verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁע מוֹאָב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַחְאָב׃
verses.english: And Moav rebelled against Israel after the death of Ah’av.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֹּל אֲחַזְיָה בְּעַד הַשְּׂבָכָה בַּעֲלִיָּתוֹ אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּחַל וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן אִם־אֶחְיֶה מֵחֳלִי זֶה׃
verses.english: Now Ahazya fell through the lattice of his upper-chamber that was in Shomeron,and he became sick [from his injuries].So he sent messengers, and said to them:Go, inquire of Baal Zevuv/Master of Flies The name is a nasty pun on “Baal Zevul,” “Baal the Exalted,” commonly found in Ugaritic texts. See the name “Izevel” in I Kings 16:31, for a possible similar usage. The trad. English for the name is “Baal-zebub,” which in later Jewish and then Christian tradition became Beelzebub, a significant demon and eventually a nickname for the Devil. , the god of Ekron One of the five major Philistine towns.,whether I will live through this sickness!

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי קוּם עֲלֵה לִקְרַאת מַלְאֲכֵי מֶלֶךְ־שֹׁמְרוֹן וְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם הַמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתֶּם הֹלְכִים לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now a messenger of YHWH spoke to Eliyya the Tishbite:Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Shomeron,and speak to them:Is it because there is no God in Israel[that all of] you go to inquire of Baal Zevuv, the god of Ekron?

verses.hebrew: וְלָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי מוֹת תָּמוּת וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּה׃
verses.english: So therefore, thus says YHWH:The bed into which you climbed up,you will not come down from it,but you will die, yes, die!And Eliyya went off.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה־זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּם׃
verses.english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them:Now why have you returned?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ עָלָה לִקְרָאתֵנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֵינוּ לְכוּ שׁוּבוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הַמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה שֹׁלֵחַ לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן לָכֵן הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃
verses.english: They said to him:A man came up to meet us,and he said to us:Go, return to the king who sent you,and speak to him:Thus says YHWH:Is it because there is no God in Israel[that] you send to inquire of Baal Zevuv, the god of Ekron?Therefore,the bed into which you climbed up,you will not come down from it,but you will die, yes, die!

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם מֶה מִשְׁפַּט הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָה לִקְרַאתְכֶם וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיכֶם אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: He spoke to them:What is the manner of the man who came up to meet youand spoke these words to you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ בַּעַל שֵׂעָר וְאֵזוֹר עוֹר אָזוּר בְּמָתְנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אֵלִיָּה הַתִּשְׁבִּי הוּא׃
verses.english: They said to him:A hairy, “possessing (much) hair,” echoing “Baal Zevuv” (Cohn 2000). It is not clear whether the text means a hairy man or merely one wearing animal skins. man,with a girded-belt of leather girded about his loins.He said:It is Eliyya the Tishbite!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַל אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה יֹשֵׁב עַל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַמֶּלֶךְ דִּבֶּר רֵדָה׃
verses.english: So he sent to him a captain of fifty, with his [unit of] fifty.He went up to him,and here, he was sitting on top of a hill;and he spoke to him:O man of God, the king has spoken:Come down!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנֶה אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־שַׂר הַחֲמִשִּׁים וְאִם־אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים אָנִי תֵּרֶד אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתֹאכַל אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־חֲמִשֶּׁיךָ וַתֵּרֶד אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתֹּאכַל אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמִשָּׁיו׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu answeredand spoke to the captain of fifty:Now if I am a man of God,let fire and esh. come down from the heavensand consume you and your fifty!And fire came down from the heavensand consumed him and his fifty.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים אַחֵר וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מְהֵרָה רֵדָה׃
verses.english: He sent again to him—another captain of fifty and his fifty;he went up and spoke to him:O man of God,thus says the king:Come down quickly!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֵלִיָּה וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם אִם־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אָנִי תֵּרֶד אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתֹאכַל אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־חֲמִשֶּׁיךָ וַתֵּרֶד אֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתֹּאכַל אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־חֲמִשָּׁיו׃
verses.english: Eliyya answered and spoke to them:If I am a man of God,let fire come down from the heavensand consume you and your fifty!And fire of God came down from the heavensand consumed him and his fifty.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁלִשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַל וַיָּבֹא שַׂר־הַחֲמִשִּׁים הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּכְרַע עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לְנֶגֶד אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּתְחַנֵּן אֵלָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים תִּיקַר־נָא נַפְשִׁי וְנֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֵלֶּה חֲמִשִּׁים בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: He sent again—a third captain of fifty and his fifty;he went up, following LXX; MT has vayaan, “spoke up.” and came, the third captain of fifty,but he bowed on his knees in front of Eliyyahuand pleaded with himand spoke to him:O man of God, now may my life and the life of these your fifty servants be precious in your eyes!

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָרְדָה אֵשׁ מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־שְׁנֵי שָׂרֵי הַחֲמִשִּׁים הָרִאשֹׁנִים וְאֶת־חֲמִשֵּׁיהֶם וְעַתָּה תִּיקַר נַפְשִׁי בְּעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: [For] here, fire came down from the heavensand consumed the previous captains of fifty and their fifties;but now, may my life be precious in your eyes!

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ רֵד אוֹתוֹ אַל־תִּירָא מִפָּנָיו וַיָּקָם וַיֵּרֶד אוֹתוֹ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then a messenger of God spoke to Eliyyahu:Go down with him; do not be afraid before him.So he arose and went down with him to the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ מַלְאָכִים לִדְרֹשׁ בְּבַעַל זְבוּב אֱלֹהֵי עֶקְרוֹן הַמִבְּלִי אֵין־אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לִדְרֹשׁ בִּדְבָרוֹ לָכֵן הַמִּטָּה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִיתָ שָּׁם לֹא־תֵרֵד מִמֶּנָּה כִּי־מוֹת תָּמוּת׃
verses.english: And he spoke to him:Thus says YHWH:Because you sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zevuv, the God of Ekron,—Is it because there is no God in Israel whose word can be inquired of?—therefore,the bed into which you climbed up,you will not come down from it,but you will die, yes, die!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלִיָּהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹרָם תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה כִּי לֹא־הָיָה לוֹ בֵּן׃
verses.english: And he died, in accordance with the word of YHWH that Eliyyahu had spoken,and Yehoram reigned as king in his place,in year two of Yehoram son of Yehoshafat, king of Judah,for he had no son.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵמָּה כְתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Ahazyahu, [and] what he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּהַעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֶת־אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁע מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל׃
verses.english: Now it was,when YHWH was about to bring up Eliyyahu in a storm to the heavens,that Eliyyahu went with Elisha from Gilgal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהוָה שְׁלָחַנִי עַד־בֵּית־אֵל וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּרְדוּ בֵּית־אֵל׃
verses.english: And Eliyyahu said to Elisha:Pray stay here,for YHWH has sent me as far as Bet-El.Elisha said:By the life of YHWH and by your own life, if I should leave you … !So they went down to Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בֵּית־אֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי הֶחֱשׁוּ׃
verses.english: And the Sons of the Prophets who were in Bet-El came out to Elishaand said to him:Do you knowthat today YHWH is going to take your lord from your head?He said:Certainly I know; be silent!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ אֱלִישָׁע שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהוָה שְׁלָחַנִי יְרִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרִיחוֹ׃
verses.english: Eliyyahu said to him:Elisha, pray stay here,for YHWH has sent me to Jericho.But he said:By the life of YHWH and by your own life, if I should leave you … !So they came to Jericho.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הֲיָדַעְתָּ כִּי הַיּוֹם יְהוָה לֹקֵחַ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ מֵעַל רֹאשֶׁךָ וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי הֶחֱשׁוּ׃
verses.english: And the Sons of the Prophets who were in Jericho came close to Elishaand said to him:Do you knowthat today YHWH is going to take your lord from your head?He said:Certainly I know; be silent!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ שֵׁב־נָא פֹה כִּי יְהוָה שְׁלָחַנִי הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Then Eliyyahu said to him:Pray stay here,for YHWH has sent me to the Jordan.But he said:By the life of YHWH and by your own life, if I should leave you … !Thus the two of them walked on.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים הָלְכוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ מִנֶּגֶד מֵרָחוֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶם עָמְדוּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Now fifty men of the Sons of the Prophets wentand stood opposite, at a distance,while the two of them stood by the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֵלִיָּהוּ אֶת־אַדַּרְתּוֹ וַיִּגְלֹם וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעַבְרוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם בֶּחָרָבָה׃
verses.english: And Eliyyahu took his mantle, folded it up, and struck the waters,and they split in half, to here and to there,and the two of them crossed over on dry-ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְעָבְרָם וְאֵלִיָּהוּ אָמַר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע שְׁאַל מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ בְּטֶרֶם אֶלָּקַח מֵעִמָּךְ וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע וִיהִי־נָא פִּי־שְׁנַיִם בְּרוּחֲךָ אֵלָי׃
verses.english: It was when they crossed that Eliyyahu said to Elisha:Make-request: what may I do for you before I am taken from beside you?Elisha said:Pray let a twofold measure of your spirit be upon me!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִקְשִׁיתָ לִשְׁאוֹל אִם־תִּרְאֶה אֹתִי לֻקָּח מֵאִתָּךְ יְהִי־לְךָ כֵן וְאִם־אַיִן לֹא יִהְיֶה׃
verses.english: He said:You have made a difficult request.If you see me being taken from you, it will be thus for you,but if not, it will not be.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵמָּה הֹלְכִים הָלוֹךְ וְדַבֵּר וְהִנֵּה רֶכֶב־אֵשׁ וְסוּסֵי אֵשׁ וַיַּפְרִדוּ בֵּין שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַל אֵלִיָּהוּ בַּסְעָרָה הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: And it was, as they were walking, walking along and speaking,that here, a chariot of fire and horses of fire:they parted the two of them,and Eliyyahu went up in the storm to the heavens.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע רֹאֶה וְהוּא מְצַעֵק אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו וְלֹא רָאָהוּ עוֹד וַיַּחֲזֵק בִּבְגָדָיו וַיִּקְרָעֵם לִשְׁנַיִם קְרָעִים׃
verses.english: When Elisha saw [it],he kept crying out: Father! Father!Israel’s chariotry and its horsemen!But he saw him no more.So he took hold of his garments and tore them into two torn-pieces,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשָׁב וַיַּעֲמֹד עַל־שְׂפַת הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: and picked up the mantle of Eliyyahu that had fallen from him;then he returned and stood at the bank of the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־אַדֶּרֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר־נָפְלָה מֵעָלָיו וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֹּאמַר אַיֵּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ אַף־הוּא וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: And he took the mantle of Eliyyahu that had fallen from himand struck the waters,and said:Where is YHWH, the God of Eliyyahu, indeed, “even he,” to efo. No good solution has been found to this awkward sentence.?He struck the watersand they split in half, to here and to there,and Elisha crossed over.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאֻהוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר־בִּירִיחוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָחָה רוּחַ אֵלִיָּהוּ עַל־אֱלִישָׁע וַיָּבֹאוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: And the Sons of the Prophets who were in Jericho saw him opposite;they said:The spirit of Eliyyahu has come to rest upon Elisha!They came to meet him and bowed low before him to the ground,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו הִנֵּה־נָא יֵשׁ־אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ חֲמִשִּׁים אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי־חַיִל יֵלְכוּ נָא וִיבַקְשׁוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ פֶּן־נְשָׂאוֹ רוּחַ יְהוָה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הֶהָרִים אוֹ בְּאַחַת הגיאות [הַגֵּאָיוֹת] וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תִשְׁלָחוּ׃
verses.english: and they said to him:Now here, there are fifty men among your servants, valiant ones;pray let them go and seek your lord,lest the rushing-spirit of YHWH has carried him offand has thrown him onto one of the mountains or into one of the valleys!But he said:You are not to send!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־בוֹ עַד־בֹּשׁ וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁלָחוּ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ שְׁלֹשָׁה־יָמִים וְלֹא מְצָאֻהוּ׃
verses.english: But they pressed him until he was ashamed,so he said: Send.They sent fifty menand searched for three days,but they did not find him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ אֵלָיו וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב בִּירִיחוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם הֲלוֹא־אָמַרְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם אַל־תֵּלֵכוּ׃
verses.english: They returned to him—he was staying in Jericho—and he said to them:Did I not say to you: Do not go?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא מוֹשַׁב הָעִיר טוֹב כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי רֹאֶה וְהַמַּיִם רָעִים וְהָאָרֶץ מְשַׁכָּלֶת׃
verses.english: The men of the town said to Elisha:Now here, the site of the town is good, as my lord can see,but the water is bad, and the land causes miscarrying!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קְחוּ־לִי צְלֹחִית חֲדָשָׁה וְשִׂימוּ שָׁם מֶלַח וַיִּקְחוּ אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: He said:Fetch me a new bowl and put salt there.They fetched [it] for him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־מוֹצָא הַמַּיִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁם מֶלַח וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה רִפִּאתִי לַמַּיִם הָאֵלֶּה לֹא־יִהְיֶה מִשָּׁם עוֹד מָוֶת וּמְשַׁכָּלֶת׃
verses.english: He went out to the outflow of the watersand threw salt in it,and he said:Thus says YHWH:I have healed these waters;there will no longer be death and miscarrying from there!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָפוּ הַמַּיִם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃
verses.english: And the waters were healed, until this very day,in accordance with the word of Elisha which he had spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם בֵּית־אֵל וְהוּא עֹלֶה בַדֶּרֶךְ וּנְעָרִים קְטַנִּים יָצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־בוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ עֲלֵה קֵרֵחַ׃
verses.english: He went up from there to Bet-El.And as he was going up on the road, some young lads went up out of the town;they jeered at him and said to him:Go up, baldhead! Go up, baldhead!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵם וַיְקַלְלֵם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה וַתֵּצֶאנָה שְׁתַּיִם דֻּבִּים מִן־הַיַּעַר וַתְּבַקַּעְנָה מֵהֶם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנֵי יְלָדִים׃
verses.english: He faced about behind him and saw themand cursed them in the name of YHWH,and two she-bears came out of the forestand ripped up forty-two youngsters from them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וּמִשָּׁם שָׁב שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: He went from there to Mount Carmel,and from there he returned to Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וִיהוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה לִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Now Yehoram son of Ah’av became king over Israel in Shomeronin year eighteen of Yehoshafat king of Judah;he reigned as king for twelve years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה רַק לֹא כְאָבִיו וּכְאִמּוֹ וַיָּסַר אֶת־מַצְּבַת הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃
verses.english: And he did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,although not like his father or like his mother:he removed the standing-stone of Baal that his father had made

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּחַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבֵק לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: —although he clung to the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin,and did not turn aside from them.

verses.hebrew: וּמֵישַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב הָיָה נֹקֵד וְהֵשִׁיב לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָה־אֶלֶף כָּרִים וּמֵאָה אֶלֶף אֵילִים צָמֶר׃
verses.english: Now Mesha. See the reference to Moav in the Commentary. king of Moav was a sheep-dealer;he would supply the king of Israel with a hundred thousand he-lambs and a hundred thousand rams in wool.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמוֹת אַחְאָב וַיִּפְשַׁע מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב בְּמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But it was, at the death of Ah’av,that the king of Moav rebelled against the king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹרָם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיִּפְקֹד אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And King Yehoram went out on that very day from Shomeronand counted all Israel [for war];

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב פָּשַׁע בִּי הֲתֵלֵךְ אִתִּי אֶל־מוֹאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶעֱלֶה כָּמוֹנִי כָמוֹךָ כְּעַמִּי כְעַמֶּךָ כְּסוּסַי כְּסוּסֶיךָ׃
verses.english: he went and sent to Yehoshafat king of Judah, saying:The king of Moav has rebelled against me.Will you go with me to Moav in battle?He said:I will go up![For] I am as you are:my people as your people,my horses as your horses!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵי־זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ נַעֲלֶה וַיֹּאמֶר דֶּרֶךְ מִדְבַּר אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: He said:By which road shall we go up?He said:The Road of the Wilderness of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמֶלֶך־יְהוּדָה וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַיָּסֹבּוּ דֶּרֶךְ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְלֹא־הָיָה מַיִם לַמַּחֲנֶה וְלַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So they went, the king of Israel, the king of Judah, and the king of Edom;they [traveled] round about the road for seven days.Now there was no water for the camp or for the animals that were behind them,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲהָהּ כִּי־קָרָא יְהוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: so the king of Israel said:Alas,for YHWH must have called these three kings togetherto give them into the hand of Moav!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט הַאֵין פֹּה נָבִיא לַיהוָה וְנִדְרְשָׁה אֶת־יְהוָה מֵאוֹתוֹ וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעַבְדֵי מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר פֹּה אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט אֲשֶׁר־יָצַק מַיִם עַל־יְדֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat said:Is there no prophet of YHWH herethat we may inquire of YHWH through him?One of the servants of the king of Israel answered and said:Here is Elisha son of Shafat,who poured water over the hands of Eliyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָט יֵשׁ אוֹתוֹ דְּבַר־יְהוָה וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט וּמֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: Yehoshafat said:With him is the word of YHWH!And so they went down to him,the king of Israel, and Yehoshafat, and the king of Edom.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ לֵךְ אֶל־נְבִיאֵי אָבִיךָ וְאֶל־נְבִיאֵי אִמֶּךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַל כִּי־קָרָא יְהוָה לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַמְּלָכִים הָאֵלֶּה לָתֵת אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: Elisha said to the king of Israel:What have I to do with you?Go to your father’s prophets and to your mother’s prophets!The king of Israel said to him:No—for YHWH has called these three kings togetherto give them into the hand of Moav!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע חַי־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו כִּי לוּלֵי פְּנֵי יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֲנִי נֹשֵׂא אִם־אַבִּיט אֵלֶיךָ וְאִם־אֶרְאֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Elisha said:By the life of YHWH of the Forces-On-High, in whose presence I stand,indeed: were it not that I hold up the face of Yehoshafat king of Judah [in respect],I would not look at you, I would not see you!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־לִי מְנַגֵּן וְהָיָה כְּנַגֵּן הַמְנַגֵּן וַתְּהִי עָלָיו יַד־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So-now, fetch me a [lyre] strummer!For it was, when the strummer strummed to specifically describe playing stringed instruments; a more general musical verb would have been z-m-r.,that the hand of YHWH would [come] upon him—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה עָשֹׂה הַנַּחַל הַזֶּה גֵּבִים גֵּבִים׃
verses.english: and he said:Thus says YHWH:This wadi will produce ditches upon ditches,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה לֹא־תִרְאוּ רוּחַ וְלֹא־תִרְאוּ גֶשֶׁם וְהַנַּחַל הַהוּא יִמָּלֵא מָיִם וּשְׁתִיתֶם אַתֶּם וּמִקְנֵיכֶם וּבְהֶמְתְּכֶם׃
verses.english: for thus says YHWH:You will not see wind, you will not see showers,yet that wadi will be filled with water,and you and your cattle and your animals will drink!

verses.hebrew: וְנָקַל זֹאת בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְנָתַן אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם׃
verses.english: And this is [but] a light matter in YHWH’s eyes;he will give Moav into your hand.

verses.hebrew: וְהִכִּיתֶם כָּל־עִיר מִבְצָר וְכָל־עִיר מִבְחוֹר וְכָל־עֵץ טוֹב תַּפִּילוּ וְכָל־מַעְיְנֵי־מַיִם תִּסְתֹּמוּ וְכֹל הַחֶלְקָה הַטּוֹבָה תַּכְאִבוּ בָּאֲבָנִים׃
verses.english: You will strike every fortified town and every choice town,every good tree you will fell,and every spring of water you will stop up,and every good plot-of-land you will mar with stones!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר כַּעֲלוֹת הַמִּנְחָה וְהִנֵּה־מַיִם בָּאִים מִדֶּרֶךְ אֱדוֹם וַתִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַמָּיִם׃
verses.english: It was at daybreak, at about the [time of] offering up the grain-gift,that here, water was coming from the direction of Edom,and the land filled up with water.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־מוֹאָב שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־עָלוּ הַמְּלָכִים לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ מִכֹּל חֹגֵר חֲגֹרָה וָמַעְלָה וַיַּעַמְדוּ עַל־הַגְּבוּל׃
verses.english: Now all Moav had heardthat the kings were coming up to do battle against them,and they were summoned,from all those belting on a sword-belt and upward,and they stood at the border.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהַשֶּׁמֶשׁ זָרְחָה עַל־הַמָּיִם וַיִּרְאוּ מוֹאָב מִנֶּגֶד אֶת־הַמַּיִם אֲדֻמִּים כַּדָּם׃
verses.english: They started early in the morning,when the sun rose over the water,and Moav saw, from a distance, water red, “red.” as blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ דָּם זֶה הָחֳרֵב נֶחֶרְבוּ הַמְּלָכִים וַיַּכּוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְעַתָּה לַשָּׁלָל מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: So they said:This is blood!—the kings have been put-to-the-sword, yes, the sword,each one has struck down his fellow!So-now, to the spoils, O Moav!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּקֻמוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב וַיָּנֻסוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם ויבו־[וַיַּכּוּ־] בָהּ וְהַכּוֹת אֶת־מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: They came to the camp of Israel,but Israel arose and struck Moav, so that they fled before them;they came against it, to strike down Moav:

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים יַהֲרֹסוּ וְכָל־חֶלְקָה טוֹבָה יַשְׁלִיכוּ אִישׁ־אַבְנוֹ וּמִלְאוּהָ וְכָל־מַעְיַן־מַיִם יִסְתֹּמוּ וְכָל־עֵץ־טוֹב יַפִּילוּ עַד־הִשְׁאִיר אֲבָנֶיהָ בַּקִּיר חֲרָשֶׂת וַיָּסֹבּוּ הַקַּלָּעִים וַיַּכּוּהָ׃
verses.english: the towns they wrecked,and into every good plot-of-land each one threw his stone, and filled it up,while every source of water they stopped upand every good tree they felled,until [only] its stones in Kir-Hareset were left—but the slingers surrounded [it] and struck it down.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב כִּי־חָזַק מִמֶּנּוּ הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקַּח אוֹתוֹ שְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חֶרֶב לְהַבְקִיעַ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וְלֹא יָכֹלוּ׃
verses.english: And the king of Moav saw that the battle was too strong for him,so he took with him to itto, as some manuscripts have. seven hundred men drawing the sword,to break through to the king of Edom and r letters are similar in appearance).,but they could not prevail.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ עֹלָה עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיְהִי קֶצֶף־גָּדוֹל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעָלָיו וַיָּשֻׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: So he took his firstborn son, who was to become king in his place,and offered him up as an offering-up on the wall.And a great wrath was upon Israel,so that they had to march away from him and return to the land.

verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אַחַת מִנְּשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָה אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ אִישִׁי מֵת וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ כִּי עַבְדְּךָ הָיָה יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה וְהַנֹּשֶׁה בָּא לָקַחַת אֶת־שְׁנֵי יְלָדַי לוֹ לַעֲבָדִים׃
verses.english: Now a woman from the wives of the Sons of the Prophets cried out to Elisha, saying:Your servant, my husband, is dead.You yourself knowthat your servant held YHWH in awe.But a creditor has come to take away my two children as slaves for himself!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ הַגִּידִי לִי מַה־יֶּשׁ־לכי [לָךְ] בַּבָּיִת וַתֹּאמֶר אֵין לְשִׁפְחָתְךָ כֹל בַּבַּיִת כִּי אִם־אָסוּךְ שָׁמֶן׃
verses.english: Elisha said to her:What can I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?She said:Your handmaid has nothing at all in the houseexcept for a cruse of oil.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי שַׁאֲלִי־לָךְ כֵּלִים מִן־הַחוּץ מֵאֵת כָּל־שכנכי [שְׁכֵנָיִךְ] כֵּלִים רֵקִים אַל־תַּמְעִיטִי׃
verses.english: He said:Go, borrow vessels for yourself from outside, from all your neighbors, empty vessels—do not skimp—

verses.hebrew: וּבָאת וְסָגַרְתְּ הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדֵךְ וּבְעַד־בָּנַיִךְ וְיָצַקְתְּ עַל כָּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה וְהַמָּלֵא תַּסִּיעִי׃
verses.english: and come in, close the door behind you and behind your children,and pour [oil] into all these vessels,while the full ones set aside.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ וַתִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בַּעֲדָהּ וּבְעַד בָּנֶיהָ הֵם מַגִּשִׁים אֵלֶיהָ וְהִיא מיצקת [מוֹצָקֶת׃]
verses.english: So she went from him and closed the door behind her and behind her sons;as they were bringing them to her, she kept on pouring.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּמְלֹאת הַכֵּלִים וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־בְּנָהּ הַגִּישָׁה אֵלַי עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אֵין עוֹד כֶּלִי וַיַּעֲמֹד הַשָּׁמֶן׃
verses.english: And it was, when the vessels were filled up, that she said to her son:Bring me another vessel.He said:There is no other vessel!And the oil stopped.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְכִי מִכְרִי אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְשַׁלְּמִי אֶת־נשיכי [נִשְׁיֵךְ] וְאַתְּ בניכי [וּבָנַיִךְ] תִחְיִי בַּנּוֹתָר׃
verses.english: Then she came and told the man of God.He said:Go, sell the oiland pay off your debt;you and your children will live on the rest.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־שׁוּנֵם וְשָׁם אִשָּׁה גְדוֹלָה וַתַּחֲזֶק־בּוֹ לֶאֱכָל־לָחֶם וַיְהִי מִדֵּי עָבְרוֹ יָסֻר שָׁמָּה לֶאֱכָל־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Now it was, one day, that Elisha traveled to Shunem.There was a prominent, usually rendered here as “great.” woman there,and she urged him strongly to eat food [with her].So it would be, whenever he traveled by, he would turn aside there to eat food.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִישָׁהּ הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים קָדוֹשׁ הוּא עֹבֵר עָלֵינוּ תָּמִיד׃
verses.english: She said to her husband:Now here, you knowthat he is a holy man of God,passing by us regularly.

verses.hebrew: נַעֲשֶׂה־נָּא עֲלִיַּת־קִיר קְטַנָּה וְנָשִׂים לוֹ שָׁם מִטָּה וְשֻׁלְחָן וְכִסֵּא וּמְנוֹרָה וְהָיָה בְּבֹאוֹ אֵלֵינוּ יָסוּר שָׁמָּה׃
verses.english: Now let us make him a little walled upper-chamberand let us put a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp there for him,so that it may be, whenever he comes to us, he may turn aside there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיָּבֹא שָׁמָּה וַיָּסַר אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּשְׁכַּב־שָׁמָּה׃
verses.english: And it was one day that he came there,and he turned aside to the upper-chamber and lay down there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ קְרָא לַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: He said to Gehazi. The meaning of the name is not certain, but Gray links it to an Arabic verb that means “to be greedy,” appropriate here. his serving-lad:Call this Shunammite!He called her, and she stood before him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱמָר־נָא אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה חָרַדְתְּ אֵלֵינוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַחֲרָדָה הַזֹּאת מֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָךְ הֲיֵשׁ לְדַבֶּר־לָךְ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אוֹ אֶל־שַׂר הַצָּבָא וַתֹּאמֶר בְּתוֹךְ עַמִּי אָנֹכִי יֹשָׁבֶת׃
verses.english: He said to him:Now say to her:Here, you have taken the trouble for us, all this trouble;what can be done for you?Might you be spoken about to the king, or to the commander of the armed-forces?She said:Among my own kinspeople I reside.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וּמֶה לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי אֲבָל בֵּן אֵין־לָהּ וְאִישָׁהּ זָקֵן׃
verses.english: He said:So what can be done for her?Gehazi said:Well, she has no son, and her husband is old.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא־לָהּ וַיִּקְרָא־לָהּ וַתַּעֲמֹד בַּפָּתַח׃
verses.english: He said:Call her.And he called her, and she stood in the entrance.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה אתי [אַתְּ] חֹבֶקֶת בֵּן וַתֹּאמֶר אַל־אֲדֹנִי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־תְּכַזֵּב בְּשִׁפְחָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Then he said:At this set season, when time revives,you), this common word is spelled out as atti (instead of the usual atta), suggesting a northern origin of this tale. will embrace a son!She said:Do not, my lord, O man of God,do not lie to your handmaid!

verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר הָאִשָּׁה וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה כָּעֵת חַיָּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיהָ אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: But the woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son,at that set season, when time revived,as Elisha had spoken to her.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְדַּל הַיָּלֶד וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם וַיֵּצֵא אֶל־אָבִיו אֶל־הַקֹּצְרִים׃
verses.english: And the boy grew.Now it was one day, that he went out to his father, to the reapers,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיו רֹאשִׁי רֹאשִׁי וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הַנַּעַר שָׂאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: and he said to his father: My head, my head!He said to a serving-lad:Carry him to his mother!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂאֵהוּ וַיְבִיאֵהוּ אֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ עַד־הַצָּהֳרַיִם וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: So he carried him and brought him to his mother;he sat on her knees until noon,and then he died.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַל וַתַּשְׁכִּבֵהוּ עַל־מִטַּת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתִּסְגֹּר בַּעֲדוֹ וַתֵּצֵא׃
verses.english: She went up and lay him down upon the bed of the man of God,closed [the door] on him, and went out.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא אֶל־אִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁלְחָה נָא לִי אֶחָד מִן־הַנְּעָרִים וְאַחַת הָאֲתֹנוֹת וְאָרוּצָה עַד־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְאָשׁוּבָה׃
verses.english: Then she called to her husband and said:Now send me one of the lads and one of the she-asses,that I may run out to the man of God and then return.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַדּוּעַ אתי [אַתְּ] הלכתי [הֹלֶכֶת] אֵלָיו הַיּוֹם לֹא־חֹדֶשׁ וְלֹא שַׁבָּת וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: He said:For-what-reason must you be going to him today?It is not New-Moon, it is not the Sabbath.She said:[All] is well.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּחֲבֹשׁ הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־נַעֲרָהּ נְהַג וָלֵךְ אַל־תַּעֲצָר־לִי לִרְכֹּב כִּי אִם־אָמַרְתִּי לָךְ׃
verses.english: But she saddled the she-ass and said to her serving-lad:Lead and go,do not stop me from riding unless I say [so] to you.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבוֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֹתָהּ מִנֶּגֶד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי נַעֲרוֹ הִנֵּה הַשּׁוּנַמִּית הַלָּז׃
verses.english: So she wentand came to the man of God, to Mount Carmel.It was, when the man of God saw her at a distance,that he said to Gehazi his serving-lad:Here is that Shunammite.

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה רוּץ־נָא לִקְרָאתָהּ וֶאֱמָר־לָהּ הֲשָׁלוֹם לָךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לְאִישֵׁךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם לַיָּלֶד וַתֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: So-now, pray run to meet her and say to her:Is it well with you?Is it well with your husband?Is it well with the child?She said: It is well.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הָהָר וַתַּחֲזֵק בְּרַגְלָיו וַיִּגַּשׁ גֵּיחֲזִי לְהָדְפָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הַרְפֵּה־לָהּ כִּי־נַפְשָׁהּ מָרָה־לָהּ וַיהוָה הֶעְלִים מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא הִגִּיד לִי׃
verses.english: She came to the man of God, to the mountain,and she took hold of him by the feet;Gehazi approached to push her away,but the man of God said:Leave her be, for her feelings can mean “being,” “essence,” or “life” (as Cohn 2000 renders it here), or even “throat,” that is, “life-breath.” are bitter within her,yet YHWH has concealed it from me and has not told me.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁאַלְתִּי בֵן מֵאֵת אֲדֹנִי הֲלֹא אָמַרְתִּי לֹא תַשְׁלֶה אֹתִי׃
verses.english: She said:Did I request a son from my lord?Did I not say: Do not set me [too much] at ease?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְגֵיחֲזִי חֲגֹר מָתְנֶיךָ וְקַח מִשְׁעַנְתִּי בְיָדְךָ וָלֵךְ כִּי־תִמְצָא אִישׁ לֹא תְבָרְכֶנּוּ וְכִי־יְבָרֶכְךָ אִישׁ לֹא תַעֲנֶנּוּ וְשַׂמְתָּ מִשְׁעַנְתִּי עַל־פְּנֵי הַנָּעַר׃
verses.english: He said to Gehazi:Gird up your loins,take my rod in your hand, and go.If you encounter a man, you are not to bless him [in greeting];you are to answer no man,and if any man blesses you [in greeting],you are not to answer him.But put my rod on the face of the lad.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵם הַנַּעַר חַי־יְהוָה וְחֵי־נַפְשְׁךָ אִם־אֶעֶזְבֶךָּ וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: The mother of the lad said:As YHWH lives and as you live, if I should leave you … !He arose and went after her.

verses.hebrew: וְגֵחֲזִי עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת עַל־פְּנֵי הַנַּעַר וְאֵין קוֹל וְאֵין קָשֶׁב וַיָּשָׁב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא הֵקִיץ הַנָּעַר׃
verses.english: Meanwhile Gehazi crossed over ahead of them and put the rod on the face of the lad,but there was no sound and no attention,so she returned to meet him and said to him, saying:The lad did not wake up!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלִישָׁע הַבָּיְתָה וְהִנֵּה הַנַּעַר מֵת מֻשְׁכָּב עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Elisha came into the house,and here, the lad was dead, lying on his bed.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיִּסְגֹּר הַדֶּלֶת בְּעַד שְׁנֵיהֶם וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: He came in and closed the door behind the two of themand prayed to YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל וַיִּשְׁכַּב עַל־הַיֶּלֶד וַיָּשֶׂם פִּיו עַל־פִּיו וְעֵינָיו עַל־עֵינָיו וְכַפָּיו עַל־כפו [כַּפָּיו] וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיָּחָם בְּשַׂר הַיָּלֶד׃
verses.english: then he climbed up and lay down atop the child;he put his mouth on his mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his palms on his palms,and bent over him,and the flesh of the child became warm.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּבַּיִת אַחַת הֵנָּה וְאַחַת הֵנָּה וַיַּעַל וַיִּגְהַר עָלָיו וַיְזוֹרֵר הַנַּעַר עַד־שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּפְקַח הַנַּעַר אֶת־עֵינָיו׃
verses.english: He turned away and went through the house, once here and once there,then he climbed up and bent over him;the lad sneezed seven timesand the lad opened his eyes!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־גֵּיחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא אֶל־הַשֻּׁנַמִּית הַזֹּאת וַיִּקְרָאֶהָ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר שְׂאִי בְנֵךְ׃
verses.english: He called Gehazi and said:Call this Shunammite!He called her and she came to him,and he said:Lift up your son!

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא וַתִּפֹּל עַל־רַגְלָיו וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה וַתִּשָּׂא אֶת־בְּנָהּ וַתֵּצֵא׃
verses.english: She came and flung herself at his feet, and bowed low to the ground;then she lifted up her son and went out.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע שָׁב הַגִּלְגָּלָה וְהָרָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וּבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים יֹשְׁבִים לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לְנַעֲרוֹ שְׁפֹת הַסִּיר הַגְּדוֹלָה וּבַשֵּׁל נָזִיד לִבְנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים׃
verses.english: When Elisha returned to Gilgal,there was famine in the land.Now the Sons of the Prophets were sitting before him.And he said to his serving-lad:Set on the large pot,and cook stew for the Sons of the Prophets.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֶחָד אֶל־הַשָּׂדֶה לְלַקֵּט אֹרֹת וַיִּמְצָא גֶּפֶן שָׂדֶה וַיְלַקֵּט מִמֶּנּוּ פַּקֻּעֹת שָׂדֶה מְלֹא בִגְדוֹ וַיָּבֹא וַיְפַלַּח אֶל־סִיר הַנָּזִיד כִּי־לֹא יָדָעוּ׃
verses.english: One [of them] went out into the field to gather herbs,and he came across a field vineand gathered field gourds from it, [enough] to fill his garment.Then he came back and split them into the pot of stew,for he did not know [what they were].

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְקוּ לַאֲנָשִׁים לֶאֱכוֹל וַיְהִי כְּאָכְלָם מֵהַנָּזִיד וְהֵמָּה צָעָקוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָוֶת בַּסִּיר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לֶאֱכֹל׃
verses.english: Now they were poured out for the men to eat,but it was, just as they ate them from the stew,that they cried out. and said:There is death in the pot, O man of God!and they could not eat it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וּקְחוּ־קֶמַח וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל־הַסִּיר וַיֹּאמֶר צַק לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ וְלֹא הָיָה דָּבָר רָע בַּסִּיר׃
verses.english: He said:Then fetch some meal! …And he threw it into the potand said:Pour some for the people, so that they may eat!And then there was nothing evil in the pot.

verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ בָּא מִבַּעַל שָׁלִשָׁה וַיָּבֵא לְאִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לֶחֶם בִּכּוּרִים עֶשְׂרִים־לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים וְכַרְמֶל בְּצִקְלֹנוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ׃
verses.english: A man came from Baal Shalisha;he brought to the man of God bread of the firstfruits:twenty bread-loaves of barley and ears of fresh grain.And he said:Give some to the people, that they may eat!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מְשָׁרְתוֹ מָה אֶתֵּן זֶה לִפְנֵי מֵאָה אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר תֵּן לָעָם וְיֹאכֵלוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר יְהוָה אָכֹל וְהוֹתֵר׃
verses.english: His attendant said:How can I give this before a hundred persons?He said:Give some to the people, so that they may eat!For thus says YHWH:They will eat and have some left over.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיּוֹתִרוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So he gave it before them and they ate, and they had some left over, in accordance with the word of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנַעֲמָן שַׂר־צְבָא מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם הָיָה אִישׁ גָּדוֹל לִפְנֵי אֲדֹנָיו וּנְשֻׂא פָנִים כִּי־בוֹ נָתַן־יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָה לַאֲרָם וְהָאִישׁ הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל מְצֹרָע׃
verses.english: Now Naaman. From a common Semitic root meaning “pleasant.” , commander of the armed-forces of the king of Aram, was a man prominent before his lord, one lifted up of face,for through him, YHWH had given victory to Aram.But the man, [though] a mighty-one of valor, was stricken-with-tzaraat For centuries translated as “leprosy,” the dreaded Hansen’s disease, but modern scholars understand it as some sort of unsightly but not contagious or serious skin rash. The strong negativity it invokes (see Lev. 13–14) may be due to the common visual deterioration and hence the suggestion of death, which was the great ritual pollutant in the Bible..

verses.hebrew: וַאֲרָם יָצְאוּ גְדוּדִים וַיִּשְׁבּוּ מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲרָה קְטַנָּה וַתְּהִי לִפְנֵי אֵשֶׁת נַעֲמָן׃
verses.english: Once Aram had gone out in raiding-bands,and they had taken a young girl captive from the land of Israel;she was [in service] before Naaman’s wife.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־גְּבִרְתָּהּ אַחֲלֵי אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אָז יֶאֱסֹף אֹתוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: She said to her mistress:Would that my lord were [standing] before the prophet who is in Shomeron—then he would cure him of his tzaraat!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיַּגֵּד לַאדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת דִּבְּרָה הַנַּעֲרָה אֲשֶׁר מֵאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He came back and told his lord, saying:Like this and like that spoke the girl who is from the land of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם לֶךְ־בֹּא וְאֶשְׁלְחָה סֵפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח בְּיָדוֹ עֶשֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי־כֶסֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים זָהָב וְעֶשֶׂר חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים׃
verses.english: The king of Aram said:Go, come [then]—I will send a letter to the king of Israel.He went and took in his hand ten talents of silver and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten sets of garments,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר וְעַתָּה כְּבוֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶת־נַעֲמָן עַבְדִּי וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: and he brought the letter to the king of Israel [which] said:So-now, when this letter reaches you,here, I am sending you Naaman my servant,so that you may cure him of his tzaraat.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּקְרֹא מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר וַיִּקְרַע בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הַאֱלֹהִים אָנִי לְהָמִית וּלְהַחֲיוֹת כִּי־זֶה שֹׁלֵחַ אֵלַי לֶאֱסֹף אִישׁ מִצָּרַעְתּוֹ כִּי אַךְ־דְּעוּ־נָא וּרְאוּ כִּי־מִתְאַנֶּה הוּא לִי׃
verses.english: But it was, when the king of Israel read the letter, that he tore his garmentsand said:Am I God, to deal death and bestow life,that this one sends [a message] to me to cure a man of his tzaraat?Indeed, just know and take-noteof how he is seeking a pretext against me!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי־קָרַע מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר לָמָּה קָרַעְתָּ בְּגָדֶיךָ יָבֹא־נָא אֵלַי וְיֵדַע כִּי יֵשׁ נָבִיא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Elisha the man of God heardthat the king of Israel had torn his garments,he sent to the king of Israel, saying:Why have you torn your garments?Just have him come to me,that he may knowthat there is a prophet in Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא נַעֲמָן בסוסו [בְּסוּסָיו] וּבְרִכְבּוֹ וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח־הַבַּיִת לֶאֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot,and stood at the entrance to the house belonging to Elisha.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע מַלְאָךְ לֵאמֹר הָלוֹךְ וְרָחַצְתָּ שֶׁבַע־פְּעָמִים בַּיַּרְדֵּן וְיָשֹׁב בְּשָׂרְךָ לְךָ וּטְהָר׃
verses.english: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying:Go and wash seven times in the Jordan;then your flesh will be restored to you, and you will be purified see Lev. 13–14..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף נַעֲמָן וַיֵּלַךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה אָמַרְתִּי אֵלַי יֵצֵא יָצוֹא וְעָמַד וְקָרָא בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְהֵנִיף יָדוֹ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם וְאָסַף הַמְּצֹרָע׃
verses.english: But Naaman became furious and went away;he said:Here, I had said to myself:He will come out, yes, out, and stand [there] to call on the name of YHWH his god,then he will raise his hand over the diseased-spot, and take away the tzaraat.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא טוֹב אבנה [אֲמָנָה] וּפַרְפַּר נַהֲרוֹת דַּמֶּשֶׂק מִכֹּל מֵימֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־אֶרְחַץ בָּהֶם וְטָהָרְתִּי וַיִּפֶן וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּחֵמָה׃
verses.english: Are not the Amana and the Parpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?Could I not wash in them and be purified?He turned and went away in hot-anger.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ אָבִי דָּבָר גָּדוֹל הַנָּבִיא דִּבֶּר אֵלֶיךָ הֲלוֹא תַעֲשֶׂה וְאַף כִּי־אָמַר אֵלֶיךָ רְחַץ וּטְהָר׃
verses.english: But his servants approached and spoke to him, they said:If it were a hard thing that the prophet spoke to you, would you not do it?How much more so, when he said to you: Wash and be purified!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּיַּרְדֵּן שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיָּשָׁב בְּשָׂרוֹ כִּבְשַׂר נַעַר קָטֹן וַיִּטְהָר׃
verses.english: So he went down and dipped in the Jordan seven times, in accordance with the word of the man of God,and his flesh was returned-to-health like a young lad’s flesh,and he was purified.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אֶל־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים הוּא וְכָל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־נָא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אֵין אֱלֹהִים בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ כִּי אִם־בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַתָּה קַח־נָא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Then he returned to the man of God, he and all his camp,and he came and stood before him and said:Now here, I knowthat there is no god in all the earth except in Israel!So-now, pray accept a blessing-gift from your servant!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חַי־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָמַדְתִּי לְפָנָיו אִם־אֶקָּח וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ לָקַחַת וַיְמָאֵן׃
verses.english: He said:As YHWH lives, before whom I stand,if I should accept [anything] … !Now he pressed him to take [it], but he refused.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲמָן וָלֹא יֻתַּן־נָא לְעַבְדְּךָ מַשָּׂא צֶמֶד־פְּרָדִים אֲדָמָה כִּי לוֹא־יַעֲשֶׂה עוֹד עַבְדְּךָ עֹלָה וָזֶבַח לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים כִּי אִם־לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: So Naaman said:If not, let there be given to your servanta mule team’s load of earth—for never again will your servant prepare an offering-up or a sacrifice to other gods,except to YHWH!

verses.hebrew: לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה יִסְלַח יְהוָה לְעַבְדֶּךָ בְּבוֹא אֲדֹנִי בֵית־רִמּוֹן לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת שָׁמָּה וְהוּא נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדִי וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֵיתִי בֵּית רִמֹּן בְּהִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָתִי בֵּית רִמֹּן יִסְלַח־נא יְהוָה לְעַבְדְּךָ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: In this [one] matter, may YHWH pardon your servant:when my lord comes to the House of Rimmon, “pomegranate.”, to bow down there,and he leans on my arm, so that I bow down in the House of Rimmon—when I bow down in the House of Rimmon,may YHWH pardon your servant in this matter!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ לְשָׁלוֹם וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאִתּוֹ כִּבְרַת־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He said to him:Go in peace.And he went from him, a stretch of land [in distance].

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּיחֲזִי נַעַר אֱלִישָׁע אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים הִנֵּה חָשַׂךְ אֲדֹנִי אֶת־נַעֲמָן הָאֲרַמִּי הַזֶּה מִקַּחַת מִיָּדוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִיא חַי־יְהוָה כִּי־אִם־רַצְתִּי אַחֲרָיו וְלָקַחְתִּי מֵאִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה׃
verses.english: And Gehazi, the serving-lad of Elisha the man of God, said [to himself]:Here, my lord spared this Naaman the Aramean by [not] accepting what he brought from his hand;by the life of YHWH, I will surely run after him and accept something from him!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֹּף גֵּיחֲזִי אַחֲרֵי נַעֲמָן וַיִּרְאֶה נַעֲמָן רָץ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּפֹּל מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: So Gehazi pursued Naaman;when Naaman saw him running after him, he got down from the chariot to meet him,and said:Is [all] well?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׁלוֹם אֲדֹנִי שְׁלָחַנִי לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַתָּה זֶה בָּאוּ אֵלַי שְׁנֵי־נְעָרִים מֵהַר אֶפְרַיִם מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים תְּנָה־נָּא לָהֶם כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁתֵּי חֲלִפוֹת בְּגָדִים׃
verses.english: He said:[All] is well.My lord sent me, saying:Here, now two lads from the highlands of Efrayim, from the Sons of the Prophets, just came to me.Pray give them a talent of silver and two sets of garments.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲמָן הוֹאֵל קַח כִּכָּרָיִם וַיִּפְרָץ־בּוֹ וַיָּצַר כִּכְּרַיִם כֶּסֶף בִּשְׁנֵי חֲרִטִים וּשְׁתֵּי חֲלִפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיִּתֵּן אֶל־שְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו וַיִּשְׂאוּ לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: Naaman said:Consent [to] accept two talents!He pressed him, and he wrapped up two talents of silver in two purses, with two sets of garments,and gave them to his two lads,and they carried them ahead of him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָעֹפֶל וַיִּקַּח מִיָּדָם וַיִּפְקֹד בַּבָּיִת וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיֵּלֵכוּ׃
verses.english: He came to the Ofel/The Bulge,and he took them from their hand, and deposited them in the house.Then he sent the men off, and they went away,

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא־בָא וַיַּעֲמֹד אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע מאן [מֵאַיִן] גֵּחֲזִי וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־הָלַךְ עַבְדְּךָ אָנֶה וָאָנָה׃
verses.english: while he himself came and stood opposite his lord.Elisha said to him:From where, Gehazi?He said:Your servant has gone neither here nor there.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לֹא־לִבִּי הָלַךְ כַּאֲשֶׁר הָפַךְ־אִישׁ מֵעַל מֶרְכַּבְתּוֹ לִקְרָאתֶךָ הַעֵת לָקַחַת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְלָקַחַת בְּגָדִים וְזֵיתִים וּכְרָמִים וְצֹאן וּבָקָר וַעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת׃
verses.english: He said to him:Did not my heart go along, when a man reversed [course] from his chariot to meet you?[Is this] the time to take silver, to take garments, or olive-groves or vineyards, or flocks or herds, or servants or handmaids?

verses.hebrew: וְצָרַעַת נַעֲמָן תִּדְבַּק־בְּךָ וּבְזַרְעֲךָ לְעוֹלָם וַיֵּצֵא מִלְּפָנָיו מְצֹרָע כַּשָּׁלֶג׃
verses.english: So Naaman’s tzaraat—it will cleave to you and to your seed, for the ages!And he went out from before him, afflicted with tzaraat like snow.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־הַנְּבִיאִים אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע הִנֵּה־נָא הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם לְפָנֶיךָ צַר מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: [Once] the Sons of the Prophets said to Elisha:Now here, the place where we are residing before you is too narrow for us.

verses.hebrew: נֵלְכָה־נָּא עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְנִקְחָה מִשָּׁם אִישׁ קוֹרָה אֶחָת וְנַעֲשֶׂה־לָּנוּ שָׁם מָקוֹם לָשֶׁבֶת שָׁם וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכוּ׃
verses.english: Pray let us go to the Jordan, and let each one take a log from there, and let us construct ourselves there a place to reside.He said: Go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאֶחָד הוֹאֶל נָא וְלֵךְ אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: One [of them] said:Pray consent to go with your servants!Elisha said:I will go.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתָּם וַיָּבֹאוּ הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וַיִּגְזְרוּ הָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: So he went with them, and they came to the Jordan,where they felled some trees.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הָאֶחָד מַפִּיל הַקּוֹרָה וְאֶת־הַבַּרְזֶל נָפַל אֶל־הַמָּיִם וַיִּצְעַק וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי וְהוּא שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: And it was, as one was felling a log, that the iron [ax head] fell into the water;he cried out and said: Alas, my lord, for it was borrowed!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אָנָה נָפָל וַיַּרְאֵהוּ אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם וַיִּקְצָב־עֵץ וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁמָּה וַיָּצֶף הַבַּרְזֶל׃
verses.english: The man of God said: Where did it fall?He showed him the place.Then he carved out some wood and threw it in there, and it made the iron float,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָרֶם לָךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ׃
verses.english: and he said: Pick it up for yourself.So he stretched out his hand and took it.

verses.hebrew: וּמֶלֶךְ אֲרָם הָיָה נִלְחָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶל־עֲבָדָיו לֵאמֹר אֶל־מְקוֹם פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי תַּחֲנֹתִי׃
verses.english: Now the king of Aram was waging battle against Israel.He sought advice from his servants, saying:Descend on as tinhatu, derived from n-h-t with Cogan/Tadmor, to link up with v.9. thus and such a place [to attack]!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הִשָּׁמֶר מֵעֲבֹר הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי־שָׁם אֲרָם נְחִתִּים׃
verses.english: But the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying:Be careful when crossing by this place,for there Aram descends [to attack],

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים והזהירה [וְהִזְהִירוֹ] וְנִשְׁמַר שָׁם לֹא אַחַת וְלֹא שְׁתָּיִם׃
verses.english: The king of Israel sent to the place about which the man of God had spoken to him and warned him, so that he took care there,not [only] once and not [only] twice.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּעֵר לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם עַל־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־עֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הֲלוֹא תַּגִּידוּ לִי מִי מִשֶּׁלָּנוּ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And the king of Aram’s heart was in turmoil over this matter,so he called his servants and said to them:Will you not tell me:who from among us is for the king of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַחַד מֵעֲבָדָיו לוֹא אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ כִּי־אֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יַגִּיד לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר בַּחֲדַר מִשְׁכָּבֶךָ׃
verses.english: One of his servants said to him:No, my lord king;but Elisha the prophet, who is in Israel,tells the king of Israelthe words that you speak in your [very] bedroom!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ אֵיכֹה הוּא וְאֶשְׁלַח וְאֶקָּחֵהוּ וַיֻּגַּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה בְדֹתָן׃
verses.english: He said:Go and see where he is,and I will send and fetch him!It was told to him, saying:Here, in Dotan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח־שָׁמָּה סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב וְחַיִל כָּבֵד וַיָּבֹאוּ לַיְלָה וַיַּקִּפוּ עַל־הָעִיר׃
verses.english: So he sent there horses and chariots, a weighty army;they came at night and encircled the town.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים לָקוּם וַיֵּצֵא וְהִנֵּה־חַיִל סוֹבֵב אֶת־הָעִיר וְסוּס וָרָכֶב וַיֹּאמֶר נַעֲרוֹ אֵלָיו אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנִי אֵיכָה נַעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: And the attendant of the man of God started-early to rise and went out,and here, an army was surrounding the town, with horse and chariotry!His serving-lad said to him:Alas, my lord, what shall we do?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא כִּי רַבִּים אֲשֶׁר אִתָּנוּ מֵאֲשֶׁר אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: He said:Do not be afraid,for many more are those who are with us than who are with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה פְּקַח־נָא אֶת־עֵינָיו וְיִרְאֶה וַיִּפְקַח יְהוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי הַנַּעַר וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָהָר מָלֵא סוּסִים וְרֶכֶב אֵשׁ סְבִיבֹת אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: Now Elisha prayed and said:O YHWH, now open his eyes, that he may see!So YHWH opened the eyes of the lad, and he saw:now here, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire surrounding Elisha!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֵלָיו וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֱלִישָׁע אֶל־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר הַךְ־נָא אֶת־הַגּוֹי־הַזֶּה בַּסַּנְוֵרִים וַיַּכֵּם בַּסַּנְוֵרִים כִּדְבַר אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: They went down against him, but Elisha prayed to YHWH and said:Now strike this nation with dazzling-light!And he struck them with dazzling-light, in accordance with the word of Elisha.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֱלִישָׁע לֹא זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ וְלֹא זֹה הָעִיר לְכוּ אַחֲרַי וְאוֹלִיכָה אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תְּבַקֵּשׁוּן וַיֹּלֶךְ אוֹתָם שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃
verses.english: Elisha said to them:This, the standard word for “this” in biblical Hebrew, the text makes use of zo, an Aramaism. is not the way and this is not the town!Go along after me, and I will lead you to the man whom you seek.And he led them to Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבֹאָם שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְהוָה פְּקַח אֶת־עֵינֵי־אֵלֶּה וְיִרְאוּ וַיִּפְקַח יְהוָה אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה בְּתוֹךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: It was, when they came to Shomeron,that Elisha said: O YHWH,open the eyes of these [people], that they may see!So YHWH opened their eyes, and they saw:now here, [they were] in the midst of Shomeron!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֱלִישָׁע כִּרְאֹתוֹ אוֹתָם הַאַכֶּה אַכֶּה אָבִי׃
verses.english: The king of Israel said to Elisha when he saw them:Shall I strike, strike them down, Father?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַכֶּה הַאֲשֶׁר שָׁבִיתָ בְּחַרְבְּךָ וּבְקַשְׁתְּךָ אַתָּה מַכֶּה שִׂים לֶחֶם וָמַיִם לִפְנֵיהֶם וְיֹאכְלוּ וְיִשְׁתּוּ וְיֵלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: He said:You are not to strike.Those whom you have taken captive with your sword, with your bow,would you strike [them] down?Put food and water before them, that they may eat and drink and go back to their lords.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֶה לָהֶם כֵּרָה גְדוֹלָה וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיהֶם וְלֹא־יָסְפוּ עוֹד גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם לָבוֹא בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And he spread out for them a great spread. The Hebrew word (kera) occurs only here in the Bible.,so that they ate and drank;then he sent them off, and they went back to their lords.And the raiding-bands of Aram no longer came into the land of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיִּקְבֹּץ בֶּן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־כָּל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וַיַּעַל וַיָּצַר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now it was, [some time] after this,that Ben-Hadad king of Aram collected all his camp;he went up and besieged Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי רָעָב גָּדוֹל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וְהִנֵּה צָרִים עָלֶיהָ עַד הֱיוֹת רֹאשׁ־חֲמוֹר בִּשְׁמֹנִים כֶּסֶף וְרֹבַע הַקַּב חרייונים [דִּבְיוֹנִים] בַּחֲמִשָּׁה־כָסֶף׃
verses.english: And there was a great famine in Shomeron;here, they were besieging ituntil [the price of] a donkey’s head was eighty silver-pieces,and a quarter of a kav of “pigeons’ dung,” five silver-pieces.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וְאִשָּׁה צָעֲקָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הוֹשִׁיעָה אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now it was that the king of Israel was crossing on the wall when a woman cried out to him, saying:Save [me], my lord king!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יוֹשִׁעֵךְ יְהוָה מֵאַיִן אוֹשִׁיעֵךְ הֲמִן־הַגֹּרֶן אוֹ מִן־הַיָּקֶב׃
verses.english: He said:No; let YHWH save you—from where can I save you?From the threshing-floor or from the winepress?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת אָמְרָה אֵלַי תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַיּוֹם וְאֶת־בְּנִי נֹאכַל מָחָר׃
verses.english: And the king said to her:What [ails] you?She said:This woman said to me:Give over your son, that we may eat him today,and my son we will eat tomorrow!

verses.hebrew: וַנְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־בְּנִי וַנֹּאכְלֵהוּ וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ בַּיּוֹם הָאַחֵר תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ וַתַּחְבִּא אֶת־בְּנָהּ׃
verses.english: So we boiled my son, and ate him;then I said to her on the next day:Give over your son, that we may eat him—but she hid her son.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הָאִשָּׁה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְהוּא עֹבֵר עַל־הַחֹמָה וַיַּרְא הָעָם וְהִנֵּה הַשַּׂק עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ מִבָּיִת׃
verses.english: Now it was, when the king heard the woman’s words,that he tore his garments;and as he was crossing by the wall,the people saw that here, the sackcloth was on his flesh, on the inside.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־יַעֲשֶׂה־לִּי אֱלֹהִים וְכֹה יוֹסִף אִם־יַעֲמֹד רֹאשׁ אֱלִישָׁע בֶּן־שָׁפָט עָלָיו הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: He said:Thus may God do to me, and thus may he add,if the head of Elisha son of Shafat is left standing upon him today!

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע יֹשֵׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ וְהַזְּקֵנִים יֹשְׁבִים אִתּוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח אִישׁ מִלְּפָנָיו בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ אֵלָיו וְהוּא אָמַר אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִים הַרְּאִיתֶם כִּי־שָׁלַח בֶּן־הַמְרַצֵּחַ הַזֶּה לְהָסִיר אֶת־רֹאשִׁי רְאוּ כְּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ סִגְרוּ הַדֶּלֶת וּלְחַצְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בַּדֶּלֶת הֲלוֹא קוֹל רַגְלֵי אֲדֹנָיו אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him,and he had sent a man from his presence;but before the messenger came to him, he had said to the elders:Do you see that this son of a murderer has sent to remove my head?See, when the messenger comes, close the door and press him against the door;is not the sound of his lord’s footsteps behind him?

verses.hebrew: עוֹדֶנּוּ מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם וְהִנֵּה הַמַּלְאָךְ יֹרֵד אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־זֹאת הָרָעָה מֵאֵת יְהוָה מָה־אוֹחִיל לַיהוָה עוֹד׃
verses.english: He was still speaking with themwhen here, the king came down to himand said:Here now, this evil-fate is from YHWH;what more hope in YHWH can I have?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־יְהוָה כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה כָּעֵת מָחָר סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Then Elisha said:Hear the word of YHWH:Thus says YHWH:Around this time tomorrow,a sei’a of flour [will go] for a shekel Food commodities will be incredibly expensive because of the siege. and two sei’as of barley for a shekel, at the gate of Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לַמֶּלֶךְ נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ אֶת־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמַר הִנֵּה יְהוָה עֹשֶׂה אֲרֻבּוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֲיִהְיֶה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְּכָה רֹאֶה בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם לֹא תֹאכֵל׃
verses.english: Then the officer upon whose arm the king leans spoke up to the man of Godand said:Here, were YHWH to make hatches in the sky,could this thing happen?He said:Here, you will it see with your eyes,but from there you shall not eat!

verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעָה אֲנָשִׁים הָיוּ מְצֹרָעִים פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מָה אֲנַחְנוּ יֹשְׁבִים פֹּה עַד־מָתְנוּ׃
verses.english: Now there were four men with tzaraat, at the entrance to the [town] gate.They said, each one to his neighbor:Why are we sitting here until we die?

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְנוּ נָבוֹא הָעִיר וְהָרָעָב בָּעִיר וָמַתְנוּ שָׁם וְאִם־יָשַׁבְנוּ פֹה וָמָתְנוּ וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנִפְּלָה אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם אִם־יְחַיֻּנוּ נִחְיֶה וְאִם־יְמִיתֻנוּ וָמָתְנוּ׃
verses.english: If we say, Let us go into the town,there is a famine in the town,and we will die there,and if we sit here, we will die.So-now, let us go and fall away to the camp of Aram—if they let us live, then we will live,and if they put us to death, then we will die.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף לָבוֹא אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־קְצֵה מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ׃
verses.english: So they arose at twilight-breeze, to enter the camp of Aram.They had entered the edge of camp of Aram,and here, there was no one there!

verses.hebrew: וַאדֹנָי הִשְׁמִיעַ אֶת־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם קוֹל רֶכֶב קוֹל סוּס קוֹל חַיִל גָּדוֹל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו הִנֵּה שָׂכַר־עָלֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־מַלְכֵי הַחִתִּים וְאֶת־מַלְכֵי מִצְרַיִם לָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: —For YHWH had made the camp of Aram hearthe sound of chariots, the sound of horses,the sound of a great army,so that each one said to his brother:Here, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Egypt, to come against us!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ וַיָּנוּסוּ בַנֶּשֶׁף וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־אָהֳלֵיהֶם וְאֶת־סוּסֵיהֶם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶם הַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר־הִיא וַיָּנֻסוּ אֶל־נַפְשָׁם׃
verses.english: So they arose and fled at twilight-breeze,and abandoned their tents and their horses and their donkeys,[with] the camp as it was,and they fled for their lives.—

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ הַמְצֹרָעִים הָאֵלֶּה עַד־קְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אֶחָד וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב וּבְגָדִים וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־אֹהֶל אַחֵר וַיִּשְׂאוּ מִשָּׁם וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּטְמִנוּ׃
verses.english: And those with tzaraat came to the edge of the camp,and they entered a tent, and ate and drank,and carried off from there silver and gold and garments,and went away and hid them;then they returned and entered another tent,and carried off [things] from thereand went away and hid them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ לֹא־כֵן אֲנַחְנוּ עֹשִׂים הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יוֹם־בְּשֹׂרָה הוּא וַאֲנַחְנוּ מַחְשִׁים וְחִכִּינוּ עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וּמְצָאָנוּ עָווֹן וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנָבֹאָה וְנַגִּידָה בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then they said, each one to his neighbor:It is not proper, what we are doing;this day—it is a day of [good] news,and we are keeping silent!If we wait until the light of daybreak,iniquity will find us!So-now, let us go, let us enter, and let us inform the king’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־שֹׁעֵר הָעִיר וַיַּגִּידוּ לָהֶם לֵאמֹר בָּאנוּ אֶל־מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וְהִנֵּה אֵין־שָׁם אִישׁ וְקוֹל אָדָם כִּי אִם־הַסּוּס אָסוּר וְהַחֲמוֹר אָסוּר וְאֹהָלִים כַּאֲשֶׁר־הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: So they went and called out to the gatekeepers of the townand told them, saying:We entered the camp of Aram,and here, no one was there, or even a human voice,but the horses were tied up and the donkeys were tied up,[with] the tents as they were.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַשֹּׁעֲרִים וַיַּגִּידוּ בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ פְּנִימָה׃
verses.english: The gatekeepers called out and informed the king’s house within,

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו אַגִּידָה־נָּא לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ לָנוּ אֲרָם יָדְעוּ כִּי־רְעֵבִים אֲנַחְנוּ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְהֵחָבֵה בהשדה [בַשָּׂדֶה] לֵאמֹר כִּי־יֵצְאוּ מִן־הָעִיר וְנִתְפְּשֵׂם חַיִּים וְאֶל־הָעִיר נָבֹא׃
verses.english: and the king arose at night and said to his servants:Now let me inform you what Aram has done to us:they knew that we were famished,so they went out of the camp to hide in the open-field, saying:When they have gone out of the town,we will seize them alive, and the town we will enter!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן אֶחָד מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר וְיִקְחוּ־נָא חֲמִשָּׁה מִן־הַסּוּסִים הַנִּשְׁאָרִים אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ הִנָּם כְּכָל־ההמון [הֲמוֹן] יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁאֲרוּ־בָהּ הִנָּם כְּכָל־הֲמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־תָּמּוּ וְנִשְׁלְחָה וְנִרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Then one of his servants spoke up and said:Now let them take five of the remaining horses, the ones that remain in it;here, they are like the whole throng of Israel that remain in it,here, they are like the whole throng of Israel that is done for.Let us send them and let us see!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי רֶכֶב סוּסִים וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מַחֲנֵה־אֲרָם לֵאמֹר לְכוּ וּרְאוּ׃
verses.english: So they picked two chariots of horses,and the king sent them after the camp of Aram, saying:Go and see.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְהִנֵּה כָל־הַדֶּרֶךְ מְלֵאָה בְגָדִים וְכֵלִים אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁלִיכוּ אֲרָם בהחפזם [בְּחָפְזָם] וַיָּשֻׁבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: They went after them, as far as the Jordan,and here, the whole road was filled with garments and vesselswhich Aram had thrown away in their fearful-haste here; the Qere reads correctly..The messenger returned and told the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם וַיָּבֹזּוּ אֵת מַחֲנֵה אֲרָם וַיְהִי סְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל וְסָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל כִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And the people went out and despoiled the camp of Aram;and it was that a sei’a of flour [went for] a shekel, and two sei’as of barley for a shekel, in accordance with the word of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ הִפְקִיד אֶת־הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁעָן עַל־יָדוֹ עַל־הַשַּׁעַר וַיִּרְמְסֻהוּ הָעָם בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּרֶדֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: Now the king had appointed the officer upon whose arm he leans to the town gate,and the people trampled him at the gate, so that he died,as the man of God had spoken,as he had spoken when the king had come down to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סָאתַיִם שְׂעֹרִים בְּשֶׁקֶל וּסְאָה־סֹלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל יִהְיֶה כָּעֵת מָחָר בְּשַׁעַר שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: For it was when the man of God had spoken to the king, saying:Two sei’as of barley [will go] for a shekel, and a sei’a of flour for a shekel will go at around this time tomorrow at the gate of Shomeron—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַשָּׁלִישׁ אֶת־אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמַר וְהִנֵּה יְהוָה עֹשֶׂה אֲרֻבּוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֲיִהְיֶה כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּמִשָּׁם לֹא תֹאכֵל׃
verses.english: that the officer had answered the man of God and said:Now here, were YHWH to make hatches in the sky,could this thing happen?And he had said:Here, you will see it with your eyes,but from there you shall not eat!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ כֵּן וַיִּרְמְסוּ אֹתוֹ הָעָם בַּשַּׁעַר וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: And thus it happened to him:the people trampled him at the gate, and he died.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע דִּבֶּר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱיָה אֶת־בְּנָהּ לֵאמֹר קוּמִי וּלְכִי אתי [אַתְּ] וּבֵיתֵךְ וְגוּרִי בַּאֲשֶׁר תָּגוּרִי כִּי־קָרָא יְהוָה לָרָעָב וְגַם־בָּא אֶל־הָאָרֶץ שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying:Arise and go, you and your household,and sojourn where you wish to sojourn,for YHWH has proclaimed a famine—indeed, it has come upon the land—for seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם הָאִשָּׁה וַתַּעַשׂ כִּדְבַר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וּבֵיתָהּ וַתָּגָר בְּאֶרֶץ־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: So the woman arose and did in accordance with the word of the man of God;she went, she and her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines, for seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקְצֵה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַתָּשָׁב הָאִשָּׁה מֵאֶרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַתֵּצֵא לִצְעֹק אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־בֵּיתָהּ וְאֶל־שָׂדָהּ׃
verses.english: It was at the end of the seven yearsthat the woman returned from the land of the Philistines,and she went out to cry out to the king about her house and about her fields can be understood as a collective plural here..

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ מְדַבֵּר אֶל־גֵּחֲזִי נַעַר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר סַפְּרָה־נָּא לִי אֵת כָּל־הַגְּדֹלוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: Now the king had been speaking to Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying:Pray recount to me all the great things that Elisha has done.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הוּא מְסַפֵּר לַמֶּלֶךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱיָה אֶת־הַמֵּת וְהִנֵּה הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱיָה אֶת־בְּנָהּ צֹעֶקֶת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־בֵּיתָהּ וְעַל־שָׂדָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר גֵּחֲזִי אֲדֹנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ זֹאת הָאִשָּׁה וְזֶה־בְּנָהּ אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱיָה אֱלִישָׁע׃
verses.english: And it was, as he was recounting to the king how he had restored the dead one to life,that here, the very woman whose son he had restored to life was crying out to the king about her house and about her fields.So Gehazi said:My lord king,this is the woman and this is her son whom Elisha restored to life!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל הַמֶּלֶךְ לָאִשָּׁה וַתְּסַפֶּר־לוֹ וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ סָרִיס אֶחָד לֵאמֹר הָשֵׁיב אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ וְאֵת כָּל־תְּבוּאֹת הַשָּׂדֶה מִיּוֹם עָזְבָה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְעַד־עָתָּה׃
verses.english: The king inquired of the woman, and she recounted it to him;so the king gave her over to an official, saying:Return everything that is hers, along with all the revenue from the fields,from the time that she left the land until now.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלִישָׁע דַּמֶּשֶׂק וּבֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם חֹלֶה וַיֻּגַּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר בָּא אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים עַד־הֵנָּה׃
verses.english: Elisha came to Damascuswhen Ben-Hadad, king of Aram, was sick,and it was told to him, saying:The man of God has come here.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־חֲזָהאֵל קַח בְּיָדְךָ מִנְחָה וְלֵךְ לִקְרַאת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וְדָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת־יְהוָה מֵאוֹתוֹ לֵאמֹר הַאֶחְיֶה מֵחֳלִי זֶה׃
verses.english: The king said to Hazael:Take a gift in your handand go to meet the man of God.Inquire of God through him, saying:Will I live through this sickness?

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ חֲזָאֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיִּקַּח מִנְחָה בְיָדוֹ וְכָל־טוּב דַּמֶּשֶׂק מַשָּׂא אַרְבָּעִים גָּמָל וַיָּבֹא וַיַּעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר בִּנְךָ בֶן־הֲדַד מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם שְׁלָחַנִי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר הַאֶחְיֶה מֵחֳלִי זֶה׃
verses.english: Hazael went to meet him,he took a gift in his hand—namely, all the best-goods of Damascus, forty camel loads,and he came and stood before him, and said:Your son, Ben-Hadad king of Aram, has sent me to you, saying:Will I live through this sickness?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱלִישָׁע לֵךְ אֱמָר־לא [לוֹ] חָיֹה תִחְיֶה וְהִרְאַנִי יְהוָה כִּי־מוֹת יָמוּת׃
verses.english: Elisha said to him:Go, say to him:You will live, yes, live—but YHWH has shown me that he will die, yes, die.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֵד אֶת־פָּנָיו וַיָּשֶׂם עַד־בֹּשׁ וַיֵּבְךְּ אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: He kept his face still, setting it [thus] until he was ashamed,and then the man of God wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזָאֵל מַדּוּעַ אֲדֹנִי בֹכֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רָעָה מִבְצְרֵיהֶם תְּשַׁלַּח בָּאֵשׁ וּבַחֻרֵיהֶם בַּחֶרֶב תַּהֲרֹג וְעֹלְלֵיהֶם תְּרַטֵּשׁ וְהָרֹתֵיהֶם תְּבַקֵּעַ׃
verses.english: Hazael said:Why does my lord weep?He said:Because I know what you will do to the Children of Israel—evil:their fortified places you will set on fire,their young men you will kill with the sword,their babies you will dash-to-pieces,and their pregnant women you will split open!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חֲזָהאֵל כִּי מָה עַבְדְּךָ הַכֶּלֶב כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה הַדָּבָר הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע הִרְאַנִי יְהוָה אֹתְךָ מֶלֶךְ עַל־אֲרָם׃
verses.english: And Hazael said:Indeed, what is your servant, a [mere] dog,that he could do such a great thing?Elisha said:YHWH has shown you to me as king over Aram.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מֵאֵת אֱלִישָׁע וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה־אָמַר לְךָ אֱלִישָׁע וַיֹּאמֶר אָמַר לִי חָיֹה תִחְיֶה׃
verses.english: He went out from Elisha and came back to his lord,and he said to him:What did Elisha say to you?He said:He said to me:You will live, yes, live.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמָּחֳרָת וַיִּקַּח הַמַּכְבֵּר וַיִּטְבֹּל בַּמַּיִם וַיִּפְרֹשׂ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיָּמֹת וַיִּמְלֹךְ חֲזָהאֵל תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: But it was on the morrowthat he took meshed-cloth and dipped it in water;he spread it over his face, and he died.And Hazael reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת חָמֵשׁ לְיוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹרָם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year five of Yoram son of Ah’av king of Israel—Yehoshafat was king of Judah—Yehoram son of Yehoshafat king of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶה שנה [שָׁנִים] מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Thirty-two years old was he at his becoming king,and for eight years he reigned as king in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בֵּית אַחְאָב כִּי בַּת־אַחְאָב הָיְתָה־לּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel,as the House of Ah’av had done,for the daughter of Ah’av was a wife for him;and he did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אָבָה יְהוָה לְהַשְׁחִית אֶת־יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר־לוֹ לָתֵת לוֹ נִיר לְבָנָיו כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: But YHWH was not willing to bring ruin upon Judahfor the sake of David his servant,as he had said to him,to give him a lamp) might better be read le-fanav (“before him”). for his children, for all the days [to come].

verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו פָּשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד־יְהוּדָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: In his days Edom rebelled from under the hand of Judah,and they kinged themselves a king.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יוֹרָם צָעִירָה וְכָל־הָרֶכֶב עִמּוֹ וַיְהִי־הוּא קָם לַיְלָה וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם הַסֹּבֵיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת שָׂרֵי הָרֶכֶב וַיָּנָס הָעָם לְאֹהָלָיו׃
verses.english: So Yoram crossed over to Tza’ir, and all the chariotry with him;it was that he set out in the nightand struck Edom, who was surrounding him and the chariot commanders,and the fighting-people fled to their tents.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְשַׁע אֱדוֹם מִתַּחַת יַד־יְהוּדָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אָז תִּפְשַׁע לִבְנָה בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃
verses.english: And Edom has been rebelling from under the hand of Judah,until this day.Then Livna [too] rebelled at that time.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹרָם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yoram, and all that he did,are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹרָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yoram lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathers in the City of David,and Ahazyahu his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְיוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year twelve of the years of Yoram son of Ah’av king of Israel,Ahazyahu son of Yehoram king of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה אֲחַזְיָהוּ בְמָלְכוֹ וְשָׁנָה אַחַת מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ עֲתַלְיָהוּ בַּת־עָמְרִי מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Twenty-two years old was Ahazyahu at his becoming king,and for one year he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Atalyahu [grand]daughter of Omri king of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּבֵית אַחְאָב כִּי חֲתַן בֵּית־אַחְאָב הוּא׃
verses.english: He walked in the way of the House of Ah’av:he did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH, like the House of Ah’av,for he was a son-in-law of the House of Ah’av.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶת־יוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב לַמִּלְחָמָה עִם־חֲזָהאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד וַיַּכּוּ אֲרַמִּים אֶת־יוֹרָם׃
verses.english: He went out with Yoram son of Ah’av to do battle with Hazael king of Aram, at Ramot-Gil’ad,and the Arameans struck Yoram.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בְיִזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בָּרָמָה בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָהאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל כִּי־חֹלֶה הוּא׃
verses.english: And Yoram the king returned to be healed in Yizre’elfrom the wounds that the Arameans had struck him at Ramawhen he engaged in battle with Hazael king of Aram.And Ahazyahu son of Yehoram king of Judah went downto see Yoram son of Ah’av in Yizre’el,for he was sick [from his wounds].

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע הַנָּבִיא קָרָא לְאַחַד מִבְּנֵי הַנְּבִיאִים וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ חֲגֹר מָתְנֶיךָ וְקַח פַּךְ הַשֶּׁמֶן הַזֶּה בְּיָדֶךָ וְלֵךְ רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: Now Elisha the prophet called one of the Sons of the Prophetsand said to him:Gird up your loins,take this flask of oil in your hand,and go to Ramot-Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וּבָאתָ שָׁמָּה וּרְאֵה־שָׁם יֵהוּא בֶן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי וּבָאתָ וַהֲקֵמֹתוֹ מִתּוֹך אֶחָיו וְהֵבֵיאתָ אֹתוֹ חֶדֶר בְּחָדֶר׃
verses.english: When you come there, look there for Yehu son of Yehoshafat son of Nimshi;when you come, you are to take him up from the midst of his brothersand are to bring him into a room within a room.

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ פַךְ־הַשֶּׁמֶן וְיָצַקְתָּ עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאָמַרְתָּ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָתַחְתָּ הַדֶּלֶת וְנַסְתָּה וְלֹא תְחַכֶּה׃
verses.english: Then you are to take the flask of oil and you are to pour it on his headand say: Thus says YHWH:I am anointing you as king over Israel!Then you are to open the door and are to flee; you are not to wait.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַנַּעַר הַנַּעַר הַנָּבִיא רָמֹת גִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: So the lad, the prophet lad, went to Ramot-Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וְהִנֵּה שָׂרֵי הַחַיִל יֹשְׁבִים וַיֹּאמֶר דָּבָר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אֶל־מִי מִכֻּלָּנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיךָ הַשָּׂר׃
verses.english: He came there, and here, the commanders of the army were sitting around;he said:I have a message for you, O Commander!Yehu said:For whom of all of us?He said:For you, O Commander.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה וַיִּצֹק הַשֶּׁמֶן אֶל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־עַם יְהוָה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He arose and entered the house,then he poured the oil on his headand said to him:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:I anoint you as king over the people of YHWH, over Israel!

verses.hebrew: וְהִכִּיתָה אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְנִקַּמְתִּי דְּמֵי עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים וּדְמֵי כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה מִיַּד אִיזָבֶל׃
verses.english: You are to strike down the House of Ah’av, your lord,that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophetsand the blood of all the servants of YHWH at the hand of Izevel.

verses.hebrew: וְאָבַד כָּל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וְהִכְרַתִּי לְאַחְאָב מַשְׁתִּין בְּקִיר וְעָצוּר וְעָזוּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: All the House of Ah’av will perish;I will cut off from Ah’av he who pisses against the wall,[even] the fettered and forsaken in Israel!

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־בֵּית אַחְאָב כְּבֵית יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וּכְבֵית בַּעְשָׁא בֶן־אֲחִיָּה׃
