verses.english: And I will make the House of Ah’av like the House of Yorov’am son of Nevat,and like the House of Ba’sha son of Ahiyya.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אִיזֶבֶל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל וְאֵין קֹבֵר וַיִּפְתַּח הַדֶּלֶת וַיָּנֹס׃
verses.english: And Izevel the dogs will eat in the plot of Yizre’el,with no one to bury [her]!Then he opened the door and fled.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא יָצָא אֶל־עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הֲשָׁלוֹם מַדּוּעַ בָּא־הַמְשֻׁגָּע הַזֶּה אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם אַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־שִׂיחוֹ׃
verses.english: Now Yehu went out to the servants of his lord;they said to him:Is [all] well?For-what-reason did this madman come to you?He said to them:You know the man and his talk!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ שֶׁקֶר הַגֶּד־נָא לָנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר כָּזֹאת וְכָזֹאת אָמַר אֵלַי לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה מְשַׁחְתִּיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: They said:A lie!Now tell us!He said:Like this and like that he said to me, saying:Thus says YHWH:I anoint you as king over Israel!

verses.hebrew: וַיְמַהֲרוּ וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ בִּגְדוֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ תַחְתָּיו אֶל־גֶּרֶם הַמַּעֲלוֹת וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיֹּאמְרוּ מָלַךְ יֵהוּא׃
verses.english: Quickly each one took his garmentand put it under him, on the steps themselves;then they sounded a blast on the shofarand said:Yehu reigns as king!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקַשֵּׁר יֵהוּא בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָט בֶּן־נִמְשִׁי אֶל־יוֹרָם וְיוֹרָם הָיָה שֹׁמֵר בְּרָמֹת גִּלְעָד הוּא וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם׃
verses.english: So Yehu son of Yehoshafat son of Nimshi bound himself [in conspiracy] against Yoram—now Yoram had been protecting Ramot-Gil’ad, he and all Israel, from Hazael king of Aram.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹרָם הַמֶּלֶךְ לְהִתְרַפֵּא בִיְזְרְעֶאל מִן־הַמַּכִּים אֲשֶׁר יַכֻּהוּ אֲרַמִּים בְּהִלָּחֲמוֹ אֶת־חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא אִם־יֵשׁ נַפְשְׁכֶם אַל־יֵצֵא פָלִיט מִן־הָעִיר לָלֶכֶת לגיד [לְהַגִּיד] בְּיִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: But King Yehoram had returned to be healed at Yizre’el from the wounds with which the Arameans had wounded him,when he had engaged in battle with Hazael king of Aram.—Yehu said:If this be your desire,do not let any escaped-one out of the town, to go tell in Yizre’el!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב יֵהוּא וַיֵּלֶךְ יִזְרְעֶאלָה כִּי יוֹרָם שֹׁכֵב שָׁמָּה וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה יָרַד לִרְאוֹת אֶת־יוֹרָם׃
verses.english: And Yehu mounted up and went to Yizre’el,for Yoram was laid up there,while Ahazya king of Judah had gone down to see Yoram.

verses.hebrew: וְהַצֹּפֶה עֹמֵד עַל־הַמִּגְדָּל בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וַיַּרְא אֶת־שִׁפְעַת יֵהוּא בְּבֹאוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁפְעַת אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם קַח רַכָּב וּשְׁלַח לִקְרָאתָם וְיֹאמַר הֲשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Now the lookout was standing on the tower in Yezre’el;he saw Yehu’s horde as he was coming,and said:I see a horde!Yehoram said:Take a rider and send him to meet them, that he may say: Is [all] well?

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ רֹכֵב הַסּוּס לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הֲשָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא־הַמַּלְאָךְ עַד־הֵם וְלֹא־שָׁב׃
verses.english: The horse rider went to meet him and said:Thus says the king: Is [all] well?Yehu said:What is it to you if [all] is well?Turn in behind me!So the lookout reported, saying:The messenger coming to them does not return.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח רֹכֵב סוּס שֵׁנִי וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ שָׁלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא מַה־לְּךָ וּלְשָׁלוֹם סֹב אֶל־אַחֲרָי׃
verses.english: So he sent a second horse rider,and he came to them and said:Thus says the king: [Is all] well?Yehu said:What is it to you if [all] is well?Turn in behind me!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד הַצֹּפֶה לֵאמֹר בָּא עַד־אֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא־שָׁב וְהַמִּנְהָג כְּמִנְהַג יֵהוּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁי כִּי בְשִׁגָּעוֹן יִנְהָג׃
verses.english: So the lookout reported, saying:He came to them but does not return.Now his driving is like the driving of Yehu son of Nimshi—for he drives like-a-madman!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹרָם אֱסֹר וַיֶּאְסֹר רִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹרָם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אִישׁ בְּרִכְבּוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ לִקְרַאת יֵהוּא וַיִּמְצָאֻהוּ בְּחֶלְקַת נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי׃
verses.english: Then Yehoram said:Harness up!They harnessed his chariot,and Yehoram king of Israel went out, with Ahazyahu king of Judah, each one in his chariot;they went to meet Yehu,and they encountered him in the plot of Navot the Yizre’elite.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹת יְהוֹרָם אֶת־יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַשָּׁלוֹם עַד־זְנוּנֵי אִיזֶבֶל אִמְּךָ וּכְשָׁפֶיהָ הָרַבִּים׃
verses.english: And it was, when Yehoram saw Yehu,that he said:Is [all] well, Yehu?He said:What is “well,” as long as the many whorings of Izevel your mother and her sorceries [continue]?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְהוֹרָם יָדָיו וַיָּנֹס וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מִרְמָה אֲחַזְיָה׃
verses.english: Yehoram reversed his hands and fled,and said to Ahazyahu: Treason, Ahazya!

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא מִלֵּא יָדוֹ בַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּךְ אֶת־יְהוֹרָם בֵּין זְרֹעָיו וַיֵּצֵא הַחֵצִי מִלִּבּוֹ וַיִּכְרַע בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: But Yehu filled his hand with the bowand struck Yehoram between his shoulder-blades,so that the arrow stuck out of his heart,and he collapsed in his chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בִּדְקַר שלשה [שָׁלִשׁוֹ] שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּחֶלְקַת שְׂדֵה נָבוֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִי כִּי־זְכֹר אֲנִי וָאַתָּה אֵת רֹכְבִים צְמָדִים אַחֲרֵי אַחְאָב אָבִיו וַיהוָה נָשָׂא עָלָיו אֶת־הַמַּשָּׂא הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Then he said to Bidkar means “to pierce,” so this officer is perhaps the original Captain Pierce. his officer:Pick [him] up! Throw himinto the plot of field of Navot the Yizre’elite,for keep in mind—I and you were riding, each with a team, behind Ah’av his father,when YHWH pronounced this pronouncement upon him:

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא אֶת־דְּמֵי נָבוֹת וְאֶת־דְּמֵי בָנָיו רָאִיתִי אֶמֶשׁ נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְשִׁלַּמְתִּי לְךָ בַּחֶלְקָה הַזֹּאת נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְעַתָּה שָׂא הַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בַּחֶלְקָה כִּדְבַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Did I not see the blood of Navot and the blood of his sons yesterday?—the Utterance of YHWH;so I will pay you back in this very plot—the Utterance of YHWH.So-now, pick [him] up, throw him into the plot, in accordance with the word of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲחַזְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה רָאָה וַיָּנָס דֶּרֶךְ בֵּית הַגָּן וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרָיו יֵהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־אֹתוֹ הַכֻּהוּ אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה בְּמַעֲלֵה־גוּר אֲשֶׁר אֶת־יִבְלְעָם וַיָּנָס מְגִדּוֹ וַיָּמָת שָׁם׃
verses.english: Now when Ahazyahu king of Judah saw [it], he fled by the road to Bet-Ha-Gan,and Yehu pursued after him and said:Him too—strike him down!… in the chariot at the ascent of Gur, which is near Yivle’am.He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ עֲבָדָיו יְרוּשָׁלְָמָה וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִקְבֻרָתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃
verses.english: His servants drove him to Jerusalem,and they buried him in his burial-place, beside his fathers,in the City of David.

verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְיוֹרָם בֶּן־אַחְאָב מָלַךְ אֲחַזְיָה עַל־יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year eleven of the years of Yoram son of Ah’av, Ahazya became king over Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבוֹא יֵהוּא יִזְרְעֶאלָה וְאִיזֶבֶל שָׁמְעָה וַתָּשֶׂם בַּפּוּךְ עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּיטֶב אֶת־רֹאשָׁהּ וַתַּשְׁקֵף בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן׃
verses.english: And Yehu came to Yizre’el;when Izevel heard,she put kohl on her eyes and prettied her hairand looked out through the window.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא בָּא בַשָּׁעַר וַתֹּאמֶר הֲשָׁלוֹם זִמְרִי הֹרֵג אֲדֹנָיו׃
verses.english: When Yehu came to the gate, she said:Is [all] well, [you] Zimri, killer of his lord?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא פָנָיו אֶל־הַחַלּוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אִתִּי מִי וַיַּשְׁקִיפוּ אֵלָיו שְׁנַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה סָרִיסִים׃
verses.english: He lifted up his face toward the windowand said:Who is with me? Who?And two [or] three officials looked out at him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שמטהו [שִׁמְטוּהָ] וַיִּשְׁמְטוּהָ וַיִּז מִדָּמָהּ אֶל־הַקִּיר וְאֶל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּרְמְסֶנָּה׃
verses.english: He said:Hurl her down! And they hurled her down;some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall and on the horses,and he trampled her.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא וַיֹּאכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיֹּאמֶר פִּקְדוּ־נָא אֶת־הָאֲרוּרָה הַזֹּאת וְקִבְרוּהָ כִּי בַת־מֶלֶךְ הִיא׃
verses.english: Then he came in, and ate and drank,and he said:Take care of this doomed one, and bury her,for she is the daughter of a king.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ לְקָבְרָהּ וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ בָהּ כִּי אִם־הַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת וְהָרַגְלַיִם וְכַפּוֹת הַיָּדָיִם׃
verses.english: But when they went to bury her, they could not find [anything] of herexcept for the skull, the feet, and the palms of the hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיַּגִּידוּ לוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־יְהוָה הוּא אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּי לֵאמֹר בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל יֹאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־בְּשַׂר אִיזָבֶל׃
verses.english: They returned and told him,and he said:It is the word of YHWHthat he spoke by the hand of his servant Eliyyahu the Tishbite, saying:In the plot of Yizre’elthe dogs will eat the flesh of Izevel!

verses.hebrew: והית [וְהָיְתָה] נִבְלַת אִיזֶבֶל כְּדֹמֶן עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בְּחֵלֶק יִזְרְעֶאל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאמְרוּ זֹאת אִיזָבֶל׃
verses.english: And the corpse of Izevel will be like dung on the surface of the ground, in the plot of Yizre’el,so that they will not [be able to] say: This is Izevel!

verses.hebrew: וּלְאַחְאָב שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּכְתֹּב יֵהוּא סְפָרִים וַיִּשְׁלַח שֹׁמְרוֹן אֶל־שָׂרֵי יִזְרְעֶאל הַזְּקֵנִים וְאֶל־הָאֹמְנִים אַחְאָב לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now Ah’av had seventy sons in Shomeron.And Yehu wrote letters and sent [them] to Shomeron,to the commanders of Yizre’el, the elders,and to those raising Ah’av’s [sons], saying:

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה אֲלֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם בְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְאִתְּכֶם הָרֶכֶב וְהַסּוּסִים וְעִיר מִבְצָר וְהַנָּשֶׁק׃
verses.english: So-now, when this letter comes to you,—since with you are your lord’s sons,and since with you are the chariotry and the horses,and the fortified city and the weapons—

verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתֶם הַטּוֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר מִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּם עַל־כִּסֵּא אָבִיו וְהִלָּחֲמוּ עַל־בֵּית אֲדֹנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: select, usually translated here as “to see.” A notable example is Gen. 22:8, “God will see-for-himself to [or: select] the lamb for the offering-up.” the best and the brightest one of your lord’s sonsand put him on the throne of his father,and do battle for the house of your lords!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד וַיֹּאמְרוּ הִנֵּה שְׁנֵי הַמְּלָכִים לֹא עָמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵיךְ נַעֲמֹד אֲנָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: They became exceedingly afraid, exceedingly, and said:Here, two kings could not stand against him,so how will we stand, we ourselves?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעִיר וְהַזְּקֵנִים וְהָאֹמְנִים אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲנַחְנוּ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמַר אֵלֵינוּ נַעֲשֶׂה לֹא־נַמְלִיךְ אִישׁ הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עֲשֵׂה׃
verses.english: [The One] Over the House, and [The One] Over the City, and the elders, and the child-rearers, sent to Yehu, saying:We are your servants!Now whatever you say to us, we will do!We will not make anyone king;what is best in your eyes, do!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב אֲלֵיהֶם סֵפֶר שֵׁנִית לֵאמֹר אִם־לִי אַתֶּם וּלְקֹלִי אַתֶּם שֹׁמְעִים קְחוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁי אַנְשֵׁי בְנֵי־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם וּבֹאוּ אֵלַי כָּעֵת מָחָר יִזְרְעֶאלָה וּבְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ אֶת־גְּדֹלֵי הָעִיר מְגַדְּלִים אוֹתָם׃
verses.english: He wrote to them a second letter, saying:If you are for me,and to my voice you would hearken,then fetch the heads of the men, your lord’s sons,and bring them to me around this time tomorrow, to Yizre’el.Now the king’s sons, seventy men,were with the great-ones of the city, the ones rearing them.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּבֹא הַסֵּפֶר אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ וַיָּשִׂימוּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶם בַּדּוּדִים וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אֵלָיו יִזְרְעֶאלָה׃
verses.english: And it was, when the letter came to them,that they took the king’s sonsand slaughtered them, seventy men,and put their heads in baskets;then they sent them to him in Yizre’el.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמַּלְאָךְ וַיַּגֶּד־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הֵבִיאוּ רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר שִׂימוּ אֹתָם שְׁנֵי צִבֻּרִים פֶּתַח הַשַּׁעַר עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃
verses.english: A messenger came and told him, saying:They have brought the heads of the king’s sons!He said:Put them in two piles at the entrance to the city-gate until daybreak.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיֵּצֵא וַיַּעֲמֹד וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם צַדִּקִים אַתֶּם הִנֵּה אֲנִי קָשַׁרְתִּי עַל־אֲדֹנִי וָאֶהְרְגֵהוּ וּמִי הִכָּה אֶת־כָּל־אֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: Now it was at daybreak that he went out and stoodand said to all the people:You are innocent.—Here, I conspired against my master, and I killed him,but who struck down all of these?

verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ אֵפוֹא כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל מִדְּבַר יְהוָה אַרְצָה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה עַל־בֵּית אַחְאָב וַיהוָה עָשָׂה אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עַבְדּוֹ אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: Know, therefore,that no word of YHWH will fall to the groundthat YHWH promised concerning the House of Ah’av;YHWH has donewhat he promised through the hand of his servant Eliyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ יֵהוּא אֵת כָּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְבֵית־אַחְאָב בְּיִזְרְעֶאל וְכָל־גְּדֹלָיו וּמְיֻדָּעָיו וְכֹהֲנָיו עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד׃
verses.english: Then Yehu struck down all who remained of the House of Ah’av in Yizre’el,along with all his great-ones as go’alav, “blood-redeemers” or relatives. , his intimates, and his priests,until he had left him no survivor.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיָּבֹא וַיֵּלֶךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן הוּא בֵּית־עֵקֶד הָרֹעִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then he arose and came, that he might go to Shomeron.He was at a binding house for shepherds on the way,

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא מָצָא אֶת־אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר מִי אַתֶּם וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲחֵי אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲנַחְנוּ וַנֵּרֶד לִשְׁלוֹם בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבְנֵי הַגְּבִירָה׃
verses.english: when Yehu came upon brothers of Ahazyahu king of Judah.He said:Who are you?They said:We are brothers of Ahazyahu;we have come down [to see] the welfare of the sons of the king and the sons of the queen [mother].

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר תִּפְשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּם חַיִּים וַיִּשְׁחָטוּם אֶל־בּוֹר בֵּית־עֵקֶד אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אִישׁ וְלֹא־הִשְׁאִיר אִישׁ מֵהֶם׃
verses.english: He said:Seize them alive!They seized them aliveand slaughtered them at the cistern of the binding-house,forty-two men;he did not leave out one of them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־יְהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲיֵשׁ אֶת־לְבָבְךָ יָשָׁר כַּאֲשֶׁר לְבָבִי עִם־לְבָבֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹנָדָב יֵשׁ וָיֵשׁ תְּנָה אֶת־יָדֶךָ וַיִּתֵּן יָדוֹ וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ אֵלָיו אֶל־הַמֶּרְכָּבָה׃
verses.english: He went from there and came upon Yehonadav). son of Rekhav plays on the sounds of “bless” (b-r-k) and “chariot” (rekhev), significant in this chapter (Martin). Note that b and v are orthographically the same letter in Hebrew. [coming] to meet him;he blessed him [in greeting] and said to him:Is your heart straight-and-true, as my heart is with your heart?Yehonadav said:It is, yes, it is![He said]:Give me your hand!He gave him his hand, and he pulled him up to him in the chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְכָה אִתִּי וּרְאֵה בְּקִנְאָתִי לַיהוָה וַיַּרְכִּבוּ אֹתוֹ בְּרִכְבּוֹ׃
verses.english: He said:Go with me, and see my zeal for YHWH!And he had him ride in his chariot.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־כָּל־הַנִּשְׁאָרִים לְאַחְאָב בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עַד־הִשְׁמִידוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־אֵלִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: He came to Shomeronand struck down all who were left to Ah’av in Shomeron, until he had wiped it out,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had spoken to Eliyyahu.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יֵהוּא אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַחְאָב עָבַד אֶת־הַבַּעַל מְעָט יֵהוּא יַעַבְדֶנּוּ הַרְבֵּה׃
verses.english: Then Yehu collected all the peopleand said to them:Ah’av served Baal a little;Yehu will serve him much!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כָל־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל כָּל־עֹבְדָיו וְכָל־כֹּהֲנָיו קִרְאוּ אֵלַי אִישׁ אַל־יִפָּקֵד כִּי זֶבַח גָּדוֹל לִי לַבַּעַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יִפָּקֵד לֹא יִחְיֶה וְיֵהוּא עָשָׂה בְעָקְבָּה לְמַעַן הַאֲבִיד אֶת־עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל׃
verses.english: So-now, all the prophets of Baal, all those serving him and all his priests, call together to me—let no man be unaccounted for,for I have a great sacrifice for Baal;anyone who is unaccounted for shall not live!—Now Yehu was acting with cunning,in order to annihilate those serving Baal.—

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא קַדְּשׁוּ עֲצָרָה לַבַּעַל וַיִּקְרָאוּ׃
verses.english: Yehu said:Hallow an atzara-festival-festival: A term used in relation to a holy day, the eighth day of the pilgrimage festival of Sukkot (see Lev. 23:36). Its meaning is unclear; some propose “restraint” or “a solemn gathering” (JPS). for Baal!And they proclaimed it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יֵהוּא בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּבֹאוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל וְלֹא־נִשְׁאַר אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בָא וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיִּמָּלֵא בֵית־הַבַּעַל פֶּה לָפֶה׃
verses.english: And Yehu sent throughout all Israel,and all those serving Baal came—there was not left one who did not come;they came to the House of Baal, and filled the House of Baal from end to end.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמֶּלְתָּחָה הוֹצֵא לְבוּשׁ לְכֹל עֹבְדֵי הַבָּעַל וַיֹּצֵא לָהֶם הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ׃
verses.english: Then he said to [The One] Over the Wardrobe:Bring out apparel for all those serving Baal!and he brought them out apparel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יֵהוּא וִיהוֹנָדָב בֶּן־רֵכָב בֵּית הַבָּעַל וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל חַפְּשׂוּ וּרְאוּ פֶּן־יֶשׁ־פֹּה עִמָּכֶם מֵעַבְדֵי יְהוָה כִּי אִם־עֹבְדֵי הַבַּעַל לְבַדָּם׃
verses.english: And Yehu and Yehonadav son of Rekhav came into the House of Baal,and he said to those serving Baal:Search out and see, lest there be with you some of the servants of YHWH,rather than those serving Baal alone!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת זְבָחִים וְעֹלוֹת וְיֵהוּא שָׂם־לוֹ בַחוּץ שְׁמֹנִים אִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּלֵט מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־יְדֵיכֶם נַפְשׁוֹ תַּחַת נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: They came in to perform sacrifices and offerings-up;meanwhile, Yehu had placed eighty men for himself outsideand had said:The man who lets [anyone] escape from the men whom I am bringing into your hand—his life in place of his life!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָעֹלָה וַיֹּאמֶר יֵהוּא לָרָצִים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁים בֹּאוּ הַכּוּם אִישׁ אַל־יֵצֵא וַיַּכּוּם לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ הָרָצִים וְהַשָּׁלִשִׁים וַיֵּלְכוּ עַד־עִיר בֵּית־הַבָּעַל׃
verses.english: So it was, when he was finished performing the offering-up,that Yehu said to the outrunners and to the officers:Come in, strike them down! Let no one get away!So they struck them down with the mouth of the sword,and the outrunners and the officers [left them] thrown [there],and went on to the rear-chamber, “city,” to devir here, signifying the interior of the temple of Baal. of the House of Baal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצִאוּ אֶת־מַצְּבוֹת בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּשְׂרְפוּהָ׃
verses.english: They took out the standing-pillar of the House of Baal,and then they burned it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּצוּ אֵת מַצְּבַת הַבָּעַל וַיִּתְּצוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבַּעַל וַיְשִׂמֻהוּ למחראות [לְמוֹצָאוֹת] עַד־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: And they demolished the standing-pillar of Baal,and they demolished the House of Baaland made it into a latrine, until today

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמֵד יֵהוּא אֶת־הַבַּעַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Thus Yehu wiped out Baal from Israel.

verses.hebrew: רַק חֲטָאֵי יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר יֵהוּא מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶם עֶגְלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־אֵל וַאֲשֶׁר בְּדָן׃
verses.english: —However, as for the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, which he had caused Israel to sin,Yehu did not turn aside from [following] after them,the golden calves that were at Bet-El, and that were at Dan.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־יֵהוּא יַעַן אֲשֶׁר־הֱטִיבֹתָ לַעֲשׂוֹת הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינַי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר בִּלְבָבִי עָשִׂיתָ לְבֵית אַחְאָב בְּנֵי רְבִעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Yehu:Because you have acted well, doing what is right in my eyes,—according to all that was in my heart, you have done to the House of Ah’av—sons of four [generations] from you shall sit on the throne of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵהוּא לֹא שָׁמַר לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרַת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־לְבָבוֹ לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Yet Yehu did not take care to walk according to the Instruction of YHWH, the God of Israel, with all his heart;he did not turn aside from the sins of Yorov’am, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהוָה לְקַצּוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכֵּם חֲזָאֵל בְּכָל־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: In those days, YHWH began to truncate Israel:Hazael struck them throughout the entire territory of Israel,

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֵת כָּל־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד הַגָּדִי וְהָרֻאובֵנִי וְהַמְנַשִּׁי מֵעֲרֹעֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־נַחַל אַרְנֹן וְהַגִּלְעָד וְהַבָּשָׁן׃
verses.english: from the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,all the land of Gil’ad: the Gadite, the Re’uvenite, and the Menashite,from Aro’er which is by Wadi Arnon, including the Gil’ad and the Bashan.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֵהוּא וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְכָל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yehu, and all that he did, and all his mighty-deeds—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יֵהוּא עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yehu lay beside his fathers;they buried him in Shomeron,and Yehoahaz his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה־שָׁנָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Now the days that Yehu had reigned as king over Israelwere twenty-eight years in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲתַלְיָה אֵם אֲחַזְיָהוּ וראתה [רָאֲתָה] כִּי מֵת בְּנָהּ וַתָּקָם וַתְּאַבֵּד אֵת כָּל־זֶרַע הַמַּמְלָכָה׃
verses.english: Now when Atalya, Ahazyahu’s mother, saw that her son was dead,she set out to annihilate all the seed of the kingdom.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח יְהוֹשֶׁבַע בַּת־הַמֶּלֶךְ־יוֹרָם אֲחוֹת אֲחַזְיָהוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָה וַתִּגְנֹב אֹתוֹ מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ הממותתים [הַמּוּמָתִים] אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־מֵינִקְתּוֹ בַּחֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת וַיַּסְתִּרוּ אֹתוֹ מִפְּנֵי עֲתַלְיָהוּ וְלֹא הוּמָת׃
verses.english: But Yehosheva daughter of King Yoram, sister of Ahazyahu, took Yoash son of Ahazyaand stole him from the midst of the king’s sons who were being put to death—him and his nurse—in the bedchamber,and they hid him from Atalyahu, so that he was not put to death.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִתָּהּ בֵּית יְהוָה מִתְחַבֵּא שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַעֲתַלְיָה מֹלֶכֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And he was with her in the House of YHWH, in hiding, for six years,while Atalyahu was reigning over the land.

verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַח יְהוֹיָדָע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי המאיות [הַמֵּאוֹת] לַכָּרִי וְלָרָצִים וַיָּבֵא אֹתָם אֵלָיו בֵּית יְהוָה וַיִּכְרֹת לָהֶם בְּרִית וַיַּשְׁבַּע אֹתָם בְּבֵית יְהוָה וַיַּרְא אֹתָם אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: But in the seventh year, Yehoyada sent and took the commanders of hundreds of the Carites, and of the outrunners,and brought them to him in the House of YHWH;he cut them a covenant and had them swear [fealty] in the House of YHWH,and showed them the king’s son.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּן הַשְּׁלִשִׁית מִכֶּם בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And he charged them, saying:This is the thing that you are to do:a third of you coming [on your watch] for the Sabbath,those who guard the guarding of the king’s house,

verses.hebrew: וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בְּשַׁעַר סוּר וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית בַּשַּׁעַר אַחַר הָרָצִים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מַסָּח׃
verses.english: and a third at the Sur Gate,and a third at the gate behind the Outrunners’ [Gate]—you are to guard the guarding of the House. , which I (and others) have omitted here.…

verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי הַיָּדוֹת בָּכֶם כֹּל יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בֵּית־יְהוָה אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: The [other] two units among you,all those going off-duty for the Sabbath,are to guard the guarding of YHWH’s house, over the king.

verses.hebrew: וְהִקַּפְתֶּם עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַשְּׂדֵרוֹת יוּמָת וִהְיוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּצֵאתוֹ וּבְבֹאוֹ׃
verses.english: You are to encircle the king, all around, each one with his weapons in his hand,so that whoever comes through to the rows is to be put to death.And be with the king in his going out and in his coming in!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ שָׂרֵי המאיות [הַמֵּאוֹת] כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְחוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו בָּאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת עִם יֹצְאֵי הַשַּׁבָּת וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: So the commanders of hundreds did exactly as Yehoyada the priest had charged:they took, each one, his fighting-men,those coming on duty on the Sabbath and those going off-duty on the Sabbath,and came to Yehoyada the priest.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן לְשָׂרֵי המאיות [הַמֵּאוֹת] אֶת־הַחֲנִית וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָטִים אֲשֶׁר לַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And the priest gave to the commanders of hundreds the spear-arsenal and the bow cases that had belonged to King Davidthat were in the House of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ הָרָצִים אִישׁ וְכֵלָיו בְּיָדוֹ מִכֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַיְמָנִית עַד־כֶּתֶף הַבַּיִת הַשְּׂמָאלִית לַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְלַבָּיִת עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ סָבִיב׃
verses.english: and the outrunners took a stand, each one with his weapons in his hand,from the right shoulder of the House to the left shoulder, at the sacrificial-altar and at the House, all around the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא אֶת־בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת־הַנֵּזֶר וְאֶת־הָעֵדוּת וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ וַיִּמְשָׁחֻהוּ וַיַּכּוּ־כָף וַיֹּאמְרוּ יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then he brought out the king’s sonand placed on him the diadem and the insignia;they made him king—they anointed him,and they struck their hands together and said:May the king live!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁמַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־קוֹל הָרָצִין הָעָם וַתָּבֹא אֶל־הָעָם בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Atalya heard the sound of the outrunners [and] of the fighting-people,so she came to the People in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא וְהִנֵּה הַמֶּלֶךְ עֹמֵד עַל־הָעַמּוּד כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהַשָּׂרִים וְהַחֲצֹצְרוֹת אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכָל־עַם הָאָרֶץ שָׂמֵחַ וְתֹקֵעַ בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וַתִּקְרַע עֲתַלְיָה אֶת־בְּגָדֶיהָ וַתִּקְרָא קֶשֶׁר קָשֶׁר׃
verses.english: And she saw: here, the king was standing by the standing-column, as was the custom,with the commanders and their trumpets by the king,and all the Landed People is found frequently in this literature, perhaps indicating landholders, or what we might call citizens. Their function in Kings seems to include choosing the king in unstable circumstances such as a coup. In later centuries the phrase came to signify the “salt of the earth,” the working poor, and eventually, the ignorant. were rejoicing and sounding a blast on the trumpets.Then Atalyahu tore her garments and called out, with the first word ending with ayin and the second with alef, so an analogy (but not a repetition) of sound is meant to catch the ear (Cohn 2000).: Conspiracy! Conspiracy!

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־שָׂרֵי המיאות [הַמֵּאוֹת ] פְּקֻדֵי הַחַיִל וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם הוֹצִיאוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַשְּׂדֵרֹת וְהַבָּא אַחֲרֶיהָ הָמֵת בֶּחָרֶב כִּי אָמַר הַכֹּהֵן אַל־תּוּמַת בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Yehoyada the priest charged the commanders of hundreds, those accountable for the army,and said to them:Bring her out within the rows,and anyone who comes after her, put to death with the sword!For the priest said [to himself]:Let her not be put to death in the House of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂמוּ לָהּ יָדַיִם וַתָּבוֹא דֶּרֶךְ־מְבוֹא הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַתּוּמַת שָׁם׃
verses.english: So they laid hands on herand she came in by way of the Horses’ Entrance to the House of YHWH,and was put to death there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוֹיָדָע אֶת־הַבְּרִית בֵּין יְהוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם לִהְיוֹת לְעָם לַיהוָה וּבֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ וּבֵין הָעָם׃
verses.english: Then Yehoyada cut a covenant between YHWH and the king and the people,to be YHWH’s people,and [one] between the king and the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ כָל־עַם הָאָרֶץ בֵּית־הַבַּעַל וַיִּתְּצֻהוּ אֶת־מזבחתו [מִזְבְּחֹתָיו] וְאֶת־צְלָמָיו שִׁבְּרוּ הֵיטֵב וְאֵת מַתָּן כֹּהֵן הַבַּעַל הָרְגוּ לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדּוֹת עַל־בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And all the Landed People came to the House of Baal and demolished it:its sacrificial-altars and its images they smashed to bits,and Mattan, the priest of Baal, they killed in front of the altars.Then the priest set accountable men over the House of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת וְאֶת־הַכָּרִי וְאֶת־הָרָצִים וְאֵת כָּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וַיֹּרִידוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבֵּית יְהוָה וַיָּבוֹאוּ דֶּרֶך־שַׁעַר הָרָצִים בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים׃
verses.english: and he took the commanders of hundreds and the Carites and the outrunners and all the Landed People,and they brought the king down from the House of YHWH;they entered by way of the Outrunners’ Gate, into the House of the King,and he took his seat on the kings’ throne.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמַח כָּל־עַם־הָאָרֶץ וְהָעִיר שָׁקָטָה וְאֶת־עֲתַלְיָהוּ הֵמִיתוּ בַחֶרֶב בֵּית מלך [הַמֶּלֶךְ׃]
verses.english: And all the Landed People rejoiced, and the city was quiet,while Atalyahu they put to death with the sword in the House of the King.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים יְהוֹאָשׁ בְּמָלְכוֹ׃
verses.english: Seven years old was Yehoash when he became king.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְיֵהוּא מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ צִבְיָה מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׃
verses.english: In year seven of Yehu, Yehoash became king,and for forty years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Tzivya, from Be’er-Sheva.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כָּל־יָמָיו אֲשֶׁר הוֹרָהוּ יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: And Yehoash did what was right in the eyes of YHWH, all his days,as Yehoyada the priest had instructed him.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃
verses.english: However, the sanctuaries were not removed;the people were still offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke at the sanctuaries.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוֹאָשׁ אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יוּבָא בֵית־יְהוָה כֶּסֶף עוֹבֵר אִישׁ כֶּסֶף נַפְשׁוֹת עֶרְכּוֹ כָּל־כֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶה עַל לֶב־אִישׁ לְהָבִיא בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Yehoash said to the priests:All the silver for holy-purposes that is brought to the House of YHWH,silver of one’s counting [in the census],—silver of the valuation of persons,[or] any silver that goes up in a man’s heart to bring to the House of YHWH—

verses.hebrew: יִקְחוּ לָהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים אִישׁ מֵאֵת מַכָּרוֹ וְהֵם יְחַזְּקוּ אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבַּיִת לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵא שָׁם בָּדֶק׃
verses.english: let the priests take it for themselves, each one from his acquaintance,and they themselves shall strengthen the breaches in the House,wherever a breach is found there.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לֹא־חִזְּקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: But it was in year twenty-three, that year of King Yehoash:the priests had not strengthened the breaches in the House.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ לִיהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן וְלַכֹּהֲנִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם מַדּוּעַ אֵינְכֶם מְחַזְּקִים אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּקְחוּ־כֶסֶף מֵאֵת מַכָּרֵיכֶם כִּי־לְבֶדֶק הַבַּיִת תִּתְּנֻהוּ׃
verses.english: So King Yehoash called for Yehoyada the priest and for the [other] priestsand said to them:Why are you not strengthening the breaches in the House?Now,do not keep silver from your acquaintances,but rather for the breaches in the House you are to give it over.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאֹתוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים לְבִלְתִּי קְחַת־כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת הָעָם וּלְבִלְתִּי חַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: The priests agreed not to take silver from the people,and not to strengthen the breaches in the House.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹיָדָע הַכֹּהֵן אֲרוֹן אֶחָד וַיִּקֹּב חֹר בְּדַלְתּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בימין [מִיָּמִין] בְּבוֹא־אִישׁ בֵּית יְהוָה וְנָתְנוּ־שָׁמָּה הַכֹּהֲנִים שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then Yehoyada the priest took a cofferand bored a hole in its lid,and gave it near the sacrificial-altar,on the right as one entered the House of YHWH;the priests, the guardians of the threshold, would give thereall the silver that was brought to the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם כִּי־רַב הַכֶּסֶף בָּאָרוֹן וַיַּעַל סֹפֵר הַמֶּלֶךְ וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וַיָּצֻרוּ וַיִּמְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So it was, whenever they saw that there was much silver in the coffer,that the king’s scribe and the Great Priest would go up,they would tie up and count the silver that was found in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמְתֻכָּן עַל־יד [יְדֵי] עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה הפקדים [הַמֻּפְקָדִים] בֵּית יְהוָה וַיּוֹצִיאֻהוּ לְחָרָשֵׁי הָעֵץ וְלַבֹּנִים הָעֹשִׂים בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then they would give the silver that was measured out into the hands of those doing the work, those accountable in the House of YHWH,and they would pay it out to the carvers of wood and to the builders who were doing [tasks] in the House of YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וְלַגֹּדְרִים וּלְחֹצְבֵי הָאֶבֶן וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־בֶּדֶק בֵּית־יְהוָה וּלְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא עַל־הַבַּיִת לְחָזְקָה׃
verses.english: and to the wall-builders and to the stone-cutters,for purchasing wood and quarried stonesto strenghen the breaches in the House of YHWH,and for everything [else] that was paid out for the House, to strengthen it.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה בֵּית יְהוָה סִפּוֹת כֶּסֶף מְזַמְּרוֹת מִזְרָקוֹת חֲצֹצְרוֹת כָּל־כְּלִי זָהָב וּכְלִי־כָסֶף מִן־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: But there would not be made for the House of YHWHsilver basins, snuffers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets,any kind of vessels of gold or vessels of silver,from the silver that was brought to the House of YHWH;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה יִתְּנֻהוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־בוֹ אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: rather, to those doing the work they would give it,so that with it they would strengthen the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַשְּׁבוּ אֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנוּ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יָדָם לָתֵת לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה כִּי בֶאֱמֻנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃
verses.english: And they did not have to reckon [exactly] with the men into whose hand they gave the silver,to give [payment] to those doing the work,for in trustworthy-fashion they dealt.

verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף אָשָׁם וְכֶסֶף חַטָּאוֹת לֹא יוּבָא בֵּית יְהוָה לַכֹּהֲנִים יִהְיוּ׃
verses.english: Silver from asham-offerings-offerings: Sacrifices designed to make reparations for sin (sometimes with the meaning of “penalty”); see Lev. 5. and silver from hattat-offerings-offerings: These were decontamination or purification sacrifices, intended to effect atonement for sin. A major feature was the sprinkling of the slaughtered animal’s blood by the priest (see Lev. 4). was not brought into the House of YHWH;it was for the priests.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־גַּת וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ וַיָּשֶׂם חֲזָאֵל פָּנָיו לַעֲלוֹת עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Then Hazael king of Aram went up and waged battle against Gat, and took it,and [afterward] Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֵת כָּל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־הִקְדִּישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָט וִיהוֹרָם וַאֲחַזְיָהוּ אֲבֹתָיו מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו וְאֵת כָּל־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בְּאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיַּעַל מֵעַל יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: So Yehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Yehoshafat, Yehoram, and Ahazyahu, his fathers, the kings of Judah, had hallowed,and his own hallowed things,and all the gold that was found in the treasuries of the House of YHWH and in the House of the king,and sent [them] to Hazael king of Aram,so that he went up away from Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yoash, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ עֲבָדָיו וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ־קָשֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־יוֹאָשׁ בֵּית מִלֹּא הַיּוֹרֵד סִלָּא׃
verses.english: His servants arose and conspired a conspiracy;they struck Yoash down at Bet-Millo, which leads down to Silla.

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שִׁמְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָד בֶּן־שֹׁמֵר עֲבָדָיו הִכֻּהוּ וַיָּמֹת וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֲמַצְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Now it was Yozakhar son of Shim’at and Yehozavad son of Shomer his servants who struck him down, so that he died;they buried him beside his fathers, in the City of David,and Amatzya his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: In year twenty-seven of the years of Yoash son of Ahazyahu king of Judah,Yehoahaz it means “YHWH Has Grasped.” Trad. English “Jehoahaz.” son of Yehu became king in Shomeron,for seventeen years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ אַחַר חַטֹּאת יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־סָר מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he walked after the sin of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin;he did not turn aside from it.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּבְיַד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל כָּל־הַיָּמִים׃
verses.english: So YHWH’s anger flared up against Israel,and he gave them into the hand of Hazael king of Aramand into the hand of Ben-Hadad son of Hazael, for all the days.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַל יְהוֹאָחָז אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו יְהוָה כִּי רָאָה אֶת־לַחַץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־לָחַץ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם׃
verses.english: But Yehoahaz soothed the face of YHWH,and YHWH hearkened to him,for he saw the oppression of Israel,for the king of Aram had oppressed them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעַ וַיֵּצְאוּ מִתַּחַת יַד־אֲרָם וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם כִּתְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃
verses.english: So YHWH granted Israel a deliverer, so that they came out from under the hand of Aram,and the Children of Israel could sit in their tents, as yesterday [and] the day-before.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־סָרוּ מֵחַטֹּאות בֵּית־יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר־החטי [הֶחֱטִיא] אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ וְגַם הָאֲשֵׁרָה עָמְדָה בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: However, they did not turn aside from the sins of the House of Yorov’am, who had caused Israel to sin—in them they walked;even an Ashera-pole stood in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הִשְׁאִיר לִיהוֹאָחָז עָם כִּי אִם־חֲמִשִּׁים פָּרָשִׁים וַעֲשָׂרָה רֶכֶב וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים רַגְלִי כִּי אִבְּדָם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַיְשִׂמֵם כֶּעָפָר לָדֻשׁ׃
verses.english: For no fighting-people were left to Yehoahazexcept for fifty riders, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot-soldiers,for the king of Aram had annihilated them;he had made them like dust for trampling.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָחָז וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yehoahaz, and all that he did, and all his mighty-deeds—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹאָשׁ בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yehoahaz lay beside his fathers;they buried him in Shomeron,and Yoash his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: In year thirty-seven of the years of Yoash king of Judah,Yehoash son of Yehoahaz became king of Israel in Shomeron,for sixteen years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לֹא סָר מִכָּל־חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהּ הָלָךְ׃
verses.english: And he did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from all the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin;in them he walked.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹאָשׁ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yoash, and all that he did, and his mighty-deeds when he did battle with Amatzya king of Judah—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וְיָרָבְעָם יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסְאוֹ וַיִּקָּבֵר יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Yoash lay beside his fathers,and Yorov’am sat on his throne,and Yoash was buried in Shomeron, beside the kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חָלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ וַיֵּרֶד אֵלָיו יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּבְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו וַיֹּאמַר אָבִי אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו׃
verses.english: Now Elisha fell sick with the sickness from which he was to die.Yoash king of Israel went down to himand wept upon his face, he said:Father! Father! Israel’s chariotry and its horsemen!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלִישָׁע קַח קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים וַיִּקַּח אֵלָיו קֶשֶׁת וְחִצִּים׃
verses.english: Elisha said to him:Take a bow and some arrows.So he took him a bow and some arrows.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַרְכֵּב יָדְךָ עַל־הַקֶּשֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּב יָדוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם אֱלִישָׁע יָדָיו עַל־יְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: He said to the king of Israel:Have your hand mount the bow.He had his hand mount it.Then Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פְּתַח הַחַלּוֹן קֵדְמָה וַיִּפְתָּח וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלִישָׁע יְרֵה וַיּוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר חֵץ־תְּשׁוּעָה לַיהוָה וְחֵץ תְּשׁוּעָה בַאֲרָם וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם בַּאֲפֵק עַד־כַּלֵּה׃
verses.english: and said:Open the east-facing window.And he opened it.Then Elisha said:Shoot.And he shot.He said:An arrow of victory for YHWH, and an arrow of victory over Aram;you will strike down Aram at Afek, until [they are] finished off!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קַח הַחִצִּים וַיִּקָּח וַיֹּאמֶר לְמֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַךְ־אַרְצָה וַיַּךְ שָׁלֹשׁ־פְּעָמִים וַיַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: And he said:Take the arrows.So he took them.Then he said to the king of Israel:Strike the ground.So he struck three times, and then stopped.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף עָלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַכּוֹת חָמֵשׁ אוֹ־שֵׁשׁ פְּעָמִים אָז הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲרָם עַד־כַּלֵּה וְעַתָּה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים תַּכֶּה אֶת־אֲרָם׃
verses.english: The man of God became furious with him and said:Striking five or six times—then you would have struck down Aram until [they would have been] finished off!But nowyou will strike Aram [only] three times.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אֱלִישָׁע וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ וּגְדוּדֵי מוֹאָב יָבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ בָּא שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Elisha died, and they buried him.Now raiding-bands from Moav would come into the land at the coming of the year to b-vo’..

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הֵם קֹבְרִים אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה רָאוּ אֶת־הַגְּדוּד וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ בְּקֶבֶר אֱלִישָׁע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּגַּע הָאִישׁ בְּעַצְמוֹת אֱלִישָׁע וַיְחִי וַיָּקָם עַל־רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: And [once] it was, they were burying a man,and here, they saw such a band,so they threw the man into the burial-place of Elisha and went off.And [when] the man touched the bones of Elisha, he lived [again],and he arose and stood on his feet.

verses.hebrew: וַחֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם לָחַץ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹאָחָז׃
verses.english: Now Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel all the days of Yehoahaz.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחָן יְהוָה אֹתָם וַיְרַחֲמֵם וַיִּפֶן אֲלֵיהֶם לְמַעַן בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא אָבָה הַשְׁחִיתָם וְלֹא־הִשְׁלִיכָם מֵעַל־פָּנָיו עַד־עָתָּה׃
verses.english: But YHWH was gracious to themand had compassion on themand turned his face toward themfor the sake of his covenant with Avraham, Yitzhak, and Yaakov;he was not willing to bring them to ruinand has not cast them out from his presence until now.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת חֲזָאֵל מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּן־הֲדַד בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Hazael king of Aram died,and Ben-Hadad his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הֶעָרִים מִיַּד בֶּן־הֲדַד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵל אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִיַּד יְהוֹאָחָז אָבִיו בַּמִּלְחָמָה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הִכָּהוּ יוֹאָשׁ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־עָרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And Yehoash son of Yehoahaz once again took the towns from the hand of Ben-Hadad son of Hazaelwhich he had taken from the hand of Yehoahaz his father, in battle:three times Yehoash struck them,and recovered the towns of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְיוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year two of Yoash son of Yehoahaz king of Israel,Amatzyahu son of Yoash became king of Judah.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יהועדין [יְהוֹעַדָּן] מִן־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Twenty-five years old was he on his becoming king,and for twenty-nine years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Yehoaddan, from Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה רַק לֹא כְּדָוִד אָבִיו כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: He did what was right in the eyes of YHWH—however, not like David his father;exactly as Yoash his father had done, he did.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃
verses.english: However, the sanctuaries were not removed;the people still were offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke at the sanctuaries.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר חָזְקָה הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־עֲבָדָיו הַמַּכִּים אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָבִיו׃
verses.english: Now it waswhen the kingdom was strong in his hand,that he struck down [those of] his servants who had struck down the king his father.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנֵי הַמַּכִּים לֹא הֵמִית כַּכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרַת־מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה לֵאמֹר לֹא־יוּמְתוּ אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים וּבָנִים לֹא־יוּמְתוּ עַל־אָבוֹת כִּי אִם־אִישׁ בְּחֶטְאוֹ ימות [יוּמָת׃]
verses.english: But the sons of those who had struck [him] down he did not put to death,as is written in the Record of the Instruction of Moshe. The reference is probably to the core of the book of Deuteronomy, either in its reality or in the perspective of a later redactor of Kings. which YHWH commanded, saying:Fathers are not to be put to death for sons, and sons are not to be put to death for fathers;rather, each for his own sin is to be put to death!

verses.hebrew: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא־המלח [מֶלַח] עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים וְתָפַשׂ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמָהּ יָקְתְאֵל עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: It was he who struck down Edom in the Valley of Salt, ten thousand,and took the Boulder in battle;he called its name Yokte’el, until this day.

verses.hebrew: אָז שָׁלַח אֲמַצְיָה מַלְאָכִים אֶל־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֵהוּא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר לְכָה נִתְרָאֶה פָנִים׃
verses.english: Then Amatzya sent messengers to Yehoash son of Yehoahaz son of Yehu king of Israel, saying:Come, let us see each other’s face [in battle]!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר הַחוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן שָׁלַח אֶל־הָאֶרֶז אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן לֵאמֹר תְּנָה־אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לִבְנִי לְאִשָּׁה וַתַּעֲבֹר חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בַּלְּבָנוֹן וַתִּרְמֹס אֶת־הַחוֹחַ׃
verses.english: Yehoash king of Israel sent [word] to Amatzyahu king of Judah, saying:The briar that is in the Levanon sent [word] to the cedar that is in the Levanon, saying:Give your daughter to my son as a wife!But a beast of the open-field that is in the Levanon crossed by and trampled the briar.

verses.hebrew: הַכֵּה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֱדוֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ לִבֶּךָ הִכָּבֵד וְשֵׁב בְּבֵיתֶךָ וְלָמָּה תִתְגָּרֶה בְּרָעָה וְנָפַלְתָּה אַתָּה וִיהוּדָה עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: You struck, yes, struck down Edom,but your heart lifts you up [in arrogance]!Keep your glory and stay at home!Why should you stir up evil for yourselfand fall, you and Judah with you?

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֲמַצְיָהוּ וַיַּעַל יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְרָאוּ פָנִים הוּא וַאֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בְּבֵית שֶׁמֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לִיהוּדָה׃
verses.english: But Amatzyahu would not hearken,so Yehoash king of Israel went up, and they saw one another’s faces [in battle], he and Amatzyahu king of Judah,at Bet-Shemesh that belongs to Judah.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּנָּגֶף יְהוּדָה לִפְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּנֻסוּ אִישׁ לאהלו [לְאֹהָלָיו׃]
verses.english: And Judah was defeated before Israel,and they fled, each to his tent.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בֶּן־יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָהוּ תָּפַשׂ יְהוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּבֵית שָׁמֶשׁ ויבאו [וַיָּבֹא] יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּפְרֹץ בְּחוֹמַת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בְּשַׁעַר אֶפְרַיִם עַד־שַׁעַר הַפִּנָּה אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אַמָּה׃
verses.english: And Amatzyahu king of Judah, son of Yehoash son of Ahazyahu, Yehoash king of Israel seized at Bet-Shemesh;then he came to Jerusalem and breached the wall of Jerusalem,from the Efrayim Gate to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits,

verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת־כָּל־הַזָּהָב־וְהַכֶּסֶף וְאֵת כָּל־הַכֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִים בֵּית־יְהוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת בְּנֵי הַתַּעֲרֻבוֹת וַיָּשָׁב שֹׁמְרוֹנָה׃
verses.english: and he took all the gold and the silver and all the vessels that were found in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the king’s house, along with hostages.Then he returned to Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹאָשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר נִלְחַם עִם אֲמַצְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yehoash, [and] what he did, and his mighty-deeds, and how he engaged in battle with Amatzyahu king of Judah—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹאָשׁ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ יָרָבְעָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yehoash lay beside his fathers;he was buried at Shomeron, beside the kings of Israel,and Yorov’am his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיְחִי אֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹאָשׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: And Amatzyahu son of Yehoash king of Judah lived after the death of Yehoash king of Israel for fifteen years.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אֲמַצְיָהוּ הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Amatzyahu—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עָלָיו קֶשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וַיָּנָס לָכִישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ אַחֲרָיו לָכִישָׁה וַיְמִתֻהוּ שָׁם׃
verses.english: They conspired a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lakhish;they sent [men] after him to Lakhish, and they put him to death there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־הַסּוּסִים וַיִּקָּבֵר בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד׃
verses.english: Then they carried him back on horses,and he was buried in Jerusalem, beside his fathers, in the City of David.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ כָּל־עַם יְהוּדָה אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וְהוּא בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיַּמְלִכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו אֲמַצְיָהוּ׃
verses.english: And all the people of Judah took Azarya—he was sixteen years old—and made him king in place of his father Amatzyahu.

verses.hebrew: הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אֵילַת וַיְשִׁבֶהָ לִיהוּדָה אַחֲרֵי שְׁכַב־הַמֶּלֶךְ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו׃
verses.english: It was he who rebuilt Elat. The Etzyon-Gever of I Kings 9:26 and 22:49, and II Kings 16:6, and today a popular resort city on the Gulf of Aqaba. and restored it to Judah,after the king lay beside his fathers.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמֵשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַאֲמַצְיָהוּ בֶן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: In year fifteen of the years of Amatzyahu son of Yehoash king of Judah,Yorov’am son of Yoash became king over Israel at Shomeron,for forty-one years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לֹא סָר מִכָּל־חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from all the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: הוּא הֵשִׁיב אֶת־גְּבוּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִלְּבוֹא חֲמָת עַד־יָם הָעֲרָבָה כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד־עַבְדּוֹ יוֹנָה בֶן־אֲמִתַּי הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר מִגַּת הַחֵפֶר׃
verses.english: It was he who restored the border of Israelfrom Levo-Hamat to the Sea of the Plain,in accordance with the word of YHWH the God of Israelwhich he had spoken by the hand of his servant Yona son of Amittai the prophet, who was from Gat Ha-Heyfer,

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָאָה יְהוָה אֶת־עֳנִי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֹרֶה מְאֹד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְאֶפֶס עָזוּב וְאֵין עֹזֵר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: for YHWH saw the affliction of Israel, exceedingly bitter [as it was],with none but the fettered, none but the forsaken—and no one to help Israel.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־דִבֶּר יְהוָה לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּיַד יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ׃
verses.english: But YHWH had not resolved to wipe out the name of Israel from under the heavens,so he delivered them by the hand of Yorov’am son of Yoash.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יָרָבְעָם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וּגְבוּרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחָם וַאֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁיב אֶת־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וְאֶת־חֲמָת לִיהוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yorov’am and all that he did, his mighty-deeds when he waged battle,how he recovered Damascus and Hamat for Israel—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יָרָבְעָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו עִם מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְלֹךְ זְכַרְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yorov’am lay beside his fathers, beside the kings of Israel,and Zekharyahu his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְיָרָבְעָם מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ עֲזַרְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year twenty-seven of the years of Yorov’am king of Israel,Azarya son of Amatzya king of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְכָלְיָהוּ מִירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Sixteen years old was he at his becoming king,and for fifty-two years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Yekholyahu, from Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אֲמַצְיָהוּ אָבִיו׃
verses.english: He did what was right in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as Amatzya his father had done.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא־סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת׃
verses.english: However, the sanctuaries were not removed;the people were still offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke at the sanctuaries.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַגַּע יְהוָה אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְהִי מְצֹרָע עַד־יוֹם מֹתוֹ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית הַחָפְשִׁית וְיוֹתָם בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַבַּיִת שֹׁפֵט אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And YHWH afflicted the king, so that he had tzaraat until the day of his death;he had to stay in the Separate House, which was thought to convey serious ritual impurity (see Lev. 13–14). ,while Yotam trad. English “Jotham,” with the meaning “YHWH Is Perfect.” See Judg. 9:5–21 for a more famous bearer of the name. the king’s son was [The One] Over the House,leading the Landed People.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי עֲזַרְיָהוּ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Azaryahu, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of theKings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב עֲזַרְיָה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ יוֹתָם בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Azarya lay beside his fathers;they buried him beside his fathers, in the City of David,and Yotam his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ זְכַרְיָהוּ בֶן־יָרָבְעָם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים׃
verses.english: In year thirty-eight of the years of Azaryahu king of Judah,Zekharyahu son of Yorov’am became king over Israel in Shomeron, for six months.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH, as his fathers had done:he did not turn aside from the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־יָבֵשׁ וַיַּכֵּהוּ קָבָלְ־עָם וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: And Shallum and meaning perhaps “payback” for a vow (so Gray 1970, who also notes that this king is called “Son of a Nobody” in Assyrian records—confirming his status as usurper). son of Yavesh conspired against him;he struck him down at Yivle’am, and put him to death, and became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי זְכַרְיָה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Zekharya—here, they are written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: הוּא דְבַר־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֶל־יֵהוּא לֵאמֹר בְּנֵי רְבִיעִים יֵשְׁבוּ לְךָ עַל־כִּסֵּא יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְהִי־כֵן׃
verses.english: That is the word of YHWH which he spoke to Yehu, saying:Sons to the fourth generation shall have seat for you on the throne of Israel.And thus it was.

verses.hebrew: שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ מָלַךְ בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לְעֻזִיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֶרַח־יָמִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Shallum son of Yavesh became king in year thirty-nine of the years of Uziyya king of Judah;he reigned as king for a month of days in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי מִתִּרְצָה וַיָּבֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיַּךְ אֶת־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־יָבֵישׁ בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: And Menahem son of Gadi, from Tirtza, went up and came to Shomeron;he struck down Shallum son of Yavesh in Shomeron, and put him to death, and became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי שַׁלּוּם וְקִשְׁרוֹ אֲשֶׁר קָשָׁר הִנָּם כְּתֻבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he conspired—here, they are written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַכֶּה־מְנַחֵם אֶת־תִּפְסַח וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִתִּרְצָה כִּי לֹא פָתַח וַיַּךְ אֵת כָּל־הֶהָרוֹתֶיהָ בִּקֵּעַ׃
verses.english: Then Menahem struck Tappuah and all who were in it, and its territory, [proceeding] from Tirtza, since it would not open [its gates];he struck it, and all its pregnant women he split open.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ מְנַחֵם בֶּן־גָּדִי עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: In year thirty-nine of the years of Azarya king of Judah,Menahem son of Gadi became king over Israel,for twenty years in Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לֹא סָר מֵעַל חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־יָמָיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: בָּא פוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּתֵּן מְנַחֵם לְפוּל אֶלֶף כִּכַּר־כָּסֶף לִהְיוֹת יָדָיו אִתּוֹ לְהַחֲזִיק הַמַּמְלָכָה בְּיָדוֹ׃
verses.english: In his days) breaks the usual formula associated with Yorov’am. Better, here, is to put it at the beginning of v.19 and to emend slightly to “in his days” (be-yamav), which it resembles orthographically, and which is a common archival phrase in this literature. , Pul king of Assyria came against the land,and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver to have his hands be with him, to keep the kingdom strong in his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא מְנַחֵם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כָּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל לָתֵת לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר חֲמִשִּׁים שְׁקָלִים כֶּסֶף לְאִישׁ אֶחָד וַיָּשָׁב מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא־עָמַד שָׁם בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And Menahem imposed a silver [payment] on Israel, from all the mighty-men of value, to give [as payment] to the king of Assyria:fifty shekels of silver for [each] one man.So the king of Assyria turned back,and did not stay there in the land.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַחֵם וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלוֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Menahem, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַחֵם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ פְּקַחְיָה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Menahem lay beside his fathers,and Pekahya his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פְּקַחְיָה בֶן־מְנַחֵם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן שְׁנָתָיִם׃
verses.english: In year fifty of the years of Azarya king of Judah,Pekahya son of Menahem became king over Israel in Shomeron, for two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לֹא סָר מֵחַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשֹׁר עָלָיו פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ שָׁלִישׁוֹ וַיַּכֵּהוּ בְשֹׁמְרוֹן בְּאַרְמוֹן בֵּית־מלך [הַמֶּלֶךְ] אֶת־אַרְגֹּב וְאֶת־הָאַרְיֵה וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי גִלְעָדִים וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: And Pekah son of Remalyahu, his officer, conspired against him;he struck him down in Shomeron, in the citadel of the king’s house, with [men from] Argov and the Aryei means “lion” does not help much.—and along with him were fifty men of the Children of the Gil’adites—and he put him to death and became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי פְקַחְיָה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Pekahya, and all that he did—here, they are written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה לַעֲזַרְיָה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשֹׁמְרוֹן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: In year fifty-two of the years of Azarya king of Judah,Pekah son of Remalyahu became king over Israel in Shomeron,for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לֹא סָר מִן־חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:he did not turn aside from the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat, who had caused Israel to sin.

verses.hebrew: בִּימֵי פֶּקַח מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיִּקַּח אֶת־עִיּוֹן וְאֶת־אָבֵל בֵּית־מַעֲכָה וְאֶת־יָנוֹחַ וְאֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־חָצוֹר וְאֶת־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־הַגָּלִילָה כֹּל אֶרֶץ נַפְתָּלִי וַיַּגְלֵם אַשּׁוּרָה׃
verses.english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel,Tiglat Pil’eser, “My Help is the Son of Esharra [the god Ashur],” the third Assyrian king by that name, who ruled from 745 to 727 B.C.E. During his active military career, the Neo-Assyrian Empire reached its maximum expansion. The Hebrew is pronounced tig-LAHT pil-EH-ser. king of Assyria came;he took Iyyon and Avel Bet-Maakha and Yanoah and Kedesh and Hatzorand the Gil’ad and the Galilee,all the region of Naftali,and he exiled them to Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשָׁר־קֶשֶׁר הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה עַל־פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים לְיוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִיָּה׃
verses.english: Then Hoshe’a son of Ela conspired a conspiracy against Pekah son of Remalyahu;he struck him down and put him to death, and became king in his place,in year twenty of Yotam son of Uziyya.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי־פֶקַח וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הִנָּם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Pekah, and all that he did—here, they are written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Israel.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ יוֹתָם בֶּן־עֻזִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year two of Pekah son of Remalyahu king of Israel,Yotam son of Uziyyahu became king, king in Judah.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְרוּשָׁא בַּת־צָדוֹק׃
verses.english: Twenty-five years old was he when he became king,and for sixteen years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Yerusha daughter of Tzadok.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה עֻזִיָּהוּ אָבִיו עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: He did what was right in the eyes of YHWH:exactly as Uziyyahu his father had done, he did.

verses.hebrew: רַק הַבָּמוֹת לֹא סָרוּ עוֹד הָעָם מְזַבְּחִים וּמְקַטְּרִים בַּבָּמוֹת הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־שַׁעַר בֵּית־יְהוָה הָעֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: However, the sanctuaries were not removed;the people were still offering-sacrifices and sending-up-smoke at the sanctuaries.It was he who built the Upper Gate of the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yotam, which he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם הֵחֵל יְהוָה לְהַשְׁלִיחַ בִּיהוּדָה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וְאֵת פֶּקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ׃
verses.english: In those daysYHWH first sent out against JudahRetzin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remalya.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יוֹתָם עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד אָבִיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָחָז בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yotam lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathers in the City of David, his father,and Ahaz his son became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לְפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מָלַךְ אָחָז בֶּן־יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: In year seventeen of the years of Pekah son of Remalyahu,Ahaz son of Yotam, king of Judah became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה אָחָז בְּמָלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְלֹא־עָשָׂה הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו כְּדָוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: Twenty years old was he at his becoming king,and for sixteen years he reigned as king in Jerusalem.He did not do what was right in the eyes of YHWH his God, like David his father,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַם אֶת־בְּנוֹ הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ כְּתֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: but he walked in the way of the kings of Israel,and even had his son cross through the fire,[just] like the abominations of the nations whom YHWH had dispossessed before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְזַבֵּחַ וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת וְתַחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃
verses.english: He offered-sacrifices and sent-up-smoke at the sanctuaries and on the hilltops,and under every luxuriant tree.

verses.hebrew: אָז יַעֲלֶה רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּפֶקַח בֶּן־רְמַלְיָהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל יְרוּשָׁלִַם לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיָּצֻרוּ עַל־אָחָז וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִלָּחֵם׃
verses.english: Then Retzin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remalyahu king of Israel went up to Jerusalem for battle;they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome [him] in battle.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא הֵשִׁיב רְצִין מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם אֶת־אֵילַת לַאֲרָם וַיְנַשֵּׁל אֶת־הַיְהוּדִים מֵאֵילוֹת וארמים [וַאֲדוֹמִים] בָּאוּ אֵילַת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: —At that time Retzin king of Aram restored Elat to Edom:he expelled the Judahites from Elat,while Edomites came to Elat and settled there, until this day.—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אָחָז מַלְאָכִים אֶל־תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר עַבְדְּךָ וּבִנְךָ אָנִי עֲלֵה וְהוֹשִׁעֵנִי מִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אֲרָם וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקּוֹמִים עָלָי׃
verses.english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglat Pil’eser king of Assyria, saying:Your servant and your son am I!Come up and deliver me from the hand of the king of Aram and from the hand of the king of Israel, who have risen up against me!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אָחָז אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב הַנִּמְצָא בֵּית יְהוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח לְמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שֹׁחַד׃
verses.english: And Ahaz took the silver and the gold that were found in the House of YHWH and in the treasuries of the king’s house,and sent a bribe to the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֵלָיו מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר אֶל־דַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיִּתְפְּשֶׂהָ וַיַּגְלֶהָ קִירָה וְאֶת־רְצִין הֵמִית׃
verses.english: And the king of Assyria hearkened to his [plea];the king of Assyria went up to Damascus, seized it, and exiled it to Kir,while Retzin he put to death.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז לִקְרַאת תִּגְלַת פִּלְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר דּוּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּדַמָּשֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶל־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־דְּמוּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־תַּבְנִיתוֹ לְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
verses.english: Then King Ahaz went to meet Tiglat Pil’eser king of Assyria at Damascus,and he saw the sacrificial-altar that was in Damascus,so King Ahaz sent to Uriyya the priest a likeness of the altar and its pattern, including all [the details for] its making.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק כֵּן עָשָׂה אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן עַד־בּוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז מִדַּמָּשֶׂק׃
verses.english: And Uriyya the priest built the altar;exactly as King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so did Uriyya the priest make,by the time King Ahaz came back from Damascus.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִדַּמֶּשֶׂק וַיַּרְא הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרַב הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיַּעַל עָלָיו׃
verses.english: The king came back from Damascus,and the king looked over the altar.Then the king drew near to the altar, and went up on it;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וַיַּסֵּךְ אֶת־נִסְכּוֹ וַיִּזְרֹק אֶת־דַּם־הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: he sent-up-in-smoke his offering-up and his gift-offering, and poured out his poured-offering,and he sprinkled the blood of the shalom-offerings that he had against the altar.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַמִּזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיַּקְרֵב מֵאֵת פְּנֵי הַבַּיִת מִבֵּין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמִבֵּין בֵּית יְהוָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל־יֶרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ צָפוֹנָה׃
verses.english: As for the bronze altar that was in the presence of YHWH,he brought it near from in front of the House, from between the [new] altar and the House of YHWH,and placed it on the flank of the [new] altar, northward.

verses.hebrew: ויצוהו [וַיְצַוֶּה] הַמֶּלֶךְ־אָחָז אֶת־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַגָּדוֹל הַקְטֵר אֶת־עֹלַת־הַבֹּקֶר וְאֶת־מִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב וְאֶת־עֹלַת הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֵת עֹלַת כָּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם וְכָל־דַּם עֹלָה וְכָל־דַּם־זֶבַח עָלָיו תִּזְרֹק וּמִזְבַּח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת יִהְיֶה־לִּי לְבַקֵּר׃
verses.english: And King Ahaz commanded Uriyya the priest, saying:On the large altar, send-up-in-smoke the morning offering-up, the evening gift, the offering-up of the king and his grain-gift,and the offering-up of all the Landed People and their gifts, along with their poured-offerings;and all the blood of the offerings-up and all the blood of the [shalom-]sacrifice, you are to sprinkle against it,while the bronze altar is to be mine to frequent.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז׃
verses.english: So Uriyya the priest didjust as King Ahaz had commanded.

verses.hebrew: וַיְקַצֵּץ הַמֶּלֶךְ אָחָז אֶת־הַמִּסְגְּרוֹת הַמְּכֹנוֹת וַיָּסַר מֵעֲלֵיהֶם ואת־[אֶת־] הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת־הַיָּם הוֹרִד מֵעַל הַבָּקָר הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּיהָ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתוֹ עַל מַרְצֶפֶת אֲבָנִים׃
verses.english: And King Ahaz stripped the rims of the standsand removed the basin from them,while the Sea he took down from the bronze oxen that were beneath it,and placed it on the pavement of stones;

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מיסך [מוּסַךְ] הַשַּׁבָּת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנוּ בַבַּיִת וְאֶת־מְבוֹא הַמֶּלֶךְ הַחִיצוֹנָה הֵסֵב בֵּית יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: and the covered-passage for the Sabbath which they had built in the House and the king’s outer entrance, he removed from the House of YHWH,on account of the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָחָז אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Ahaz, [and] what he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב אָחָז עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר עִם־אֲבֹתָיו בְּעִיר דָּוִד וַיִּמְלֹךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Ahaz lay beside his fathers;he was buried with his fathers, in the City of David,and Hizkiyyahu, meaning “YHWH Was Strong.” The name Ezekiel (Yehezke’el) derives from the same Hebrew root. The trad. English is “Hezekiah.” his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה לְאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מָלַךְ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה בְשֹׁמְרוֹן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּשַׁע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: In year twelve of Ahaz king of Judah,Hoshe’a son of Ela became king in Shomeron, over Israel,for nine years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה רַק לֹא כְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH—however, not like the kings of Israel who were before him.

verses.hebrew: עָלָיו עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיְהִי־לוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ עֶבֶד וַיָּשֶׁב לוֹ מִנְחָה׃
verses.english: Against him Shalman’eser, suggesting perhaps a heightened rhetoric, fitting for the introduction to such a dramatic moment in Israel’s history. king of Assyria came up, “[The God] Shalman Is Exalted.” Sargon II is also mentioned in Assyrian records as the conqueror of Shomeron. ,and Hoshe’a became servant to himand rendered him tribute.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ קֶשֶׁר אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סוֹא מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְלֹא־הֶעֱלָה מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר כְּשָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה וַיַּעַצְרֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בֵּית כֶּלֶא׃
verses.english: But the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshe’a,in that he sent messengers to So king of Egyptand did not send up tribute to the king of Assyria as year after year.So the king of Assyria arrested him and bound him over. to the prison house.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ וַיַּעַל שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: And the king of Assyria went up throughout all the land;he went up to Shomeron and laid siege to it, for three years.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁיעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ לָכַד מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיֹּשֶׁב אֹתָם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃
verses.english: In the ninth year of Hoshe’a, the king of Assyria captured Shomeron,and he exiled Israel to Assyria;he settled them in Halah and on the Havor, the River Gozan, and the towns of Media.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָטְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִתַּחַת יַד פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיִּירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃
verses.english: So it was,because the Children of Israel had sinned against YHWH their God,the one bringing them up from the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt,and had held other gods in awe,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃
verses.english: and had walked in the customs of the nations which YHWH had dispossessed before the Israelitesand of the kings of Israel, which they had observed;

verses.hebrew: וַיְחַפְּאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־כֵן עַל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיִּבְנוּ לָהֶם בָּמוֹת בְּכָל־עָרֵיהֶם מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃
verses.english: and the Children of Israel had imputed things which are not so to YHWH their God,and had built themselves sanctuaries throughout all their towns,from guards’ tower to fortified town;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּצִּבוּ לָהֶם מַצֵּבוֹת וַאֲשֵׁרִים עַל כָּל־גִּבְעָה גְבֹהָה וְתַחַת כָּל־עֵץ רַעֲנָן׃
verses.english: and had set up standing-pillars and Ashera-poles for themselves, on every lofty hill and beneath every luxuriant tree,

verses.hebrew: וַיְקַטְּרוּ־שָׁם בְּכָל־בָּמוֹת כַּגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הֶגְלָה יְהוָה מִפְּנֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ דְּבָרִים רָעִים לְהַכְעִיס אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: and had sent-up-smoke there, at all the sanctuaries, like the nations whom YHWH had exiled before them,and had done evil things, to provoke YHWH,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
