verses.english: and had served Illicit-Thingsabout which YHWH had said to them:You are not to do this thing!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּעַד יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִיהוּדָה בְּיַד כָּל־נביאו [נְבִיאֵי] כָל־חֹזֶה לֵאמֹר שֻׁבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶם הָרָעִים וְשִׁמְרוּ מִצְוֺתַי חֻקּוֹתַי כְּכָל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד עֲבָדַי הַנְּבִיאִים׃
verses.english: And YHWH had warned Israel and Judah by the hand of every prophet, every seer, saying:Turn back from your evil ways and keep my commandments and my regulations,according to all the Instruction that I commanded your fathersand which I sent to them by the hand of my servants the prophets.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּקְשׁוּ אֶת־עָרְפָּם כְּעֹרֶף אֲבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: But they had not hearkened;they had hardened their neck, like the neck of their fathers,who had not trusted in YHWH their God,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ אֶת־חֻקָּיו וְאֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְאֵת עֵדְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֵעִיד בָּם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהֶבֶל וַיֶּהְבָּלוּ וְאַחֲרֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתָם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֹתָם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּהֶם׃
verses.english: and they had rejected his rules and his covenant which he had cut with their fathers,and his warnings by which he had warned them;and they had walked after futility and became futile [themselves],and after the nations that were around them, about whom YHWH had commanded them to not do like them;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה שנים [שְׁנֵי] עֲגָלִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֲשֵׁירָה וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְכָל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבָּעַל׃
verses.english: they had abandoned all the commandments of YHWH their Godand had made for themselves something molten—two calves,and had made an Ashera-poleand bowed down to all the Forces of the Heavensand served Baal;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ וַיִּקְסְמוּ קְסָמִים וַיְנַחֵשׁוּ וַיִּתְמַכְּרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִיסוֹ׃
verses.english: and they had made their sons and their daughters cross through the fire,and they had augured augury and practiced divination,and had sold themselves to do what was evil in the eyes of YHWH, provoking him—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַנַּף יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְסִרֵם מֵעַל פָּנָיו לֹא נִשְׁאַר רַק שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: so YHWH became exceedingly angry at Israel, and he removed them from his presence;none remained, save the tribe of Judah alone.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוּדָה לֹא שָׁמַר אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּחֻקּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ׃
verses.english: But even Judah did not keep the commandments of YHWH their God;they walked in the customs of Israel which they had observed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס יְהוָה בְּכָל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְעַנֵּם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים עַד אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִיכָם מִפָּנָיו׃
verses.english: And so YHWH rejected all the seed of Israel;he afflicted them and gave them into the hand of pillagers,until he had cast them out from his presence.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־קָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל בֵּית דָּוִד וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט וידא [וַיַּדַּח] יָרָבְעָם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וְהֶחֱטֵיאָם חֲטָאָה גְדוֹלָה׃
verses.english: When he had torn Israel away from the House of Davidand had made Yorov’am son of Nevat king,Yorov’am had led Israel away from [following] after YHWHand had caused them to sin a great sin.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־חַטֹּאות יָרָבְעָם אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לֹא־סָרוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel had walked in all the sins of Yorov’am son of Nevat which he wrought,and had not turned aside from it,

verses.hebrew: עַד אֲשֶׁר־הֵסִיר יְהוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל פָּנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד כָּל־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים וַיִּגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ אַשּׁוּרָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: until YHWH removed, punning on saru, “turn aside,” in the previous verse. Israel from his presence,as he had promised by the hand of all his servants the prophets.So Israel was exiled from its soil to Assyria,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר מִבָּבֶל וּמִכּוּתָה וּמֵעַוָּא וּמֵחֲמָת וּסְפַרְוַיִם וַיֹּשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן תַּחַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּרְשׁוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּעָרֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And the king of Assyria brought [people] from Babylon, from Kuta, from Avva, from Hamat, and from Sefarvayim,and settled them in the towns of Shomeron, in place of the Children of Israel;they took possession of Shomeron, and settled in her towns.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּתְחִלַּת שִׁבְתָּם שָׁם לֹא יָרְאוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוָה בָּהֶם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ הֹרְגִים בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: Now it was:at the start of their settlement there, they did not hold YHWH in awe,so YHWH sent out lions, echoes the key verb y-r-’, “hold in awe,” as well as the term “instruct” (y-r-k) in v.27. against them,and they were killing [some] among them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתָ וַתּוֹשֶׁב בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן לֹא יָדְעוּ אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ וַיְשַׁלַּח־בָּם אֶת־הָאֲרָיוֹת וְהִנָּם מְמִיתִים אוֹתָם כַּאֲשֶׁר אֵינָם יֹדְעִים אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: So they said to the king of Assyria, saying:The nations whom you exiled and resettled in the towns of Shomerondo not know the practices of the god of the land,so he has sent out lions against them;here, they are causing their death,as they do not know the practices of the god of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לֵאמֹר הֹלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלִיתֶם מִשָּׁם וְיֵלְכוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ שָׁם וְיֹרֵם אֶת־מִשְׁפַּט אֱלֹהֵי הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: So the king of Assyria commanded, saying:Have one of the priests whom I exiled from there go there,let him go and settle there, and instruct them in the practices of the god of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶחָד מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הִגְלוּ מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵית־אֵל וַיְהִי מוֹרֶה אֹתָם אֵיךְ יִירְאוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So one of the priests whom they had exiled from Shomeron cameand settled at Bet-El,and he was instructing them how they should hold YHWH in awe.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים גּוֹי גּוֹי אֱלֹהָיו וַיַּנִּיחוּ בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ הַשֹּׁמְרֹנִים גּוֹי גּוֹי בְּעָרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם יֹשְׁבִים שָׁם׃
verses.english: But each-nation, each-nation went on making their own gods;they put them in the sanctuary buildings that the Shomeronites had made,each-nation, each-nation in their towns in which they had settled:

verses.hebrew: וְאַנְשֵׁי בָבֶל עָשׂוּ אֶת־סֻכּוֹת בְּנוֹת וְאַנְשֵׁי־כוּת עָשׂוּ אֶת־נֵרְגַל וְאַנְשֵׁי חֲמָת עָשׂוּ אֶת־אֲשִׁימָא׃
verses.english: the men of Bavel made Sukkot Benot,and the men of Kut made Nergal,and the men of Hamat made Ashima,

verses.hebrew: וְהָעַוִּים עָשׂוּ נִבְחַז וְאֶת־תַּרְתָּק וְהַסְפַרְוִים שֹׂרְפִים אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ לְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וַעֲנַמֶּלֶךְ אלה [אֱלֹהֵי] ספרים [סְפַרְוָיִם׃]
verses.english: and the Awites made Nivhaz and Tartak,and the Sefarvites were burning their children in fire to Adrammelekh and to Anammelekh, the gods of Sefarvayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהוָה וַיַּעֲשׂוּ לָהֶם מִקְצוֹתָם כֹּהֲנֵי בָמוֹת וַיִּהְיוּ עֹשִׂים לָהֶם בְּבֵית הַבָּמוֹת׃
verses.english: Now they went on holding YHWH in awe,but they [also] made for themselves, from [all] their quarters, priests for the sanctuaries;they went on making [worship] for them at the sanctuary buildings.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־יְהוָה הָיוּ יְרֵאִים וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים כְּמִשְׁפַּט הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְלוּ אֹתָם מִשָּׁם׃
verses.english: Now YHWH they held in awe,while their gods they went on serving,according to the practice of the nations from among whom they had been exiled.

verses.hebrew: עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הֵם עֹשִׂים כַּמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֵינָם יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהוָה וְאֵינָם עֹשִׂים כְּחֻקֹּתָם וּכְמִשְׁפָּטָם וְכַתּוֹרָה וְכַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: To this day they do, according to their earlier practices:they do not hold YHWH in awe;they do not do according to their laws, according to their practice,or according to the Instructions and the commandments that YHWH commanded the Children of Yaakov, whose name he appointed Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרֹת יְהוָה אִתָּם בְּרִית וַיְצַוֵּם לֵאמֹר לֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְלֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם וְלֹא תַעַבְדוּם וְלֹא תִזְבְּחוּ לָהֶם׃
verses.english: But YHWH had cut a covenant with them and had commanded them, saying:You are not to hold other gods in awe,you are not to bow down to them,you are not to serve them,and you are not to sacrifice to them!

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה אֹתוֹ תִירָאוּ וְלוֹ תִשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְלוֹ תִזְבָּחוּ׃
verses.english: Rather, YHWH,who brought you up from the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm,him you are to hold in awe,to him you are to bow down, to him you are to sacrifice!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַחֻקִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוָה אֲשֶׁר כָּתַב לָכֶם תִּשְׁמְרוּן לַעֲשׂוֹת כָּל־הַיָּמִים וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃
verses.english: The laws and the practices, the instruction and the commandment that he wrote down for you,you are to keep, observing it all the days [of your life];you are not to hold other gods in awe!

verses.hebrew: וְהַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַתִּי אִתְּכֶם לֹא תִשְׁכָּחוּ וְלֹא תִירְאוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים׃
verses.english: The covenant that I cut with you, you are not to forget;you are not to hold other gods in awe!

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם תִּירָאוּ וְהוּא יַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד כָּל־אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: Rather, YHWH your God you are to hold in awe—and he will rescue you from the hand of all your enemies.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי אִם־כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הֵם עֹשִׂים׃
verses.english: But they did not hearken,rather, according to their former practice they went on doing.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה יְרֵאִים אֶת־יְהוָה וְאֶת־פְּסִילֵיהֶם הָיוּ עֹבְדִים גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָם הֵם עֹשִׂים עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So these nations have been holding YHWH in awe,but their idols they have gone on serving,and also their children and their children’s children:as their fathers did, [so] they go on doing,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלֹשׁ לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל מָלַךְ חִזְקִיָּה בֶן־אָחָז מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now it was in year three of Hoshe’a son of Ela, king of Israel:Hizkiyya son of Ahaz, king of Judah, became king.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וְעֶשְׂרִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ אֲבִי בַּת־זְכַרְיָה׃
verses.english: Twenty-five years old was he at his becoming king,and for twenty-nine years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Avi daughter of Zekharya.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה דָּוִד אָבִיו׃
verses.english: He did what was right in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as David his father had done:

verses.hebrew: הוּא הֵסִיר אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבֹת וְכָרַת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה וְכִתַּת נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה כִּי עַד־הַיָּמִים הָהֵמָּה הָיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַטְּרִים לוֹ וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּן׃
verses.english: it was he who removed the sanctuariesand smashed the standing-pillarsand cut down the Ashera-poleand crushed to bits the Viper of Copper. Biblical Hebrew does not differentiate between copper and its alloys (Zevit 2004). See Num. 21:4–9, where Moshe is commanded to counter a plague of snakes by hanging one made out of bronze on a standard, for those afflicted to look at and be healed. According to our passage, it had been preserved and was apparently worshipped. that Moshe had made,for until those days, the Children of Israel used to send-up-smoke to it—it was called Copperviper.

verses.hebrew: בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּטָח וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־הָיָה כָמֹהוּ בְּכֹל מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַאֲשֶׁר הָיוּ לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: On YHWH the God of Israel did he rely;after him there was no one like him among all the kings of Judah,[nor] of those who were before him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדְבַּק בַּיהוָה לֹא־סָר מֵאַחֲרָיו וַיִּשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: He clung to YHWH,and did not turn aside from [following] after him,but he kept his commandments, which YHWH had commanded Moshe.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה יְהוָה עִמּוֹ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא יַשְׂכִּיל וַיִּמְרֹד בְּמֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וְלֹא עֲבָדוֹ׃
verses.english: So YHWH was with him;wherever he went out, he prospered.He rose-in-revolt against the king of Assyria, and would not serve him.

verses.hebrew: הוּא־הִכָּה אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים עַד־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלֶיהָ מִמִּגְדַּל נוֹצְרִים עַד־עִיר מִבְצָר׃
verses.english: It was he who struck the Philistines as far as Gaza and its territories,from guards’ tower to fortified town.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִית לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ הִיא הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִית לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־אֵלָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלָה שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וַיָּצַר עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Now it was in the fourth year of King Hizkiyyahu—that is the seventh year of Hoshe’a son of Ela king of Israel—Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Shomeron and laid siege to it,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ מִקְצֵה שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים בִּשְׁנַת־שֵׁשׁ לְחִזְקִיָּה הִיא שְׁנַת־תֵּשַׁע לְהוֹשֵׁעַ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל נִלְכְּדָה שֹׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: and he took it at the end of three years;in year six of Hizkiyyahu—that is year nine of Hoshe’a king of Israel—Shomeron was captured.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּגֶל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַשּׁוּרָה וַיַּנְחֵם בַּחְלַח וּבְחָבוֹר נְהַר גּוֹזָן וְעָרֵי מָדָי׃
verses.english: The king of Assyria exiled Israel to Assyria;he led them off to Halah and Havor, the River Gozan and the towns of Media,

verses.hebrew: עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד יְהוָה וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ וְלֹא עָשׂוּ׃
verses.english: because they had not hearkened to the voice of YHWH their God,but had crossed his covenant,all that he had commanded Moshe, the servant of YHWH—they had not hearkened, they had not done [it.]

verses.hebrew: וּבְאַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּה עָלָה סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל כָּל־עָרֵי יְהוּדָה הַבְּצֻרוֹת וַיִּתְפְּשֵׂם׃
verses.english: In the fourteenth year of King Hizkiyya,Sanheriv trad. English “Sennacherib,” Assyrian Sin-ahhe-eriba, “[The God] Sin Compensated for [Dead] Brothers.” king of Assyria came up against all the fortified towns of Judah and seized them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר לָכִישָׁה לֵאמֹר חָטָאתִי שׁוּב מֵעָלַי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תִּתֵּן עָלַי אֶשָּׂא וַיָּשֶׂם מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עַל־חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת כִּכַּר־כֶּסֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים כִּכַּר זָהָב׃
verses.english: And Hizkiyya king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lakhish, saying:I have sinned—turn back from me;whatever you place upon me, I will bear.So the king of Assyria imposed upon Hizkiyya king of Judahthree hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־כָּל־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בֵית־יְהוָה וּבְאֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: and Hizkiyya gave over all the silver that was found in the House of YHWHand in the treasuries of the king’s house.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא קִצַּץ חִזְקִיָּה אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת הֵיכַל יְהוָה וְאֶת־הָאֹמְנוֹת אֲשֶׁר צִפָּה חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה וַיִּתְּנֵם לְמֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: At that time,Hizkiyya stripped the doors of YHWH’s Great-Hall,and the posts, denoting “firmness” or “support” (Cogan/Tadmor). which Hizkiyya king of Judah had overlaid,and gave them to the king of Assyria.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֶת־תַּרְתָּן וְאֶת־רַב־סָרִיס וְאֶת־רַב־שָׁקֵה מִן־לָכִישׁ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּחֵיל כָּבֵד יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ בִּתְעָלַת הַבְּרֵכָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר בִּמְסִלַּת שְׂדֵה כוֹבֵס׃
verses.english: But the king of Assyria sent the Field-Marshal probably derives from the Assyrian turtanu. and the Chief Official and the Chief Cupbearer from Lakhish to King Hizkiyyahu with a weighty army to Jerusalem;they went up and came to Jerusalem,and when they had gone up and come, they stopped at the channel of the Upper Pool that is by the road of the Washer’s Field

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֵּצֵא אֲלֵהֶם אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַבָּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָה הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: and called for the king.And Elyakim son of Hilkiyyahu, [The One] Over the House,and Shevna the [Royal] Scribeand Yoah “YHWH Is Kinsman.” son of Asaf the Herald went out to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רַב־שָׁקֵה אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כֹּה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר מָה הַבִּטָּחוֹן הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּטָחְתָּ׃
verses.english: The Chief Cupbearer said to them:Now say to Hizkiyyahu:Thus says the Great King, the king of Assyria:What is this reliance on which you rely?

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתָּ אַךְ־דְּבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם עֵצָה וּגְבוּרָה לַמִּלְחָמָה עַתָּה עַל־מִי בָטַחְתָּ כִּי מָרַדְתָּ בִּי׃
verses.english: Do you really think that [mere] words from lipsare counsel and might for battle?Now, on whom do you rely, that you have risen-in-revolt against me?

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה הִנֵּה בָטַחְתָּ לְּךָ עַל־מִשְׁעֶנֶת הַקָּנֶה הָרָצוּץ הַזֶּה עַל־מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יִסָּמֵךְ אִישׁ עָלָיו וּבָא בְכַפּוֹ וּנְקָבָהּ כֵּן פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם לְכָל־הַבֹּטְחִים עָלָיו׃
verses.english: Now here, you have relied for yourself on this snapped shaft of a reed, on Egypt,which when a man leans on it, it enters his palm and punctures it!That is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who rely on him!

verses.hebrew: וְכִי־תֹאמְרוּן אֵלַי אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בָּטָחְנוּ הֲלוֹא־הוּא אֲשֶׁר הֵסִיר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־בָּמֹתָיו וְאֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לִיהוּדָה וְלִירוּשָׁלִַם לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַזֶּה תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And if you say to me:On YHWH our God we rely—is it not he whose sanctuaries and whose altars Hizkiyyahu removedand said to Judah and to Jerusalem:Before this sacrificial-altar [alone] you are to bow down, in Jerusalem!?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִתְעָרֶב נָא אֶת־אֲדֹנִי אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אַלְפַּיִם סוּסִים אִם־תּוּכַל לָתֶת לְךָ רֹכְבִים עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So-now, pray make a wager with my lord, with the king of Assyria:I will give you two thousand horsesif you are able to place riders upon them!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵיךְ תָּשִׁיב אֵת פְּנֵי פַחַת אַחַד עַבְדֵי אֲדֹנִי הַקְּטַנִּים וַתִּבְטַח לְךָ עַל־מִצְרַיִם לְרֶכֶב וּלְפָרָשִׁים׃
verses.english: So how will you turn away the face of a single governor, may be considered a gloss (Cogan/Tadmor), and is often omitted. of the least of my lord’s servants?Yet you rely for yourself on Egypt for chariotry and horsemen!

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה הֲמִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה עָלִיתִי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַשְׁחִתוֹ יְהוָה אָמַר אֵלַי עֲלֵה עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ׃
verses.english: And now [too],is it without YHWH that I have come up against this place, to bring it to ruin?It is YHWH who said to me:Go up against this land and wreak ruin upon it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּהוּ וְשֶׁבְנָה וְיוֹאָח אֶל־רַב־שָׁקֵה דַּבֶּר־נָא אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲרָמִית כִּי שֹׁמְעִים אֲנָחְנוּ וְאַל־תְּדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ יְהוּדִית בְּאָזְנֵי הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַחֹמָה׃
verses.english: Then Elyakim son of Hilkiyyahu and Shevna and Yoah to the Chief Cupbearer said:Pray speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it,but do not speak with us in Judean within earshot of the fighting-people who are on the wall!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַב־שָׁקֵה הַעַל אֲדֹנֶיךָ וְאֵלֶיךָ שְׁלָחַנִי אֲדֹנִי לְדַבֵּר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲלֹא עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הַיֹּשְׁבִים עַל־הַחֹמָה לֶאֱכֹל אֶת חריהם [צוֹאָתָם] וְלִשְׁתּוֹת אֶת־שיניהם [מימֵי] [רַגְלֵיהֶם] עִמָּכֶם׃
verses.english: But the Chief Cupbearer said to them:Is it to your lord and to you that my lord has sent me to speak these words?Is it not to the men sitting on the wall,[who will have] to eat their filth and drink the “water of their legs” euphemisms for excrement and urine. with you?

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד רַב־שָׁקֵה וַיִּקְרָא בְקוֹל־גָּדוֹל יְהוּדִית וַיְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְעוּ דְּבַר־הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: And the Chief Cupbearer stood forth and called out in a loud voice in Judean,he spoke and said:Hearken to the word of the Great King, the king of Assyria:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ אַל־יַשִּׁיא לָכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־לֹא יוּכַל לְהַצִּיל אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדוֹ׃
verses.english: Thus says the king:Do not let Hizkiyyahu deceive you,for he is not able to rescue you from my hand,

verses.hebrew: וְאַל־יַבְטַח אֶתְכֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר הַצֵּל יַצִּילֵנוּ יְהוָה וְלֹא תִנָּתֵן אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: and do not let Hizkiyyahu make you rely on YHWH, saying:YHWH will rescue, yes, rescue us;this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי כֹה אָמַר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עֲשׂוּ־אִתִּי בְרָכָה וּצְאוּ אֵלַי וְאִכְלוּ אִישׁ־גַּפְנוֹ וְאִישׁ תְּאֵנָתוֹ וּשְׁתוּ אִישׁ מֵי־בוֹרוֹ׃
verses.english: Do not hearken to Hizkiyyahu,for thus says the king of Assyria:Make me a blessing-gift, most often “blessing,” can sometimes mean “gift,” as in Gen. 33:11. Cogan/Tadmor see the construction here (with “make”) as deriving from Akkadian usage, and others have remarked on the Assyrian flavor of the speech. , and come out to me [in surrender],and each will eat of his vine, each of his fig tree,and each will drink waters of his cistern,

verses.hebrew: עַד־בֹּאִי וְלָקַחְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּאַרְצְכֶם אֶרֶץ דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ אֶרֶץ לֶחֶם וּכְרָמִים אֶרֶץ זֵית יִצְהָר וּדְבַשׁ וִחְיוּ וְלֹא תָמֻתוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי־יַסִּית אֶתְכֶם לֵאמֹר יְהוָה יַצִּילֵנוּ׃
verses.english: until my coming to take you away to a land like your land,a land of new-wine and grain, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of shining olive oil and honey,that you may live and not die.So do not hearken to Hizkiyyahuwhen he incites you, saying:YHWH will rescue us!

verses.hebrew: הַהַצֵּל הִצִּילוּ אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אִישׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מִיַּד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: Did the gods of the [other] nations rescue, yes, rescue their land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי חֲמָת וְאַרְפָּד אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֵי סְפַרְוַיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה כִּי־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־שֹׁמְרוֹן מִיָּדִי׃
verses.english: Where are the gods of Hamat or Arpad?Where are the gods of Sefarvayim, Heina, and Ivva?Indeed, did they rescue Shomeron from my hand?

verses.hebrew: מִי בְּכָל־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר־הִצִּילוּ אֶת־אַרְצָם מִיָּדִי כִּי־יַצִּיל יְהוָה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם מִיָּדִי׃
verses.english: Who is it among all the gods of these lands that rescued their land from my hand,that YHWH should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?

verses.hebrew: וְהֶחֱרִישׁוּ הָעָם וְלֹא־עָנוּ אֹתוֹ דָּבָר כִּי־מִצְוַת הַמֶּלֶךְ הִיא לֵאמֹר לֹא תַעֲנֻהוּ׃
verses.english: But the people were silent, and did not answer him a word,for it was the king’s command, saying:You are not to answer him!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְיוֹאָח בֶּן־אָסָף הַמַּזְכִּיר אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ קְרוּעֵי בְגָדִים וַיַּגִּדוּ לוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַב־שָׁקֵה׃
verses.english: Then Elyakim son of Hilkiyya, [The One] Over the Household, and Shevna the Scribe, and Yoah son of Asaf the Herald, came to Hizkiyyahu, with torn garments,and they told him the words of the Chief Cupbearer.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיִּתְכַּס בַּשָּׂק וַיָּבֹא בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: It was, when King Hizkiyyahu heard,that he tore his garmentsand covered himself in sackclothand came into the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים אֲשֶׁר־עַל־הַבַּיִת וְשֶׁבְנָא הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת זִקְנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים מִתְכַּסִּים בַּשַּׂקִּים אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא בֶּן־אָמוֹץ׃
verses.english: Then he sent Elyakim, [The One] Over the Household, and Shevna the Scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered in sackcloth,to Yesha’yahu, “YHWH Has Delivered,” the great prophet (English: Isaiah) whose book follows Kings in the Hebrew Bible. the prophet, son of Amotz;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר חִזְקִיָּהוּ יוֹם־צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי בָאוּ בָנִים עַד־מַשְׁבֵּר וְכֹחַ אַיִן לְלֵדָה׃
verses.english: they said to him:Thus says Hizkiyyahu:A day of distress, rebuke, and scorn is this day,for children have come to the womb-breaking,but strength there is none for giving birth!

verses.hebrew: אוּלַי יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי רַב־שָׁקֵה אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֲדֹנָיו לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חַי וְהוֹכִיחַ בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְנָשָׂאתָ תְפִלָּה בְּעַד הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּמְצָאָה׃
verses.english: Perhaps YHWH your God will hear all the words of the Chief Cupbearer with which the king of Assyria, his lord, sent him to mock the Living Godand will give rebuke because of the words that YHWH your God has heard—so lift up a prayer on behalf of the remnant that is found!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַבְדֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעַיָהוּ׃
verses.english: So the servants of King Hizkiyyahu came to Yesha’yahu,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם יְשַׁעְיָהוּ כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־אֲדֹנֵיכֶם כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אַל־תִּירָא מִפְּנֵי הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְתָּ אֲשֶׁר גִּדְּפוּ נַעֲרֵי מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אֹתִי׃
verses.english: and Yesha’yahu said to them:Thus are you to say to your lord:Thus says YHWH:Do not be afraid before the words that you have heard,with which the serving-lads of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me!

verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי נֹתֵן בּוֹ רוּחַ וְשָׁמַע שְׁמוּעָה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּיו בַּחֶרֶב בְּאַרְצוֹ׃
verses.english: Here, I will put a spirit in him,so that he hears some hearsay and has to return to his land,and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his land!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב רַב־שָׁקֵה וַיִּמְצָא אֶת־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר נִלְחָם עַל־לִבְנָה כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ׃
verses.english: The Chief Cupbearer returned and found the king of Assyria engaging in battle against Livna,for he had heard that he had marched on from Lakhish.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶל־תִּרְהָקָה מֶלֶך־כּוּשׁ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה יָצָא לְהִלָּחֵם אִתָּךְ וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: He heard [a report] about Tirhaka king of Kush, saying:Here, he has gone out to engage in battle with you!So he sent messengers back to Hizkiyyahu, saying:Thus are you to say to Hizkiyyahu king of Judah, saying:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה תֹאמְרוּן אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה לֵאמֹר אַל־יַשִּׁאֲךָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בֹּטֵחַ בּוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא תִנָּתֵן יְרוּשָׁלִַם בְּיַד מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר׃
verses.english: Do not let your God on whom you rely beguile you, saying [to yourself]:Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria!

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַתָּה שָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר לְכָל־הָאֲרָצוֹת לְהַחֲרִימָם וְאַתָּה תִּנָּצֵל׃
verses.english: Here, you have heard what the kings of Assyria did to all the [other] lands, devoting-them-to-destruction—so will you be rescued?

verses.hebrew: הַהִצִּילוּ אֹתָם אֱלֹהֵי הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר שִׁחֲתוּ אֲבוֹתַי אֶת־גּוֹזָן וְאֶת־חָרָן וְרֶצֶף וּבְנֵי־עֶדֶן אֲשֶׁר בִּתְלַאשָּׂר׃
verses.english: Did the gods of the nations whom my fathers brought to ruin rescue them:Gozan and Harran,Retzef and the Children of Ehden who were in Telassar?

verses.hebrew: אַיּוֹ מֶלֶךְ־חֲמָת וּמֶלֶךְ אַרְפָּד וּמֶלֶךְ לָעִיר סְפַרְוָיִם הֵנַע וְעִוָּה׃
verses.english: Where is he, the king of Hamat, or the king of Arpad, or the king of La’ir, of Sefarvayim, Heina, and Ivva?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶת־הַסְּפָרִים מִיַּד הַמַּלְאָכִים וַיִּקְרָאֵם וַיַּעַל בֵּית יְהוָה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂהוּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Hizkiyyahu took the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it;then he went up to the House of YHWH,and Hizkiyyahu spread it out in the presence of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים אַתָּה־הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדְּךָ לְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: And Hizkiyyahu prayed in the presence of YHWH, he said:O YHWH, God of Israel, [Who is] Seated on the Winged-Sphinxes,you are God, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth;you made the heavens and the earth.

verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ וּשֲׁמָע פְּקַח יְהוָה עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה וּשְׁמַע אֵת דִּבְרֵי סַנְחֵרִיב אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחוֹ לְחָרֵף אֱלֹהִים חָי׃
verses.english: Incline, O YHWH, your ear and hearken;open, O YHWH, your eyes and see,and hear the words of Sanheriv which he sent to mock the Living God!

verses.hebrew: אָמְנָם יְהוָה הֶחֱרִיבוּ מַלְכֵי אַשּׁוּר אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם וְאֶת־אַרְצָם׃
verses.english: In truth, O YHWH, the kings of Assyria have laid waste to nations and their land[s],

verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בָּאֵשׁ כִּי לֹא אֱלֹהִים הֵמָּה כִּי אִם־מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי־אָדָם עֵץ וָאֶבֶן וַיְאַבְּדוּם׃
verses.english: and they have put their gods to the fire—for they are not gods,but the work of human hands, wood and stone—so they have demolished them.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ נָא מִיָּדוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ כִּי אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: But now, O YHWH our God,pray deliver us from his hand,so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, YHWH, are God, you alone!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ לֵאמֹר כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הִתְפַּלַּלְתָּ אֵלַי אֶל־סַנְחֵרִב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר שָׁמָעְתִּי׃
verses.english: And Yesha’yahu son of Amotz sent [word] to Hizkiyyahu, saying:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:That which you prayed to me concerning Sanheriv king of Assyria, I have heard.

verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה עָלָיו בָּזָה לְךָ לָעֲגָה לְךָ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן אַחֲרֶיךָ רֹאשׁ הֵנִיעָה בַּת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: This is the word that YHWH speaks concerning can also be understood as “against” (Cohn 2000). him:She despises you, she derides you,the Nubile Daughter of Zion;after you, she shakes her head after you,the Daughter of Jerusalem:

verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִי חֵרַפְתָּ וְגִדַּפְתָּ וְעַל־מִי הֲרִימוֹתָ קּוֹל וַתִּשָּׂא מָרוֹם עֵינֶיךָ עַל־קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Whom have you mocked and blasphemed?Against whom have your raised [your] voice?You have lifted up your eyes on highagainst the Holy One of Israel!

verses.hebrew: בְּיַד מַלְאָכֶיךָ חֵרַפְתָּ אֲדֹנָי וַתֹּאמֶר ברכב [בְּרֹב] רִכְבִּי אֲנִי עָלִיתִי מְרוֹם הָרִים יַרְכְּתֵי לְבָנוֹן וְאֶכְרֹת קוֹמַת אֲרָזָיו מִבְחוֹר בְּרֹשָׁיו וְאָבוֹאָה מְלוֹן קִצֹּה יַעַר כַּרְמִלּוֹ׃
verses.english: By the hand of your messengers you have mocked YHWH,you said: With my vast chariotryI have gone up the loftiest mountains,the flanks of the Levanon;I cut down the highest of its cedars,the choicest of its junipers.And I came to its farthest lodge,its garden-like forest.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי קַרְתִּי וְשָׁתִיתִי מַיִם זָרִים וְאַחְרִב בְּכַף־פְּעָמַי כֹּל יְאֹרֵי מָצוֹר׃
verses.english: It was I who dug and drankthe water of strangers,and I dried up with the soles of my feetall the Nile-streams of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־שָׁמַעְתָּ לְמֵרָחוֹק אֹתָהּ עָשִׂיתִי לְמִימֵי קֶדֶם וִיצַרְתִּיהָ עַתָּה הֲבֵיאתִיהָ וּתְהִי לַהְשׁוֹת גַּלִּים נִצִּים עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת׃
verses.english: Have you not heard? From of old I did it,in former days I fashioned it;now I bring it to pass,and it is:crashing into wrecked heapsfortified towns,

verses.hebrew: וְיֹשְׁבֵיהֶן קִצְרֵי־יָד חַתּוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ הָיוּ עֵשֶׂב שָׂדֶה וִירַק דֶּשֶׁא חֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת וּשְׁדֵפָה לִפְנֵי קָמָה׃
verses.english: while their settled-folk, short-armed,were dismayed and confounded.They were [like] the herbage of the field,the green grass,the straw of the rooftops, blastedbefore the east wind, the reading in the Dead Sea Isaiah Scroll, which is clearly more correct than MT’s qmh, “standing grain.”;

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ וְצֵאתְךָ וּבֹאֲךָ יָדָעְתִּי וְאֵת הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלָי׃
verses.english: your staying, your going, and your coming I know,[yes], and your raging against me.

verses.hebrew: יַעַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ אֵלַי וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ עָלָה בְאָזְנָי וְשַׂמְתִּי חַחִי בְּאַפֶּךָ וּמִתְגִּי בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־בָּאתָ בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Because you have raged against me,and your roaring, “complacency,” as she’onkhato. has ascended to my ears,I will put my hook in your nostrilsand my bridle in your lips,and I will turn you back on the wayby which you came.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת אָכוֹל הַשָּׁנָה סָפִיחַ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית סָחִישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁלִישִׁית זִרְעוּ וְקִצְרוּ וְנִטְעוּ כְרָמִים וְאִכְלוּ פִרְיָם׃
verses.english: And this shall be the sign for you:eat this year the wild-growth,and in the second year, the aftergrowth,and in the third year, sow and harvest and plant vineyards,and eat their fruit.

verses.hebrew: וְיָסְפָה פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית־יְהוּדָה הַנִּשְׁאָרָה שֹׁרֶשׁ לְמָטָּה וְעָשָׂה פְרִי לְמָעְלָה׃
verses.english: And the survivors of the House of Judah, the remaining ones,will add rootgrowth below,and will produce fruit above;

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִירוּשָׁלִַם תֵּצֵא שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה מֵהַר צִיּוֹן קִנְאַת יְהוָה [צְבָאוֹת] תַּעֲשֶׂה־זֹּאת׃
verses.english: for from Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant,and the survivors from Mount Zion—the zeal of YHWH of the Forces-On-High will do this!

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְלֹא־יוֹרֶה שָׁם חֵץ וְלֹא־יְקַדְּמֶנָּה מָגֵן וְלֹא־יִשְׁפֹּךְ עָלֶיהָ סֹלְלָה׃
verses.english: Therefore, thus says YHWH concerning the king of Assyria:He shall not enter this city,he shall not shoot an arrow there,he shall not advance upon it [with a] shield,he shall not pile up a siege-mound against it!

verses.hebrew: בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָּהּ יָשׁוּב וְאֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לֹא יָבֹא נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: By the way that he came, he shall return,but this city he shall not enter—the Utterance of YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וְגַנּוֹתִי אֶל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְהוֹשִׁיעָהּ לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃
verses.english: And I will shield this city to deliver it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֵּצֵא מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַיַּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה אַשּׁוּר מֵאָה שְׁמוֹנִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה אָלֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ בַבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה כֻלָּם פְּגָרִים מֵתִים׃
verses.english: It was on that very nightthat the messenger of YHWH went forthand struck down in the camp of Assyria a hundred and eighty-five thousand;they started-early at daybreak,and here, all of them were corpses, dead men!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשָׁב סַנְחֵרִיב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּנִינְוֵה׃
verses.english: So Sanheriv king of Assyria marched off and went away and returned [home],and stayed in Nineveh.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הוּא מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה בֵּית נִסְרֹךְ אֱלֹהָיו וְאַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶצֶר [בָּנָיו] הִכֻּהוּ בַחֶרֶב וְהֵמָּה נִמְלְטוּ אֶרֶץ אֲרָרָט וַיִּמְלֹךְ אֵסַר־חַדֹּן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Now it was, when he was bowing down in the house of Nisrokh his god,that Adrammelekh and Sar’etzer his sons struck him down with the sword.They escaped to the land of Ararat,and Esar-haddon, “[The god] Ashur Has Given a Brother.” his son became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן־אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה׃
verses.english: In those days,Hizkiyyahu became sick, to [the point of] death.And Yesha’yahu son of Amotz, the prophet, came to him and said to him:Thus says YHWH:Charge your household,for you are about to die, and will not live!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־פָּנָיו אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: He turned his face to the walland prayed to YHWH, saying:

verses.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהוָה זְכָר־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְלֵבָב שָׁלֵם וְהַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי וַיֵּבְךְּ חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּכִי גָדוֹל׃
verses.english: Please, O YHWH,pray recall how I have walked about before you with truthfulness and with a whole heart,and what was good in your eyes, I have done!And Hizkiyyahu wept with a great weeping.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ לֹא יָצָא העיר [חָצֵר] הַתִּיכֹנָה וּדְבַר־יְהוָה הָיָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now Yesha’yahu had not yet gone out of the middle courtyardwhen the word of YHWH [came] to him, saying:

verses.hebrew: שׁוּב וְאָמַרְתָּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ נְגִיד־עַמִּי כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי דָּוִד אָבִיךָ שָׁמַעְתִּי אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֶךָ רָאִיתִי אֶת־דִּמְעָתֶךָ הִנְנִי רֹפֶא לָךְ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי תַּעֲלֶה בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Return, you are to say to Hizkiyyahu, Nagid See note to I Kings 1:35. Since the term has not been used from I Kings 14:7 until now, it is clear that Hizkiyyahu is being singled out in a positive way. of my people:Thus says YHWH, the God of David your father:I have heard your prayer,I have seen your tears.Here, I am healing you;on the third day, you will go up to the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְהֹסַפְתִּי עַל־יָמֶיךָ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וּמִכַּף מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר אַצִּילְךָ וְאֵת הָעִיר הַזֹּאת וְגַנּוֹתִי עַל־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת לְמַעֲנִי וּלְמַעַן דָּוִד עַבְדִּי׃
verses.english: I will add fifteen years to your days,and from the grasp of the king of Assyria I will rescue you, along with this city;I will shield this cityfor my sake and for the sake of David my servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ קְחוּ דְּבֶלֶת תְּאֵנִים וַיִּקְחוּ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַשְּׁחִין וַיֶּחִי׃
verses.english: Then Yesha’yahu said:Fetch a cake of figs.They fetched it and placed it on the boil,and he lived.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ מָה אוֹת כִּי־יִרְפָּא יְהוָה לִי וְעָלִיתִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And Hizkiyyahu said to Yesha’yahu:What is the sign that YHWH will heal me,so that I may go up by the third day to the House of YHWH?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ זֶה־לְּךָ הָאוֹת מֵאֵת יְהוָה כִּי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר הָלַךְ הַצֵּל עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת אִם־יָשׁוּב עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃
verses.english: Yesha’yahu said:This will be for you the sign from YHWHthat YHWH will do the thing that he has promised:the shadow has gone forward ten steps;can it return ten steps?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ נָקֵל לַצֵּל לִנְטוֹת עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת לֹא כִי יָשׁוּב הַצֵּל אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃
verses.english: He said:It is easy for the shadow. to lengthen ten steps;not so, that the shadow can return backward ten steps.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־יְהוָה וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַצֵּל בַּמַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁר יָרְדָה בְּמַעֲלוֹת אָחָז אֲחֹרַנִּית עֶשֶׂר מַעֲלוֹת׃
verses.english: So Yesha’yahu the prophet called out to YHWH,and he made the shadow return by the steps by which it had gone down on the step-dial of Ahaz, backward by ten steps.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא שָׁלַח בְּרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן בֶּן־בַּלְאֲדָן מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל סְפָרִים וּמִנְחָה אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: At [about] that time,Merodakh Bal’adan, “[The God] Marduk Gave the Inheriting Son.” This foe of Assyria reigned from 722 to 710 and again from 704 to 703. son of Bal’adan king of Babylon sent letters and a gift to Hizkiyyahu,for he had heard that Hizkiyyahu was sick.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע עֲלֵיהֶם חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־כָּל־בֵּית נְכֹתֹה אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַבְּשָׂמִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַטּוֹב וְאֵת בֵּית כֵּלָיו וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא בְּאוֹצְרֹתָיו לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֶרְאָם חִזְקִיָּהוּ בְּבֵיתוֹ וּבְכָל־מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: And Hizkiyyahu was pleased with them replacing MT’s sh-m-’, “heard about them.” them: Presumably the messengers from the Babylonian king. ,and he had them see his whole storehouse, a loan word from Akkadian.—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oil,his weapons house,and all that was to be found in his treasuries.There was not a thing that Hizkiyyahu did not have them see in his house or in all his kingdom.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְשַׁעְיָהוּ הַנָּבִיא אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ חִזְקִיָּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מָה אָמְרוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה וּמֵאַיִן יָבֹאוּ אֵלֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ מֵאֶרֶץ רְחוֹקָה בָּאוּ מִבָּבֶל׃
verses.english: Then Yesha’yahu the prophet came to King Hizkiyyahu and said to him:What did these men say,and from where do they come to you?Hizkiyyahu said:From a land far away they came, from Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה רָאוּ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתִי רָאוּ לֹא־הָיָה דָבָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הִרְאִיתִם בְּאֹצְרֹתָי׃
verses.english: He said:What did they see in your house?He said:Everything that is in my house they saw;there was not a thing that I did not have them see in my treasuries.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ שְׁמַע דְּבַר־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then Yesha’yahu said to Hizkiyyahu:Hear the word of YHWH:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יָמִים בָּאִים וְנִשָּׂא כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵיתֶךָ וַאֲשֶׁר אָצְרוּ אֲבֹתֶיךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה בָּבֶלָה לֹא־יִוָּתֵר דָּבָר אָמַר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Here, days are comingwhen everything in your house will be carried off,[all] that your fathers amassed-as-treasure up until this day, to Babylon;there will not be a thing left, says YHWH!

verses.hebrew: וּמִבָּנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יֵצְאוּ מִמְּךָ אֲשֶׁר תּוֹלִיד יקח [יִקָּחוּ] וְהָיוּ סָרִיסִים בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃
verses.english: And some of your sons who have issued from you, whom you have begotten, will be taken away,and they will become officials in the Great-Hall of the king of Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֶל־יְשַׁעְיָהוּ טוֹב דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲלוֹא אִם־שָׁלוֹם וֶאֱמֶת יִהְיֶה בְיָמָי׃
verses.english: Hizkiyyahu said to Yesha’yahu:Good is the word of YHWH that you have spoken.For he said [to himself]:Will there not [at least] be trustworthy peace in my days?

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ וְכָל־גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֶת־הַבְּרֵכָה וְאֶת־הַתְּעָלָה וַיָּבֵא אֶת־הַמַּיִם הָעִירָה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Hizkiyyahu, and all his mighty-deeds,—how he made the pool and the channel, and brought the waters into the city—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב חִזְקִיָּהוּ עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Hizkiyyahu lay beside his fathers,and Menashe his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מְנַשֶּׁה בְמָלְכוֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֶפְצִי־בָהּ׃
verses.english: Twelve years old was Menashe trad. English “Manasseh.” The meaning seems to be “He Who Makes Forget” (the name of one of Yosef’s [Joseph’s] sons; see Gen. 41:51). at his becoming king,and for fifty-five years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Heftzi-va. It means “My Delight Is in Her”; trad. English “Hephzibah.”.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּתוֹעֲבֹת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,according to the abominations of the nations that YHWH had dispossessed before the Children of Israel:

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּבֶן אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר אִבַּד חִזְקִיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיָּקֶם מִזְבְּחֹת לַבַּעַל וַיַּעַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אַחְאָב מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְכָל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹד אֹתָם׃
verses.english: he once again built the sanctuaries that Hizkiyyahu his father had demolished,and erected sacrificial-altars to Baal,and made an Ashera-pole, just as Ah’av king of Israel had made,and bowed down to all the Forces of the Heavens, and served them;

verses.hebrew: וּבָנָה מִזְבְּחֹת בְּבֵית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלִַם אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי׃
verses.english: he built sacrificial-altars in the House of YHWHabout which YHWH had said: In Jerusalem I will set my name!,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן מִזְבְּחוֹת לְכָל־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: and he built sacrificial-altars to all the Forces of the Heavensin the two courtyards of the House of YHWH;

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר אֶת־בְּנוֹ בָּאֵשׁ וְעוֹנֵן וְנִחֵשׁ וְעָשָׂה אוֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִים הִרְבָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְהַכְעִיס׃
verses.english: he had his son cross through the fireand practiced soothsaying and divination, made [contact with] ghosts) derives from a pit where ghosts are summoned. It and “all-knowing ones” are used to describe both them and those who deal with them. and all-knowing ones—he did much that was evil in the eyes of YHWH, to provoke him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־פֶּסֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה אֶל־דָּוִד וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַרְתִּי מִכֹּל שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָשִׂים אֶת־שְׁמִי לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And he placed the statue of Ashera that he had madein the House about which YHWH had said to David and to Shelomo his son:In this House in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel,I will set my name for the ages,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אֹסִיף לְהָנִיד רֶגֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם רַק אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִים וּלְכָל־הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֹתָם עַבְדִּי מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: and I will not continue to make Israel’s foot wander from the soil that I gave to their fathers;if only they take care to observe according to all that I have commanded them,including all the Instruction that my servant Moshe commanded them.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמֵעוּ וַיַּתְעֵם מְנַשֶּׁה לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הָרָע מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִיד יְהוָה מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But they did not hearken,and Menashe led them astray to do what was evil, more than the nations that YHWH had wiped out before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: So YHWH spoke by the hand of his servants the prophets, saying:

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֵרַע מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וַיַּחֲטִא גַם־אֶת־יְהוּדָה בְּגִלּוּלָיו׃
verses.english: Because Menashe king of Judah has done these abominations,practicing more evil than all that the Amorites did who were before him,and has caused Judah too to sin with his Illicit-Things,

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם וִיהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר כָּל־שמעיו [שֹׁמְעָהּ] תִּצַּלְנָה שְׁתֵּי אָזְנָיו׃
verses.english: therefore,thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Here, I am about to bring such evil upon Jerusalem and Judahthat all who hear of it, their two ears will ring!

verses.hebrew: וְנָטִיתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֵת קָו שֹׁמְרוֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹלֶת בֵּית אַחְאָב וּמָחִיתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם כַּאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶה אֶת־הַצַּלַּחַת מָחָה וְהָפַךְ עַל־פָּנֶיהָ׃
verses.english: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring-line of Shomeron and the plumb-bob of the House of Ah’av,and I will wipe Jerusalem clean as one wipes a dish clean,wiping and turning it over on its face.

verses.hebrew: וְנָטַשְׁתִּי אֵת שְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתִי וּנְתַתִּים בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְהָיוּ לְבַז וְלִמְשִׁסָּה לְכָל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And I will forsake the remnant of my inheritanceand give them into the hand of their enemies,so that they become spoil and pillage for all their enemies,

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינַי וַיִּהְיוּ מַכְעִסִים אֹתִי מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ אֲבוֹתָם מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: because they have done what was evil in my eyes, and have been provoking mefrom the day that their fathers went out of Egypt until this day.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם דָּם נָקִי שָׁפַךְ מְנַשֶּׁה הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם פֶּה לָפֶה לְבַד מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יְהוּדָה לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: —Now even more, Menashe spilled innocent blood, exceedingly much,until he filled Jerusalem from one end to the [other] end,aside from his sin by which he caused Judah to sin,by doing what was evil in the eyes of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי מְנַשֶּׁה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Menashe, and all that he did,and the sins that he sinned—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב מְנַשֶּׁה עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּגַן־בֵּיתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ אָמוֹן בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Menashe lay beside his fathers;he was buried in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza,and Amon his son reigned as king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה אָמוֹן בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ מְשֻׁלֶּמֶת בַּת־חָרוּץ מִן־יָטְבָה׃
verses.english: Twenty-two years old was Amon at his becoming king,and for two years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Meshullemet daughter of Harutz, from Yotva.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה אָבִיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH, as Menashe his father had done:

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ אָבִיו וַיַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים אֲשֶׁר עָבַד אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶם׃
verses.english: he walked in all the way that his father had walked,and served the Illicit-Things that his father had served, and bowed down to them;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָיו וְלֹא הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: he abandoned YHWH, the God of his fathers,and did not walk in the way of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְשְׁרוּ עַבְדֵי־אָמוֹן עָלָיו וַיָּמִיתוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: And Amon’s [court-]servants conspired against him,and put the king to death in his house.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֵת כָּל־הַקֹּשְׁרִים עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ אָמוֹן וַיַּמְלִיכוּ עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: But the Landed People struck down all those who had conspired against Amon,and the Landed People made Yoshiyyahu his son king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי אָמוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Amon, [and all] that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּר אֹתוֹ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ בְּגַן־עֻזָּא וַיִּמְלֹךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: He was buried in his burial-place in the garden of Uzza,and Yoshiyyahu, and possibly meaning “YHWH Will Grant.” his son became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנָה יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ בְמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ יְדִידָה בַת־עֲדָיָה מִבָּצְקַת׃
verses.english: Eight years old was Yoshiyyahu at his becoming king,and for thirty-one years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Yedida daughter of Adaya, from Botzkat.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּרֶךְ דָּוִד אָבִיו וְלֹא־סָר יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃
verses.english: He did what was right in the eyes of YHWH,and walked in all the way of David his father;he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ שָׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־שָׁפָן בֶּן־אֲצַלְיָהוּ בֶן־מְשֻׁלָּם הַסֹּפֵר בֵּית יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Now it was in the eighteenth year of King Yoshiyyahu:the king sent Shafan. The hyrax or the rock badger, an animal mentioned in Lev. 11:5 (see Commentary to this chapter). son of Atzalyahu son of Meshullam the Scribe to the House of YHWH, saying:

verses.hebrew: עֲלֵה אֶל־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְיַתֵּם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַמּוּבָא בֵּית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר אָסְפוּ שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף מֵאֵת הָעָם׃
verses.english: Go up to Hilkiyyahu. “YHWH Is My Portion”; trad. English “Hilkiah.” Some have suggested that he is identical to the father of the prophet Jeremiah, although the latter’s family came from Anatot, and seem not to have been serving as priests any longer. the Great Priest and have him sum up the silver that has been brought to the House of YHWH,which the guardians of the threshold have gathered from the people,

verses.hebrew: ויתנה [וְיִתְּנֻהוּ] עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה הַמֻּפְקָדִים בבית [בֵּית] יְהוָה וְיִתְּנוּ אֹתוֹ לְעֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהוָה לְחַזֵּק בֶּדֶק הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: and let them give it into the hand of those doing the work, those accountable in the House of YHWH;they shall give it over to those doing the work who are in the House of YHWH, to strengthen the breaches in the House of YHWH—

verses.hebrew: לֶחָרָשִׁים וְלַבֹּנִים וְלַגֹּדְרִים וְלִקְנוֹת עֵצִים וְאַבְנֵי מַחְצֵב לְחַזֵּק אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃
verses.english: to the carvers, to the builders, and to the wall-masons,and for purchasing wood and hewn stone, to strengthen the House.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־יֵחָשֵׁב אִתָּם הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּתָּן עַל־יָדָם כִּי בֶאֱמוּנָה הֵם עֹשִׂים׃
verses.english: But there need not be reckoning with them for the silver that is given into their hand,for in trustworthy-fashion they deal.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל עַל־שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה מָצָאתִי בְּבֵית יְהוָה וַיִּתֵּן חִלְקִיָּה אֶת־הַסֵּפֶר אֶל־שָׁפָן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Then Hilkiyyahu the Great Priest said to Shafan the Scribe:I have found a [written] Record of the Instruction in the House of YHWH!And Hilkiyyahu gave the record to Shafan, and he read it.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר וַיֹּאמֶר הִתִּיכוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף הַנִּמְצָא בַבַּיִת וַיִּתְּנֻהוּ עַל־יַד עֹשֵׂי הַמְּלָאכָה הַמֻּפְקָדִים בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then Shafan the Scribe came to the kingand returned word to the king;he said:Your servants have melted down the silver that was found in the Houseand have given it over to the hand of those doing the work, those accountable in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּד שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר סֵפֶר נָתַן לִי חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וַיִּקְרָאֵהוּ שָׁפָן לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And Shafan the Scribe told the king, saying:Hilkiyya the priest has given me a [written] record.And Shafan read it before the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּשְׁמֹעַ הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃
verses.english: It was, when the king heard the words of the Record of the Instruction,that he tore his garments;

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶת־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן וְאֶת־עַכְבּוֹר בֶּן־מִיכָיָה וְאֵת שָׁפָן הַסֹּפֵר וְאֵת עֲשָׂיָה עֶבֶד־הַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: and the king commanded Hilkiyya the priest and Ahikam son of Shafan and Akhbor son of Mikhaya and Shafan the Scribe and Asaya Servant of the king, saying:

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ דִרְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בַּעֲדִי וּבְעַד־הָעָם וּבְעַד כָּל־יְהוּדָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַנִּמְצָא הַזֶּה כִּי־גְדוֹלָה חֲמַת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא נִצְּתָה בָנוּ עַל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁמְעוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ עַל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּכָל־הַכָּתוּב עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Go, inquire of YHWH on my behalf, on behalf of the people, and on behalf of all Judahconcerning the words of this Record that has been found,for great is the wrath of YHWH that has been kindled against usbecause our fathers did not hearken to the words of this Record,to observe all that is written concerning us!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וַאֲחִיקָם וְעַכְבּוֹר וְשָׁפָן וַעֲשָׂיָה אֶל־חֻלְדָּה הַנְּבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת שַׁלֻּם בֶּן־תִּקְוָה בֶּן־חַרְחַס שֹׁמֵר הַבְּגָדִים וְהִיא יֹשֶׁבֶת בִּירוּשָׁלִַם בַּמִּשְׁנֶה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: So Hilkiyyahu the priest and Ahikam and Akhbor and Shafan and Asayawent to Hulda, and meaning “Mole.” Female prophets are likewise attested in seventh-century Assyria (Cogan/Tadmor). the prophetess, wife of Shallum son of Tikva son of Harhas, Guardian of the [Royal] Garments—now she was dwelling in Jerusalem, in the Second [District]—and they spoke to her.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִמְרוּ לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח אֶתְכֶם אֵלָי׃
verses.english: She said to them:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:Say to the man who sent you to me:

verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי מֵבִיא רָעָה אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו אֵת כָּל־דִּבְרֵי הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר קָרָא מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Thus says YHWH:Here, I am about to bring evil upon this place and upon its inhabitants,all the words of the Record that the king of Judah has read,

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר עֲזָבוּנִי וַיְקַטְּרוּ לֵאלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְמַעַן הַכְעִיסֵנִי בְּכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם וְנִצְּתָה חֲמָתִי בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְלֹא תִכְבֶּה׃
verses.english: because they have abandoned me and sent-up-smoke to other gods,in order to provoke me with all the works of their hands—so my wrath will be kindled against this place, and will not be extinguished!

verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אֶתְכֶם לִדְרֹשׁ אֶת־יְהוָה כֹּה תֹאמְרוּ אֵלָיו כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁמָעְתָּ׃
verses.english: But to the king of Judah, the one sending you to inquire of YHWH,thus you are to say to him:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:As for the words that you have heard,

verses.hebrew: יַעַן רַךְ־לְבָבְךָ וַתִּכָּנַע מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְעַל־יֹשְׁבָיו לִהְיוֹת לְשַׁמָּה וְלִקְלָלָה וַתִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדֶיךָ וַתִּבְכֶּה לְפָנָי וְגַם אָנֹכִי שָׁמַעְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before YHWHwhen you heard what I spoke concerning this place and concerning its inhabitants,to become a desolation and a curse,and you tore your garments and wept before me,I too have heard—YHWH’s Utterance.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי אֹסִפְךָ עַל־אֲבֹתֶיךָ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־קִבְרֹתֶיךָ בְּשָׁלוֹם וְלֹא־תִרְאֶינָה עֵינֶיךָ בְּכֹל הָרָעָה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מֵבִיא עַל־הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּשִׁיבוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ דָּבָר׃
verses.english: Therefore,here, I will gather you to your fathers;you will be gathered to your burial-place in peace,so that your eyes will not see all the evil that I am about to bring upon this place.And they returned word to the king.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־זִקְנֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: The king sentand had all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem gathered to him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל הַמֶּלֶךְ בֵּית־יְהוָה וְכָל־אִישׁ יְהוּדָה וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אִתּוֹ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַנְּבִיאִים וְכָל־הָעָם לְמִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וַיִּקְרָא בְאָזְנֵיהֶם אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַנִּמְצָא בְּבֵית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Then the king went up to the House of YHWH,and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him,and the priests and the prophets and all the people, great and small,and he read in their ears all the words of the Record of the Covenant that had been found in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד הַמֶּלֶךְ עַל־הָעַמּוּד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הַבְּרִית לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לָלֶכֶת אַחַר יְהוָה וְלִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָיו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב וּבְכָל־נֶפֶשׁ לְהָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית הַזֹּאת הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה וַיַּעֲמֹד כָּל־הָעָם בַּבְּרִית׃
verses.english: And the king stood by the standing-columnand cut a covenant in the presence of YHWHto walk after YHWH, to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his lawswith all [one’s] heart and with all [one’s] being,to fulfill the words of this covenant that were written in this Record.And all the people took a stand in the covenant.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵי הַמִּשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף לְהוֹצִיא מֵהֵיכַל יְהוָה אֵת כָּל־הַכֵּלִים הָעֲשׂוּיִם לַבַּעַל וְלָאֲשֵׁרָה וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַיִּשְׂרְפֵם מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַם בְּשַׁדְמוֹת קִדְרוֹן וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲפָרָם בֵּית־אֵל׃
verses.english: Then the king charged Hilkiyyahu the Great Priest and the priests of second rank and the guardians of the thresholdto take out of the Great-Hall of YHWHall the vessels that had been made for Baal and for Ashera and for all the Forces of the Heavens,and he burned them outside Jerusalem, on the terraces of Kidron,and carried their ashes to Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבִּית אֶת־הַכְּמָרִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְקַטֵּר בַּבָּמוֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּמְסִבֵּי יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֶת־הַמְקַטְּרִים לַבַּעַל לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵחַ וְלַמַּזָּלוֹת וּלְכֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: And he put an end to the clerics) used only of foreign (pagan) priests in the Hebrew Bible. whom the kings of Judah had given-license to send-up-smoke at the sanctuaries in the towns of Judah and in the [sacred] places around Jerusalem,namely, those who sent-up-smoke to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, and to the constellations,and to all the Forces of the Heavens.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵא אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה מִבֵּית יְהוָה מִחוּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֹתָהּ בְּנַחַל קִדְרוֹן וַיָּדֶק לְעָפָר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָהּ עַל־קֶבֶר בְּנֵי הָעָם׃
verses.english: And he brought out the Ashera-pole from the House of YHWH, outside Jerusalem, to the Wadi Kidron,and burned it in the Wadi Kidron;then he crushed it into dustand threw its dust over the burial-ground of the [common] people.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־בָּתֵּי הַקְּדֵשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הַנָּשִׁים אֹרְגוֹת שָׁם בָּתִּים לָאֲשֵׁרָה׃
verses.english: And he demolished the houses of the [male] prostitutes that were in the House of YHWH,where the women had been weaving coverings for the Ashera-pole.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֵא אֶת־כָּל־הַכֹּהֲנִים מֵעָרֵי יְהוּדָה וַיְטַמֵּא אֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר קִטְּרוּ־שָׁמָּה הַכֹּהֲנִים מִגֶּבַע עַד־בְּאֵר שָׁבַע וְנָתַץ אֶת־בָּמוֹת הַשְּׁעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־פֶּתַח שַׁעַר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ שַׂר־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־שְׂמֹאול אִישׁ בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר׃
verses.english: And he brought in all the priests from the towns of Judah,and he rendered tamei That is, ritually polluted, and so permanently unfit for sacred use. the sanctuaries where the priests had sent-up-smokefrom Geva to Be’er-Sheva,and he demolished the sanctuaries at the gates that were at the entrance to the gate of Yehoshua, commander of the city,which were at a person’s left [entering] the gate of the city.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא יַעֲלוּ כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֶל־מִזְבַּח יְהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלִָם כִּי אִם־אָכְלוּ מַצּוֹת בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: However, the priests of the sanctuaries did not go up to the sacrificial-altar of YHWH in Jerusalem,although they ate unleavened-bread among their brothers.

verses.hebrew: וְטִמֵּא אֶת־הַתֹּפֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּגֵי בני־[בֶן־] הִנֹּם לְבִלְתִּי לְהַעֲבִיר אִישׁ אֶת־בְּנוֹ וְאֶת־בִּתּוֹ בָּאֵשׁ לַמֹּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And he rendered tamei the Tofet/Hearth that is in the Valley of Ben Hinnom. It was directly south of the present Old City walls. Heb. Gei Hinnom (also in the Aramaic form Gehenna), because of the terrible deeds done in this location, became the term for Hell in later Jewish literature.,so that no [one could] cross his son or his daughter through the fire to the Molekh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁבֵּת אֶת־הַסּוּסִים אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מִבֹּא בֵית־יְהוָה אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת נְתַן־מֶלֶךְ הַסָּרִיס אֲשֶׁר בַּפַּרְוָרִים וְאֶת־מַרְכְּבוֹת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And he put an end to the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun at the entrance to the House of YHWH,near the chamber of Natan-Melekh the Official that was in the [Temple] colonnade).,and the chariots of the sun he burned with fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַגָּג עֲלִיַּת אָחָז אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מְנַשֶּׁה בִּשְׁתֵּי חַצְרוֹת בֵּית־יְהוָה נָתַץ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיָּרָץ מִשָּׁם וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶת־עֲפָרָם אֶל־נַחַל קִדְרוֹן׃
verses.english: And as for the sacrificial-altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made,and the sacrificial-altars that Menashe had made in the two courtyards of the House of YHWH,the king demolished them;he hastened to vayyeritzem. them from there and threw their rubble into the Wadi Kidron.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר מִימִין לְהַר־הַמַּשְׁחִית אֲשֶׁר בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְעַשְׁתֹּרֶת שִׁקֻּץ צִידֹנִים וְלִכְמוֹשׁ שִׁקֻּץ מוֹאָב וּלְמִלְכֹּם תּוֹעֲבַת בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן טִמֵּא הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: And the sanctuaries which were facing Jerusalem, which were to the right/south of the Mount of the Ruinbringer,which Shelomo king of Israel had built to Astarte, the Detestable-One of the Sidonians,to Kemosh the Detestable-One of Moav,and to Milkom the Abominable-One of the Children of Ammon,the king rendered tamei.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁבַּר אֶת־הַמַּצֵּבוֹת וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרִים וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־מְקוֹמָם עַצְמוֹת אָדָם׃
verses.english: And he smashed the standing-pillars,and cut down the Ashera-polesand filled in their sites with human bones.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־אֵל הַבָּמָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־נְבָט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִיא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּם אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַהוּא וְאֶת־הַבָּמָה נָתָץ וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־הַבָּמָה הֵדַק לְעָפָר וְשָׂרַף אֲשֵׁרָה׃
verses.english: And also the sacrificial-altar that was at Bet-El, the sanctuary that Yorov’am son of Nevat made, [the one] who had caused Israel to sin,also that altar and the sanctuary, he demolished,and he burned the sanctuary and crushed it fine, into dust,and he burned the Ashera-pole.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַקְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם בָּהָר וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעֲצָמוֹת מִן־הַקְּבָרִים וַיִּשְׂרֹף עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְטַמְּאֵהוּ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר קָרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: And Yoshiyyahu faced aboutand saw the burial-places that were there on the hill,so he sent and had the bones taken from the burial-places and burned on the altar, rendering it tamei,in accordance with the word of YHWH which the man of God had proclaimed,who had proclaimed these things.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הַצִּיּוּן הַלָּז אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר הַקֶּבֶר אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִיהוּדָה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ עַל הַמִּזְבַּח בֵּית־אֵל׃
verses.english: Then he said:What is this marker that I see?The men of the town said to him:It is the burial-place of the man of God who came from Judah,who proclaimed these things that you have done against the sacrificial-altar of Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַנִּיחוּ לוֹ אִישׁ אַל־יָנַע עַצְמֹתָיו וַיְמַלְּטוּ עַצְמֹתָיו אֵת עַצְמוֹת הַנָּבִיא אֲשֶׁר־בָּא מִשֹּׁמְרוֹן׃
verses.english: He said:Let it rest;let no one disturb his bones!So they let his bones be,along with the bones of the prophet who had come from Shomeron.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־כָּל־בָּתֵּי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּעָרֵי שֹׁמְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַכְעִיס הֵסִיר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהֶם כְּכָל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה בְּבֵית־אֵל׃
verses.english: And also all the sanctuary buildings that were in the towns of Shomeronwhich the kings of Israel had made to provoke [YHWH], Yoshiyyahu removed;he dealt with them in accordance with all the deeds that he had done in Bet-El.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח אֶת־כָּל־כֹּהֲנֵי הַבָּמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם עַל־הַמִּזְבְּחוֹת וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־עַצְמוֹת אָדָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיָּשָׁב יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: And he slew all the priests of the sanctuaries who were there, on the sacrificial-altars,and burned human bones on them.Then he returned to Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־כָּל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר עֲשׂוּ פֶסַח לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם כַּכָּתוּב עַל סֵפֶר הַבְּרִית הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: And the king commanded all the people, saying:Observe the Passover to YHWH your God,as is written in this Record of the Covenant!

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נַעֲשָׂה כַּפֶּסַח הַזֶּה מִימֵי הַשֹּׁפְטִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁפְטוּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכֹל יְמֵי מַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: —For no such Passover had been observedsince the days of the judge-leaders who led Israel,and all the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־בִּשְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ נַעֲשָׂה הַפֶּסַח הַזֶּה לַיהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: But in the eighteenth year of King Yoshiyyahusuch a Passover was observed to YHWH in Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־הָאֹבוֹת וְאֶת־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִים וְאֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִים וְאֵת כָּל־הַשִּׁקֻּצִים אֲשֶׁר נִרְאוּ בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַם בִּעֵר יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לְמַעַן הָקִים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַכְּתֻבִים עַל־הַסֵּפֶר אֲשֶׁר מָצָא חִלְקִיָּהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And also the ghosts and the all-knowing ones, the terafim Pronounced te-rah-FEEM. Household idols, notable in Gen. 31:19 and I Sam. 19:13–16. and the Illicit-Things,and all the Detestable-Things that could be seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem,Yoshiyyahu eradicated,in order to fulfill the words of the Instruction, the ones written in the Record that Hilkiyyahu the priest had found in the House of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וְכָמֹהוּ לֹא־הָיָה לְפָנָיו מֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב אֶל־יְהוָה בְּכָל־לְבָבוֹ וּבְכָל־נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדוֹ כְּכֹל תּוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה וְאַחֲרָיו לֹא־קָם כָּמֹהוּ׃
verses.english: Now like him there was none before him as king,who turned back to YHWH with all his heart, with all his being, and with all his substance,in accordance with all the teaching of Moshe,and after him there arose none like him.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֹא־שָׁב יְהוָה מֵחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר־חָרָה אַפּוֹ בִּיהוּדָה עַל כָּל־הַכְּעָסִים אֲשֶׁר הִכְעִיסוֹ מְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: Yet YHWH did not turn back from his great flaming-anger, whose anger flared up against Judah,on account of all the provocations with which Menashe had provoked him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה גַּם אֶת־יְהוּדָה אָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנַי כַּאֲשֶׁר הֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָאַסְתִּי אֶת־הָעִיר הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַרְתִּי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי יִהְיֶה שְׁמִי שָׁם׃
verses.english: So YHWH said:Judah too I will remove from my presence,just as I removed Israel,and I will reject this city which I chose, Jerusalem,along with the House about which I said: My name will be there!

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yoshiyyahu, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה פַרְעֹה נְכֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם עַל־מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר עַל־נְהַר־פְּרָת וַיֵּלֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְמִיתֵהוּ בִּמְגִדּוֹ כִּרְאֹתוֹ אֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: In his days, Pharaoh Nekho king of Egypt came up to the king of Assyria, to the River Euphrates,and King Yoshiyyahu marched out to meet him,but he put him to death at Megiddo when he saw him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכִּבֻהוּ עֲבָדָיו מֵת מִמְּגִדּוֹ וַיְבִאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּקְבְּרֻהוּ בִּקְבֻרָתוֹ וַיִּקַּח עַם־הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ אֹתוֹ וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ תַּחַת אָבִיו׃
verses.english: His servants conveyed him dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem,and they buried him in his burial-place.And the Landed People took Yehoahaz, “YHWH Has Seized”; trad. English “Jehoahaz.” The name is another form of the previously encountered “Ahazyahu.” Apparently this was a regnal name, since formerly his name was Shallum. son of Yoshiyyahuand anointed him, making him king in place of his father.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹאָחָז בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חֲמוּטַל בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃
verses.english: Twenty-three years old was Yehoahaz at his becoming king,and for three months he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Yirmeyahu, from Livna.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as his fathers had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ פַרְעֹה נְכֹה בְרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת במלך [מִמְּלֹךְ] בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וַיִּתֶּן־עֹנֶשׁ עַל־הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה כִכַּר־כֶּסֶף וְכִכַּר זָהָב׃
verses.english: And Pharaoh Nekho imprisoned him at Rivla, in the region of Hamat, from reigning as king in Jerusalem,and placed a fine on the land of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלֵךְ פַּרְעֹה נְכֹה אֶת־אֶלְיָקִים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ תַּחַת יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ אָבִיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים וְאֶת־יְהוֹאָחָז לָקָח וַיָּבֹא מִצְרַיִם וַיָּמָת שָׁם׃
verses.english: Pharaoh Nekho made Elyakim son of Yoshiyyahu king in place of Yoshiyyahu his father,and changed his name to Yehoyakim,while Yehoahaz he took away, so that he came to Egypt and died there.

verses.hebrew: וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נָתַן יְהוֹיָקִים לְפַרְעֹה אַךְ הֶעֱרִיךְ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־פִּי פַרְעֹה אִישׁ כְּעֶרְכּוֹ נָגַשׂ אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ לָתֵת לְפַרְעֹה נְכֹה׃
verses.english: Now the silver and the gold, Yehoyakim gave [as payment] to Pharaoh,but he had to assess the land, in order to give the silver by order of Pharaoh:from each one according to his assessment he exacted the silver and the gold, from the Landed People, to give to Pharaoh Nekho.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָקִים בְּמָלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ זבידה [זְבוּדָּה] בַת־פְּדָיָה מִן־רוּמָה׃
verses.english: Twenty-five years old was Yehoyakim at his becoming king,and for eleven years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Zevuda daughter of Pedaya, from Ruma.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as his fathers had done.

verses.hebrew: בְּיָמָיו עָלָה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְהִי־לוֹ יְהוֹיָקִים עֶבֶד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּמְרָד־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: In his days, Nevukhadnetzar trad. English “Nebuchadnezzar.” Among his other accomplishments was the construction of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, renowned as one of the Seven Wonders of the ancient world. In Akkadian his name is Nabukudurru-utzur, “[The god] Nabu Has Protected the Inheriting Son.” king of Babylon came up.And Yehoyakim was servant to him for three years,but then he turned and rose-in-revolt against him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוָה בּוֹ אֶת־גְּדוּדֵי כַשְׂדִּים וְאֶת־גְּדוּדֵי אֲרָם וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי מוֹאָב וְאֵת גְּדוּדֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וַיְשַׁלְּחֵם בִּיהוּדָה לְהַאֲבִידוֹ כִּדְבַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים׃
verses.english: So YHWH sent loose against him raiding-bands of Chaldeans, bands of Aram, bands of Moav, and bands of the Children of Ammon;he sent them loose against Judah, to annihilate) which in this form appears as part of the future curses against Israel in Deut. 28:51 and 63 (Cogan/Tadmor), and is also used regarding Baal worshippers in 10:19 above. it,in accordance with the word of YHWH which he had spoken by the hand of his servants the prophets.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ עַל־פִּי יְהוָה הָיְתָה בִּיהוּדָה לְהָסִיר מֵעַל פָּנָיו בְּחַטֹּאת מְנַשֶּׁה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: Yes, at the order of YHWH did all this [come] against Judah,to remove them from his presence,for the sins of Menashe, in accordance with all that he did,

verses.hebrew: וְגַם דַּם־הַנָּקִי אֲשֶׁר שָׁפָךְ וַיְמַלֵּא אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם דָּם נָקִי וְלֹא־אָבָה יְהוָה לִסְלֹחַ׃
verses.english: and also [because of] the innocent blood that he shed—for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood—so YHWH was not willing to forgive.

verses.hebrew: וְיֶתֶר דִּבְרֵי יְהוֹיָקִים וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה הֲלֹא־הֵם כְּתוּבִים עַל־סֵפֶר דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים לְמַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: Now the rest of the events of Yehoyakim, and all that he did—are they not written in the Record of Yearly Events of the Kings of Judah?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב יְהוֹיָקִים עִם־אֲבֹתָיו וַיִּמְלֹךְ יְהוֹיָכִין בְּנוֹ תַּחְתָּיו׃
verses.english: Yehoyakim lay beside his fathers,and Yehoyakhin his son became king in his place.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֹסִיף עוֹד מֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם לָצֵאת מֵאַרְצוֹ כִּי־לָקַח מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל מִנַּחַל מִצְרַיִם עַד־נְהַר־פְּרָת כֹּל אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: Now the king of Egypt no longer went out [to war] from his land any more,for the king of Babylon had taken away, from the Wadi of Egypt to the River Euphrates,all that had belonged to the king of Egypt.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה יְהוֹיָכִין בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁה חֳדָשִׁים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּא בַת־אֶלְנָתָן מִירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Eighteen years old was Yehoyakhin at his becoming king,and for three months he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Nehushta daughter of Elnatan, from Jerusalem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה אָבִיו׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as his father had done.

verses.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַהִיא עלה [עָלוּ] עַבְדֵי נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר׃
verses.english: At [about] that time, the servants of Nevukhadnetzar king of Babylon went up to Jerusalem,and the city came under siege.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל עַל־הָעִיר וַעֲבָדָיו צָרִים עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Nevukhadnetzar king of Babylon came to the citywhile his servants were besieging it,

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל הוּא וְאִמּוֹ וַעֲבָדָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְסָרִיסָיו וַיִּקַּח אֹתוֹ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת שְׁמֹנֶה לְמָלְכוֹ׃
verses.english: and Yehoyakhin king of Judah went out [in surrender] to the king of Babylon,he and his mother, his court-servants, his officers, and his officials,and the king of Babylon took him [prisoner] in year eight of his being king.
