verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא מִשָּׁם אֶת־כָּל־אוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה וְאוֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיְקַצֵּץ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהֵיכַל יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And he brought out from there all the treasuries of the House of YHWH and the treasuries of the king’s house;he cut-to-pieces all the vessels of gold that Shelomo king of Israel had made in the Great-Hall of YHWH,as YHWH had promised.

verses.hebrew: וְהִגְלָה אֶת־כָּל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאֶת־כָּל־הַשָּׂרִים וְאֵת כָּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל עשרה [עֲשֶׂרֶת] אֲלָפִים גּוֹלֶה וְכָל־הֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר לֹא נִשְׁאַר זוּלַת דַּלַּת עַם־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He exiled all of Jerusalem:all the officers and all the mighty-men of valor,ten thousand exiles,and all the carvers and the smiths;none remained, save the poorest of the people of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּגֶל אֶת־יְהוֹיָכִין בָּבֶלָה וְאֶת־אֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֶת־סָרִיסָיו וְאֵת אולי [אֵילֵי] הָאָרֶץ הוֹלִיךְ גּוֹלָה מִירוּשָׁלִַם בָּבֶלָה׃
verses.english: And he exiled Yehoyakhin to Babylon,while the king’s mother and the king’s wives and his officials and the “rams” of the land he made go into exile, from Jerusalem to Babylon,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וְהֶחָרָשׁ וְהַמַּסְגֵּר אֶלֶף הַכֹּל גִּבּוֹרִים עֹשֵׂי מִלְחָמָה וַיְבִיאֵם מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל גּוֹלָה בָּבֶלָה׃
verses.english: along with all the men of valor, seven thousand,and the carvers and the smiths, a thousand,all mighty-men, trained for battle;the king of Babylon brought them into exile, to Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְלֵךְ מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־מַתַּנְיָה דֹדוֹ תַּחְתָּיו וַיַּסֵּב אֶת־שְׁמוֹ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: And the king of Babylon installed Mattanya his uncle as king in his place,and changed his name to Tzidkiyyahu.

verses.hebrew: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְאַחַת שָׁנָה צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְמָלְכוֹ וְאַחַת עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ חמיטל [חֲמוּטַל] בַּת־יִרְמְיָהוּ מִלִּבְנָה׃
verses.english: Twenty-one years old was Tzidkiyyahu at his becoming king,and for eleven years he reigned as king in Jerusalem;his mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Yirmeyahu, from Livna.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יְהוֹיָקִים׃
verses.english: He did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,exactly as Yehoyakim had done.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עַל־אַף יְהוָה הָיְתָה בִירוּשָׁלִַם וּבִיהוּדָה עַד־הִשְׁלִכוֹ אֹתָם מֵעַל פָּנָיו וַיִּמְרֹד צִדְקִיָּהוּ בְּמֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל׃
verses.english: Indeed, [it was] because of YHWH’s anger that it happened in Jerusalem and in Judah,until he cast them out from his presence.And Tzidkiyyahu rose-in-revolt against the king of Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִשְׁנַת הַתְּשִׁיעִית לְמָלְכוֹ בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּא נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל הוּא וְכָל־חֵילוֹ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּחַן עָלֶיהָ וַיִּבְנוּ עָלֶיהָ דָּיֵק סָבִיב׃
verses.english: So it was in the ninth year of his being king,in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month:Nevukhadnetzar king of Babylon, he and all his army, came against Jerusalem;they set up camp against it and built a bulwark against it, all around.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא הָעִיר בַּמָּצוֹר עַד עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ צִדְקִיָּהוּ׃
verses.english: And the city came under siege until the eleventh year of King Tzidkiyyahu.

verses.hebrew: בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַק הָרָעָב בָּעִיר וְלֹא־הָיָה לֶחֶם לְעַם הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: On [day] nine of the [fourth] month, hunger became strong in the city;there was no food [even] for the Landed People.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּבָּקַע הָעִיר וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַלַּיְלָה דֶּרֶךְ שַׁעַר בֵּין הַחֹמֹתַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל־גַּן הַמֶּלֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּים עַל־הָעִיר סָבִיב וַיֵּלֶךְ דֶּרֶךְ הָעֲרָבָה׃
verses.english: The city-wall was broken through,[and Tzidkiyyahu] and all the men fit for battle [fled] at night through the gate between the double-walls that are near the king’s garden,with the Chaldeans all around the city;he went by the Road of the Plain.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפוּ חֵיל־כַּשְׂדִּים אַחַר הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂגוּ אֹתוֹ בְּעַרְבוֹת יְרֵחוֹ וְכָל־חֵילוֹ נָפֹצוּ מֵעָלָיו׃
verses.english: But the Chaldean army pursued after the kingand overtook him in the Plains of Jericho,with all his army having scattered from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְפְּשׂוּ אֶת־הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ אִתּוֹ מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: They seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon, at Rivla,and pronounced judgment upon him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בְּנֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ שָׁחֲטוּ לְעֵינָיו וְאֶת־עֵינֵי צִדְקִיָּהוּ עִוֵּר וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ בַנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְבִאֵהוּ בָּבֶל׃
verses.english: The sons of Tzidkiyyahu were slain before his eyes,and Tzidkiyyahu’s eyes were blinded;then they bound him with double-bronze and brought him to Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הִיא שְׁנַת תְּשַׁע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה לַמֶּלֶךְ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל בָּא נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים עֶבֶד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Now in the fifth month, on [day] seven of the month—that is the nineteenth year of King Nevukhadnetzar, king of Babylon,Nevuzar’adan Akkadian Nabu-zer-iddina, “Nabu has given me offspring.” , Captain of the Guard, servant to the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂרֹף אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְאֵת כָּל־בָּתֵּי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּית גָּדוֹל שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: he burned down the House of YHWH and the king’s houseand all the houses of Jerusalem,and every house of a great-one he burned with fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חוֹמֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם סָבִיב נָתְצוּ כָּל־חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר רַב־טַבָּחִים׃
verses.english: As for the walls of Jerusalem, all around,they were demolished by all the Chaldean army that belonged to the Captain of the Guard.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּעִיר וְאֶת־הַנֹּפְלִים אֲשֶׁר נָפְלוּ עַל־הַמֶּלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְאֵת יֶתֶר הֶהָמוֹן הֶגְלָה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים׃
verses.english: And the rest of the people who remained in the city,and those falling away who had fallen away to the king of Babylon, the rest of the masses,Nevuzar’adan the Captain of the Guard exiled;

verses.hebrew: וּמִדַּלַּת הָאָרֶץ הִשְׁאִיר רַב־טַבָּחִים לְכֹרְמִים וּלְיֹגְבִים׃
verses.english: but from the poor of the land, the Captain of the Guard allowed some to remain,as vine-dressers and as husbandmen.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בֵּית־יְהוָה וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנוֹת וְאֶת־יָם הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית־יְהוָה שִׁבְּרוּ כַשְׂדִּים וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־נְחֻשְׁתָּם בָּבֶלָה׃
verses.english: Now the bronze columns that were in the House of YHWH,and the bases and the Bronze Sea that were in the House of YHWH, the Chaldeans smashed,and brought their bronze to Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַסִּירֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמְזַמְּרוֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּוֹת וְאֵת כָּל־כְּלֵי הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ־בָם לָקָחוּ׃
verses.english: And the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the ladlesand all the bronze vessels with which they attended, they took.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתּוֹת וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר זָהָב זָהָב וַאֲשֶׁר־כֶּסֶף כָּסֶף לָקַח רַב־טַבָּחִים׃
verses.english: And the fire-pans and the forks that were of gold, [each of] gold, and of silver, [each of] silver—the Captain of the Guard took.

verses.hebrew: הָעַמּוּדִים שְׁנַיִם הַיָּם הָאֶחָד וְהַמְּכֹנוֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה שְׁלֹמֹה לְבֵית יְהוָה לֹא־הָיָה מִשְׁקָל לִנְחֹשֶׁת כָּל־הַכֵּלִים הָאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: Now the columns, two, the Sea, one, and the bases that Shelomo had made for the House of YHWH,were beyond weighing for bronze, all these vessels.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה אַמָּה קוֹמַת הָעַמּוּד הָאֶחָד וְכֹתֶרֶת עָלָיו נְחֹשֶׁת וְקוֹמַת הַכֹּתֶרֶת שָׁלֹשׁ אמה [אַמּוֹת] וּשְׂבָכָה וְרִמֹּנִים עַל־הַכֹּתֶרֶת סָבִיב הַכֹּל נְחֹשֶׁת וְכָאֵלֶּה לַעַמּוּד הַשֵּׁנִי עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָה׃
verses.english: Eighteen cubits was the height of the one column,with a crowning-capital for it of bronze,and the height of the capital three cubits,with a lattice-work and pomegranates on the capital, all around,—all of it was bronze—and like these for the second column, along with the lattice-work.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח רַב־טַבָּחִים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה כֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָהוּ כֹּהֵן מִשְׁנֶה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹשֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵי הַסַּף׃
verses.english: And the Captain of the Guard took Seraya the Head Priest and Tzefanyahu the Second Priestand the three guardians of the threshold;

verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הָעִיר לָקַח סָרִיס אֶחָד אֲ‍שֶׁר־הוּא פָקִיד עַל־אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה וַחֲמִשָּׁה אֲנָשִׁים מֵרֹאֵי פְנֵי־הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצְאוּ בָעִיר וְאֵת הַסֹּפֵר שַׂר הַצָּבָא הַמַּצְבִּא אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁים אִישׁ מֵעַם הָאָרֶץ הַנִּמְצְאִים בָּעִיר׃
verses.english: and from the city he took an official who was [The One] Accountable for the Men of War,and five men from Those [Who] See the King’s Face who were found in the city,and the Scribe of the Commander of the Armed-Forces who mustered the forces of the Landed People,and sixty men from the Landed People who were found in the city;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֹתָם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָן רַב־טַבָּחִים וַיֹּלֶךְ אֹתָם עַל־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל רִבְלָתָה׃
verses.english: Nevuzar’adan the Captain of the Guard took themand brought them to the king of Babylon at Rivla.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אֹתָם מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיְמִיתֵם בְּרִבְלָה בְּאֶרֶץ חֲמָת וַיִּגֶל יְהוּדָה מֵעַל אַדְמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death at Rivla, in the land of Hamat.So Judah was exiled from its soil.

verses.hebrew: וְהָעָם הַנִּשְׁאָר בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁאִיר נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וַיַּפְקֵד עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָם בֶּן־שָׁפָן׃
verses.english: Now as for the people who remained in the land of Judah,whom Nevukhadnetzar king of Babylon allowed to remain—he appointed over them Gedalyahu son of Ahikam son of Shafan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כָל־שָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים הֵמָּה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים כִּי־הִפְקִיד מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָהוּ הַמִּצְפָּה וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה וְיוֹחָנָן בֶּן־קָרֵחַ וּשְׂרָיָה בֶן־תַּנְחֻמֶת הַנְּטֹפָתִי וְיַאֲזַנְיָהוּ בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִי הֵמָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם׃
verses.english: And all the commanders of the soldiers heard, they and their men, that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedalyahu,so they came to Gedalyahu at Mitzpa—Yishmael son of Netanya, Yohanan son of Kare’ah, Seraya son of Tanhumet the Netofatite, and Yaazanyahu son of the Maakhatite,they and their men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׁבַע לָהֶם גְּדַלְיָהוּ וּלְאַנְשֵׁיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם אַל־תִּירְאוּ מֵעַבְדֵי הַכַּשְׂדִּים שְׁבוּ בָאָרֶץ וְעִבְדוּ אֶת־מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל וְיִטַב לָכֶם׃
verses.english: And Gedalyahu swore to them and to their men;he said to them:Do not be afraid of serving the Chaldeans;stay in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בָּא יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָה בֶּן־אֱלִישָׁמָע מִזֶּרַע הַמְּלוּכָה וַעֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים אִתּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָהוּ וַיָּמֹת וְאֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּים אֲשֶׁר־הָיוּ אִתּוֹ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: But it was in the seventh monththat Yishmael son of Netanya son of Elishama, one of the royal seed, and ten men with him, cameand struck down Gedalyahu, so that he died,along with the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ כָל־הָעָם מִקָּטֹן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל וְשָׂרֵי הַחֲיָלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיִם כִּי יָרְאוּ מִפְּנֵי כַשְׂדִּים׃
verses.english: Then all the people, great and small, and the commanders of the soldiers, arose and went to Egypt,for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִשְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה לְגָלוּת יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ נָשָׂא אֱוִיל מְרֹדַךְ מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בִּשְׁנַת מָלְכוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ יְהוֹיָכִין מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא׃
verses.english: Now it was in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Yehoyakhin king of Judah,in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh of the month,that Ehvil-Merodakh Akkadian Amel-marduk, “Worshipper of [the god] Marduk.” The son of Nevukhadnetzar, he reigned only from 562 to 560 B.C.E. Trad. English translations render the name as “Evil Merodach,” with unintentional negative connotations. In biblical Hebrew, though, ehvil does happen to mean “foolish.” , king of Babylon, in the year of his becoming king, lifted up the head of Yehoyakhin king of Judah, from the prison house.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ טֹבוֹת וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־כִּסְאוֹ מֵעַל כִּסֵּא הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְּבָבֶל׃
verses.english: He spoke kind-words with himand set his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon.

verses.hebrew: וְשִׁנָּא אֵת בִּגְדֵי כִלְאוֹ וְאָכַל לֶחֶם תָּמִיד לְפָנָיו כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו׃
verses.english: So he changed his prison garmentsand ate food regularly before him,all the days of his life;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲרֻחָתוֹ אֲרֻחַת תָּמִיד נִתְּנָה־לּוֹ מֵאֵת הַמֶּלֶךְ דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיָּו׃
verses.english: his allowance, a regular allowance, was given to him by the king, each day’s amount in its day,all the days of his life.
